plugins.about: Vereinfachtes Verfahren zur Berechnung einer Flutwelle mit primär eindimensionaler Ausbreitung. Dieses Programm dient der Abschätzung der Flutwelle.  Die Überprüfung der Resultate ist durch den Benutzer vorzunehmen. Der Benutzer trägt die Verantwortung für etwaige Konsequenzen. Neben der Aktivierung des Plug-ins müssen die GeoTIF-Files der zu untersuchenden Region in ein Verzeichnis heruntergeladen werden. Zu finden sind die Files bei swissALTI3D  oder swissSURFACE3D sie sind jedoch vorzugsweise in separate Verzeichnisse zu speichern.
plugins.author: retep relleum

plugins.name: CLC2Manning
plugins.description: Calcula la rugosidad de Manning de CORINE 2018 y la recorta por un área de interés para flujos de trabajo de modelado hidráulico.
plugins.about: CLC2Manning es un complemento de QGIS que asigna valores de rugosidad de Manning a los polígonos de CORINE Land Cover 2018. Permite cargar datos de CORINE desde un GeoPackage, seleccionar un Área de Interés haciendo clic en cualquier polígono del mapa, recortar CORINE a esa AOI, asignar valores de Manning según la clasificación CODE_18, calcular áreas de polígonos y, opcionalmente, heredar la simbología original de CORINE. Está diseñado para aplicaciones hidráulicas e hidrológicas, como estudios de inundaciones HEC-RAS. Por el momento sólo disponible para España Peninsular.
plugins.author: Pedro Ivar y Hugo Alejandro Bohorquez Aliaga Villafuerte

plugins.name: SatIrriga QGIS
plugins.description: QGIS client for the SatIrriga platform (ANA/INPE). Browse, download, edit, and submit satellite-based irrigation maps.
plugins.about: SatIrriga QGIS is the official desktop client for the SatIrriga platform, a satellite-based irrigation monitoring system developed jointly by ANA (Brazil's National Water and Sanitation Agency) and INPE (Brazil's National Institute for Space Research). The plugin enables a complete field-validation workflow without leaving the QGIS environment: authenticate securely via Single Sign-On (OIDC/PKCE through Keycloak); browse the zonal catalog and download geospatial results as editable GeoPackage files via FlatGeobuf; refine geometries using the full suite of QGIS sketching and editing tools; and submit revisions back to the Feature Server with asynchronous processing and conflict resolution. Designed for analysts and technicians who review remote-sensing-derived irrigation maps, the plugin streamlines the review-and-correction cycle that is central to the SatIrriga quality-assurance process.
plugins.author: Tharles de Sousa Andrade | ANA | INPE

plugins.name: Geochemistry Plotting Tools
plugins.description: Create spider diagrams, discrimination diagrams, and custom XY plots for geochemical data
plugins.about:
A simple geochemistry plotting tool for QGIS that creates:
- Chondrite or Primitive Mantle normalized spider diagrams (REE + trace elements)
- Tectonic discrimination diagrams (Pearce, Meschede, Wilson, Cox et al.)
- Custom XY plots with user-defined element/oxide ratios

Developed for UWA EART3343 Lab exercises.
plugins.author: Mark Jessell, Julien Perret

plugins.name: Add Coordinates
plugins.description: Add projected or geographic coordinates to the map using unique IDs. Supports EPSG:32376 (Projected) and EPSG:4326 (Geographic). Preview points and export to CSV or Shapefile.
plugins.about: Adds points to the map using either projected or geographic coordinates, ensures unique IDs, allows preview in memory, and export to CSV or Shapefile. The plugin handles memory cleanly and simplifies coordinate input.
plugins.author: Wongani Msukwa

plugins.name: SAR VIEW
plugins.description: A specialized tool for Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) visualization. It automatically converts raw intensity/amplitude data to Decibels (dB) via logarithmic scaling and enhances contrast using statistical outlier removal (cumulative cut).
plugins.about: Enhance raw SAR imagery with one click. Features include customizable Logarithmic Transformation (dB) and Histogram Stretching based on Standard Deviation to remove speckle noise and outliers.
plugins.author: Mohamad El Moussawi

plugins.name: Label on a Cable - KelTech IoE
plugins.description: Generate, synchronise and manage infrastructure asset labels with the LOC platform.
plugins.about: Authenticate to LOC, select a Location, and automatically generate infrastructure labels directly from your QGIS designs, eliminating manual label creation. The plugin enables bidirectional data flow between QGIS and LOC. Pull high-accuracy field data captured by engineers using mobile devices or GNSS receivers to update asset positions in your GIS project. Push bulk attribute updates (such as cable lengths or metadata) from QGIS back into LOC to keep your digital records aligned with real-world installations. Designed to significantly accelerate labelling workflows while improving spatial accuracy and data consistency across design and field operations.
plugins.author: Brandon Kellett, KelTech IoE

plugins.name: Open NSPD Maps
plugins.description: Охват окна на сайте NSPD
plugins.about: Этот плагин открывает текущий охват карты на сайте NSPD простым нажатием кнопки. Связь в telegram: https://t.me/russofed
plugins.author: Alexandr Fedorov

plugins.name: SIOSE2Manning
plugins.description: Calcula la rugosidad de Manning a partir de SIOSE AR (T_COMBINADA - ID_COBERTURA_MAX) y la recorta por un Área de Interés georeferenciada para flujos de trabajo de modelado hidráulico.
plugins.about: SIOSE2Manning es un complemento de QGIS que asigna valores de rugosidad de Manning a los polígonos de SIOSE AR utilizando la cobertura dominante (ID_COBERTURA_MAX) de la capa T_COMBINADA. Permite cargar datos de SIOSE AR desde un GeoPackage, seleccionar un Area de Interes directamente en el mapa, recortar la cartografía a dicha AOI, calcular areas de poligonos y generar una capa lista para su uso en modelacion hidraulica e hidrologica (por ejemplo HEC-RAS). Este desarrollo se ha beneficiado de aportes técnicos y discusiones compartidas por Antonio López y la comunidad SIG en LinkedIn, que ayudaron a orientar el enfoque metodológico, aunque el diseño e implementación del complemento han sido desarrollados de forma independiente por los autores.
plugins.author: Pedro Ivar y Hugo Alejandro Bohorquez Aliaga Villafuerte

plugins.name: PG2GPKG
plugins.description: Bidirectional bridge between PostgreSQL/PostGIS and GeoPackage: export databases to GPKG and import GPKG into PostGIS.
plugins.about:
PG2GPKG moves data both ways between PostgreSQL/PostGIS and GeoPackage.

EXPORT (PostgreSQL → GeoPackage):
• One GeoPackage per schema
• Everything in a single GeoPackage
• One GeoPackage per table
• Automatic QGIS project export with datasource path rewriting

IMPORT (GeoPackage → PostgreSQL):
• Multi-layer batch import with per-layer destination schema/table
• Append, replace or create modes
• Interactive field mapping (rename / exclude columns)
• Optional reprojection to a target SRID
• Fast COPY-based loading via GDAL (PG_USE_COPY)

General:
• Tree/table-based layer selection with geometry info
• Handles fid type conflicts, compressed project formats, and SSL mode normalization
• Filters system tables automatically
• Full Italian and English interface
plugins.author: Federico Gianoli

plugins.name: mes_elus
plugins.description: Plugin pour télécharger et géoréférencer les données du RNE.
plugins.about: Plugin to automate the download and processing of data from the French National Directory of Elected Officials (Référentiel National des Élus)
plugins.author: Xavier FAYOUX

plugins.name: Sort and Group Layers
plugins.description: Sort and group layers by file path, name, date, geometry, feature count, or file size
plugins.about: A QGIS plugin that adds "Sort Layers" and "Group Layers" submenus under the Layer menu. Sort layers by full file path, alphabetical name, file modification date, geometry type, feature count, or file size. When layers are already grouped, sorting operates within each group and also reorders the groups. Group layers automatically by geometry type or source folder path. Save and restore the original layer order. Created by Australis Asset Advisory Group.
plugins.author: Australis Asset Advisory Group

plugins.name: Geomaticape Tools
plugins.description: Landsat C2 L1/L2, Sentinel-2, CBERS-04A, MODIS 09/11/12/13 scale factor per product independently, PCA, spectral indices, supervised + unsupervised classification, band extraction, vector geoprocessing, zonal statistics and multi-point sampling
plugins.about:
GeomaticaPE is a QGIS plugin developed by Geomatica Ambiental to automate
preprocessing and analysis of multispectral satellite imagery and to
support common geoprocessing tasks.

Tools organized into 7 groups:

[Conversion]
- Factor Escala LandSat C2 L1 (SR + LST + PAN)
- Factor escala Landsat C2 L2 (SR + LST)
- Factor de escala Sentinel-2 L1C (10m)
- Factor de escala Sentinel-2 L2A (10m)
- Factor escala MODIS 09 (Reflectancia Superficial)
- Factor escala MODIS 11 (LST C)
- Factor escala MODIS 12 (Cobertura del Suelo)
- Factor escala MODIS 13 (NDVI / EVI)

[Procesamiento]
- ACP Multiespectral (cualquier satelite)
- CBERS-04A Pansharpening Brovey 2m
- Clasificacion no supervisada (K-Means / GMM / ISODATA / Birch)
- Clasificacion supervisada y validacion
- Definir celdas nulas
- Extraer bandas de imagenes multiespectrales
- Firma espectral (Landsat 5/7/8/9 / Sentinel-2 / ASTER)
- Indices espectrales (NDVI, SAVI, EVI, NDWI, NBR, NDSI...)
- Indices espectrales - Seleccion multiple (varios indices -> carpeta)
- Mosaico de imagenes
- Reproyectar raster
- Tasseled Cap (Brightness / Greenness / Wetness)

[PostProcesamiento]
- Clasificar raster por rangos
- Reclasificar raster (remapeo de valores)
- Reporte clasificacion vectorial (area y graficos)
- Reporte de clasificacion raster (area, porcentaje, estadisticas)

[Geoprocesamiento]
- Calcular angulo de poligono
- Crear poligonos a partir de tabla
- Estadistica zonal raster (Excel/CSV)
- Extraer valores puntuales de multiples raster
- Poligono superpuesto propio
- Secciones transversales

[Descarga GEE]
- Descargar imagenes Landsat / Sentinel-2
- Descargar indices espectrales (GEE)
- Firma espectral profesional (GEE)

[MDE]
- Descargar MDE
- Generar curvas de nivel intermedias
- Generar elevaciones puntuales



COMPATIBILITY:
- Qt5 (PyQt5) and Qt6 (PyQt6) via qgis.PyQt compatibility layer
- QGIS 3.28 to 4.99

REQUIREMENTS - Python modules bundled with QGIS (no installation needed):
- numpy           (all tools)
- GDAL / osgeo    (all tools)
- matplotlib      (QGIS LTR 3.22+; supervised_classification, pca_satellite)

REQUIREMENTS - External modules NOT bundled with QGIS (must install):
- scikit-learn    REQUIRED by: Unsupervised Classification (KMeans,
MiniBatchKMeans, GaussianMixture, Birch, StandardScaler),
Supervised Classification (DecisionTree, RandomForest,
NaiveBayes, MLP, KNN, train_test_split, classification_report),
Multispectral PCA (PCA, StandardScaler, make_pipeline)
- pandas          REQUIRED by: Multispectral PCA (variance table),
Create Polygons from Table (read CSV/TXT/XLS/XLSX)
- openpyxl        REQUIRED by: Raster Zonal Statistics (export .xlsx),
Extract Point Values (export .xlsx),
Classification Report (export .xlsx with charts),
Create Polygons from Table (read .xlsx)
- xgboost         (Optional) REQUIRED by: Supervised Classification (XGBoost)
- catboost        (Optional) REQUIRED by: Supervised Classification (CatBoost)
- earthengine-api REQUIRED by: GEE Descargar Imagenes, GEE Descargar Indices,
GEE Firma Espectral, Descargar MDE

Install all external dependencies (run once):
python -m pip install --upgrade scikit-learn pandas openpyxl xgboost catboost earthengine-api

Developed and maintained by:
Geomatica Ambiental - www.geomatica.pe

Acknowledgments:
- Point Sampling Tool by Borys Jurgiel (GPL v2+) - inspiration for the
multi-raster point sampling tool. https://github.com/borysiasty/pointsamplingtool
plugins.author: Geomatica Ambiental

plugins.name: Embed Legend
plugins.description: Interactive Floating Legend & Advanced KMZ/MIF Thematic Export Tool for RF Engineers and GIS Analysts.
plugins.about:
Embed Legend is the ultimate productivity booster for QGIS users, particularly in the Telecommunications and GIS sectors. It creates a live, draggable floating legend panel that stays on your map canvas. Key features include:
* Interactive visibility toggle (click to hide/show layers with a strikethrough effect).
* Multi-layer stacking with clear separators.
* Real-time feature counts and percentage (%) statistics.
* Professional KMZ (Google Earth) export with auto-embedded legend images on the screen.
* Smart Labeling: Automatically detects SiteID columns for Sectoral/Polygon layers, keeping Drive Test (Points) and Grid geometries clean without text clutter.
* Direct MapInfo MIF export with hardcoded thematics.
Export thousands of complex RF data points (Drive Test, Covmo/MR/MDT, Gcell) cleanly and efficiently in less than a minute.
plugins.author: Jujun Junaedi

plugins.name: Shinrinbo Code Converter
plugins.description: Converts code values in Shizuoka Prefecture's forest register to human-readable text based on the code table, joins with forest planning maps, and outputs as a QGIS layer.
plugins.about: Automatically converts code values (CD columns) in Shizuoka Prefecture's forest register (xlsx), published as open data, into human-readable text based on the forest register code table (docx). Joins with forest planning maps (Shapefile) using the KEY1 field and outputs as a GIS layer with attribute information. / 静岡県がオープンデータとして公開している森林簿（xlsx）のコード値（CD列）を、森林簿コード表（docx）に基づき自動的に人間が読めるテキストに変換します。森林計画図（Shapefile）とKEY1フィールドで結合し、属性情報付きのGISレイヤとして出力します。 / Support: https://paypal.me/rawslnc

plugins.author: Giuseppe De Marco

plugins.name: GeoAccuRate
plugins.description: Accuracy assessment done right — Olofsson, Pontius, and publication-ready reports in one click.
plugins.about:
GeoAccuRate provides statistically rigorous accuracy assessment for land cover
and remote sensing classification validation in QGIS. It implements the area-weighted
estimation method of Olofsson et al. (2014), Pontius quantity and allocation
disagreement metrics, Wilson confidence intervals, and automated stratified random
sampling with sample size optimization. Generates publication-ready PDF reports with
confusion matrices (counts and row-normalized), per-class metrics, interpretation
notes, ISO 19157 quality element mapping, and auto-generated methods text with
citations. Designed for researchers, students, and agencies requiring reproducible
and defensible accuracy assessment without leaving QGIS.
plugins.author: Osman Ibrahim

plugins.name: Brutvögel_Papierrevier_LR
plugins.description: Automatisierte Revierabgrenzung nach Südbeck-Standard mit räumlichem Clustering und Phänologie-Kriterium.
plugins.about:
Erstellt automatisiert Revierpolygone für avifaunistische Kartierungen.

Funktionen:
- Räumliches BFS-Clustering mit konfigurierbarer Suchdistanz (Standard: 50m)
- Anti-Ketten-Regel verhindert langgezogene Polygone
- Phänologie-Kriterium (Mindest-Tagesspanne)
- Südbeck-Statuszuweisung (C16 bis A1) (experimentell) 
- Brutnachweise (BN) werden priorisiert
- Schnelle Nachbarsuche via QgsSpatialIndex (O(n log n))
- Fortschrittsanzeige und Abbruchmöglichkeit
- Kompatibel mit QGIS 3.22 bis 4.x
plugins.author: Lienus Rob

plugins.name: Geopacker
plugins.description: Bundles an entire QGIS project (.qgz) into an easily shareable, single compressed file. Consolidates vectors, rasters, layout images, and .qml styles, then fixes layer paths.
plugins.about: A tool to package layers for sharing by eliminating broken paths.

plugins.author: Matheus Durso N. Caetano

plugins.name: SMART-MOVE Mobility Analytics
plugins.description:
SMART-MOVE (Spatial Monitoring & Analysis of Real-Time Traffic Movement) is a QGIS plugin designed to transform traffic visualization outputs into spatial mobility intelligence indicators.
It supports advanced spatiotemporal traffic pattern analysis, congestion dynamics interpretation, and mobility signal monitoring for urban and regional planning applications.

It includes two main tools:
1. Traffic Analyzer for generating traffic class summaries from visual traffic data.
2. Traffic Summary Visualizer for producing multi-scale spatiotemporal analytics, charts, and animated mobility patterns.
plugins.about:
SMART-MOVE provides an integrated framework for interpreting traffic visualization layers into analytical indicators for mobility assessment, congestion pattern detection, and transport dynamics modeling.
The plugin supports visual-proxy mobility analytics for planning research, urban digital twin development, and spatial decision support systems.
plugins.author: Firman Afrianto, Maya Safira

plugins.name: Site Sector
plugins.description: Generate dynamic sectoral site wedges and PCI audits.
plugins.about:
Site Sector is an advanced productivity tool designed for RF/NPO Engineers in the Telecommunications sector. It automates the generation of cellular site polygons (wedges) and features a built-in audit engine for network optimization. Key features include:
* Dynamic Band Styling: Automatically detects and styles unique frequencies/bands using smart Regex parsing.
* Auto-Decrement Radius: Intelligently reduces sector radius for overlapping multi-band layers to ensure full visibility.
* PCI Modulo Audit: Instantly visualize LTE interference by generating thematic site sector based on PCI Modulo 3 (RS), Mod 6 (PSS).
* Multi-Format Export: Seamlessly export generated sectors data to ESRI Shapefile (.shp), MapInfo (.tab), or professional Google Earth (.kml) formats with auto-embedded floating legends.
plugins.author: Jujun Junaedi

plugins.name: Layer Multiply Toggle
plugins.description: Toggle the Multiply blend mode for all or selected layers and groups with a single click.
plugins.about: (27.05.2026) Adds a toolbar button that toggles the Multiply blend mode for all layers or only the selected layers/groups. A clickable Multiply icon next to each layer in the layer tree toggles Multiply per layer. A dropdown menu on the toolbar button lets you show/hide the layer-tree icons on demand and reset everything (restore originals, remove icons, toggle off). Original blend modes are preserved and restored on toggling off, and the on/off state is stored per project. Compatible with QGIS 3.x (Qt5) and QGIS 4.x (Qt6).
plugins.author: Mike Elstermann (#geoObserver), Thomas Wölk

plugins.name: EasyGeocoder
plugins.description: Professional batch geocoding of CSV address data for QGIS using OpenStreetMap Nominatim.
plugins.about:
EasyGeocoder is a QGIS plugin for reliable batch geocoding of CSV address data with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.
It supports configurable column mapping (address, city, postal code, country), structured lookup with automatic fallback, and clear status reporting for each record.
Output is an EPSG:4326 point layer that preserves all source CSV columns and adds standardized geocoding fields for analysis and QA.
plugins.author: Jakub Grodzicki

plugins.name: LatLong Digitizer
plugins.description: Digitizes a polygon by manually entering latitude/longitude points.
plugins.about: This plugin is designed to digitize polygon features in QGIS through precise manual coordinate entry. It enables users to build geometries by entering specific latitude and longitude values one by one, ensuring high accuracy for data management tasks that require exact spatial positioning.
plugins.author: Rajesh

plugins.name: AutoAtlas Pro
plugins.description: Automated cartographic report generator. Create professional atlas reports with thematic maps in one click.
plugins.about: AutoAtlas Pro automates the generation of professional cartographic reports with thematic maps. Perfect for census data, demographic analysis, municipal reports, and academic research. Features a Dark Corporate UI theme, resilient batch generation with Circuit Breaker pattern, and Graceful Degradation for offline basemaps. Supports PDF and PNG export with customizable templates.
plugins.author: Jorge Ulloa Roa

plugins.name: RORB catg/stm Editor
plugins.description: Table-format viewer and editor for RORB .catg and .stm files — fully edit catchment node/reach data and create or edit storm files interactively.
plugins.author: Irene Jaya

plugins.name: GPKG Editor
plugins.description: View and edit GeoPackage (GPKG) layer attributes with plan management and GPKG/CSV export.
plugins.about: Manage multiple named plans against a single GPKG — switch and compare them instantly without duplicating files. All plans and attribute edits are stored in one companion file ({name}_data.sqlite), leaving the original GPKG untouched. Each plan holds a feature set with column configuration; edits are merged only at export time (GPKG/CSV). Also features expression-based status rows and a lock mode that freezes the canvas for spatial comparison. Support: https://paypal.me/rawslnc
plugins.author: Hideharu Masai

plugins.name: タイル境界道路接続
plugins.description: タイル境界で分断された道路の接続を自動修復。Fix tile-cut road connectivity by snapping endpoints near tile boundaries.

plugins.name: Bearing Protractor
plugins.description: Interactive floating protractor and advanced azimuth/distance measurement tool for RF Site Audit and Network Planning.
plugins.about:
Bearing Protractor is an interactive floating protractor and azimuth/distance measurement tool for QGIS, designed for Telecommunications, RF Engineering, GIS planning, and site audit workflows. The protractor stays directly on the map canvas, allowing users to visualize bearings, sector beams, distances, and coverage directions without leaving the map. Key features include:
* Visual Beam & Multiple Bearings: Create and adjust multiple sector bearings with visual beam coverage directly on the map canvas.
* Floating Legend Summary: A freely draggable panel providing a real-time summary of active sectors, including labels, azimuths, distances, colors, and sector information.
* Calculated Population: Estimate the population within a sector footprint by sampling data from a selected population raster layer.
* Real-Time Distance Tracking: Calculate real-world distances in meters or kilometers dynamically using QGIS distance calculations.
* Manual Measurement Ruler: Draw a temporary measurement line to quickly check azimuth and distance between sites or other map locations.
* Cell Footprint Generation: Export current sector configurations as polygon vector layers directly to the QGIS map canvas.
* Copy Data: Copy sector information such as Azimuth, Beamwidth, and Distance to the clipboard for use in spreadsheets, reports, and other workflows.
* Sector Customization: Change individual sector labels, colors, and beamwidths directly from the bearing context menu, or remove a selected bearing when it is no longer needed.
* Resizable Protractor: Resize the protractor directly on the map canvas using the mouse wheel. Place the cursor at the center of the protractor ring and scroll up or down to adjust its size.
* Custom Visual Styles: Choose from different protractor styles and customize visual elements such as colors, fonts, text, ring size, and sector appearance.
* Azimuth Gap Threshold: Set an azimuth gap threshold to help identify potential gaps or clashes between sector bearings during site audits.
* Persistent Settings: Visual preferences and selected settings are retained across QGIS sessions.
* Bilingual Support: Switch between English and Indonesian through the plugin interface.
* Clean Floating Interface: The transparent, map-focused interface keeps the protractor and its tools accessible without unnecessarily blocking the QGIS map canvas.
Whether you are checking site azimuths, measuring distances, reviewing sector configurations, or performing RF site audits, Bearing Protractor provides a practical visual workflow directly inside QGIS.

plugins.name: LAS to ENVI-met Tree Converter
plugins.description: Converts LAS/LAZ point clouds into ENVI‑met tree models with Leaf Area Density (LAD) calculation and A‑gs physiological parameterisation
plugins.about: This plugin provides a complete workflow to convert LiDAR point clouds (LAS/LAZ format) into 3D tree models suitable for the microclimate simulation software ENVI‑met. Users can interactively select a trunk point and define a region of interest, apply percentile‑based filtering to isolate tree points, and then scale, rotate, or translate the point cloud to match desired dimensions. The plugin voxelises the data at 1 m resolution and calculates Leaf Area Density (LAD) values using user‑selected reference voxels. Further refinements such as crown factor adjustment, trunk enhancement, LAD thresholding, and ground clearing are available. Physiological A‑gs parameters can be chosen from species presets or entered manually. The final tree can be exported as an ENVI‑met plant file (.txt) and optionally inserted directly into an existing project database. Designed for researchers and urban planners, the plugin bridges the gap between high‑resolution LiDAR data and microclimate modelling in ENVI‑met. Some of the tools in las2ENVImet require the Python libraries laspy, lazrs and matplotlib, which are not included in the default installation of QGIS. See the "Dependencies" section in the README file.

plugins.name: Netcad DNS Koordinat Donusum
plugins.description: Coordinate transformation using Netcad DNS files: Helmert, Affine and TIN methods.
plugins.about:
This plugin reads Netcad .dns transformation files and applies coordinate
transformation to selected vector layers.

SUPPORTED METHODS:
- Helmert (4 parameters): Isotropic scale + rotation + translation.
Most common method. Minimum 2 control points required.
- Affine (6 parameters): Different scale in E/N direction + shear.
More flexible. Minimum 3 control points required.
- TIN (Delaunay Triangulation): Local transformation per triangle.
Residual = 0 at all control points (exact pass-through).
Best accuracy for large areas. Minimum 3 control points required.

SUPPORTED DNS FILE TYPES:
- Point-Based ($AMAT + $NOK): Parameters computed from control points via LSQ.
- Matrix-Based ($AMAT only): Parameters read directly from $AMAT matrix.

QUALITY CONTROL:
- Data Snooping (Baarda Test): Iteratively detects suspicious control points.
- Normalized residuals (w-values) vs critical value comparison.
- Error ellipses: sigma_E, sigma_N, sigma_P, semi-major/minor axes.
- Residual vector and error ellipse layers can be added to the map.

MULTI-LAYER SUPPORT:
- Multiple layers can be selected (Ctrl/Shift) and transformed in one step.
- Option to transform in-place or create new layers with custom suffix.

REPORTING:
- HTML report: Opens in browser with full CSS styling.
- PDF report: Generated via QGIS WebEngine.

Compatible with QGIS 3.16+ and QGIS 4.x (Qt5/Qt6).
scipy package required for TIN method.

plugins.name: NEBULA Network-Based Urban Location Analyzer
plugins.description:
NEBULA (Network-Based Urban Location Analyzer) is a QGIS plugin designed to support evidence-based planning of urban facilities using network accessibility analysis and facility location optimization.

The plugin evaluates existing facilities, identifies underserved demand areas, and recommends optimal facility locations using classical operations research models such as the Maximum Coverage Location Problem (MCLP) and the P-Median model.

NEBULA integrates graph-based spatial analysis, demand coverage evaluation, and spatial equity diagnostics to provide robust decision-support for infrastructure planning and service allocation.

The tool supports a wide range of planning applications including:
1. Public transport stop planning
2. Healthcare and education facility allocation
3. Waste management infrastructure planning
4. Public space accessibility assessment
5. Emergency and evacuation facility placement
plugins.about:
NEBULA provides an integrated spatial intelligence framework for analyzing and optimizing urban facility systems based on network accessibility.

The plugin combines concepts from spatial network science, operations research, and urban planning to evaluate facility coverage, identify spatial service gaps, and generate optimized facility location scenarios.

It includes analytical diagnostics such as population coverage assessment, accessibility distance statistics, spatial equity indicators (Gini and Theil indices), and visual analytics including accessibility histograms, Lorenz curves, and facility performance charts.

NEBULA is designed for research, planning practice, and spatial decision-support systems in urban and regional planning.
plugins.author: Firman Afrianto, Maya Safira

plugins.name: ParkSense Metrics
plugins.description:
ParkSense Metrics is a QGIS plugin designed to estimate urban parking supply and parking pressure using spatial analytics.
The plugin transforms building footprints, road networks, and optional point-of-interest (POI) data into measurable parking capacity indicators.

It supports grid-based parking supply estimation, roadside parking capacity modeling, building-based off-street parking estimation,
and POI-based demand proxy analysis to evaluate spatial parking pressure patterns in urban environments.

The plugin enables planners, researchers, and urban mobility analysts to convert spatial datasets into actionable parking capacity metrics
for mobility planning, land-use interpretation, and urban infrastructure assessment.

It includes the following main analytical components:
1. On-Street Parking Estimator – calculates curbside parking capacity from road geometry and parking-side rules.
2. Off-Street Parking Estimator – estimates parking capacity from building footprints and land-use parking factors.
3. Parking Supply Grid Generator – aggregates parking supply indicators into a regular spatial grid.
4. Parking Pressure Analyzer – compares parking demand proxies from POI data with available supply to derive parking pressure indicators.
plugins.about:
ParkSense Metrics provides an integrated spatial analytics framework for evaluating parking capacity and parking pressure in urban areas.
The plugin applies rule-based estimation models to infer parking supply from built environment datasets,
enabling rapid parking supply assessment where detailed parking inventories are unavailable.

The framework supports urban mobility research, parking management studies, spatial infrastructure planning,
and smart city analytics by transforming spatial layers into interpretable parking capacity indicators.

plugins.name: Transit Stop Optimizer
plugins.description:
Transit Stop Optimizer is a QGIS plugin designed to support evidence-based public transport stop planning using network accessibility analysis, demand estimation, and location-allocation optimization.

The plugin evaluates walk-based accessibility to candidate transit stops using a NetworkX graph built from a road network, demand points derived from a population raster, and optional attraction weights from POIs.

It supports two optimization models:
1. MCLP greedy for achieving target population coverage
2. P-Median heuristic for minimizing weighted access distance for a fixed number of stops

The plugin also includes optional AI-augmented demand smoothing, regulatory stop spacing based on Kepdirjen 271 HK.105 DRJD 96, and equity diagnostics using Gini and Theil indices.

Transit Stop Optimizer is suitable for urban transport planning, stop spacing studies, service coverage analysis, and accessibility-based infrastructure planning.
plugins.about:
Transit Stop Optimizer provides an integrated spatial intelligence framework for transit stop planning based on road-network accessibility, demand aggregation, optimization, regulatory spacing, and spatial equity evaluation.

The plugin combines graph-based accessibility modelling, population-based demand estimation, POI attractiveness weighting, and classical operations research approaches to support robust stop location decisions.

It includes analytical components such as:
1. Network cleaning and topological preparation
2. Demand point generation from population raster zonal aggregation
3. POI attractiveness weighting using log(1+review)
4. Candidate stop generation from network vertices or corridor lines
5. MCLP and P-Median stop optimization
6. Equity metrics based on weighted access distances
7. Optional AI demand prediction using RandomForest smoothing
8. Regulatory spacing mode with simple zoning or advanced corridor-based variable spacing
9. Output reports and histogram visualization of access distances

Transit Stop Optimizer is designed for research, planning practice, and decision-support workflows in transport and urban planning.

plugins.description: Connect QGIS to Claude AI via the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
plugins.about:
Socket server plugin that exposes QGIS operations to LLMs through the
Model Context Protocol. Enables Claude to directly control QGIS: manage
layers, edit features, run processing algorithms, render maps, and more.

This plugin is only one half of the setup. You also need an MCP server
so that Claude (or another LLM) can talk to QGIS.
See https://github.com/nkarasiak/qgis-mcp for installation instructions.

Features:
- 100+ MCP tools for layers, features, processing, rendering, layouts
- Diagnose tool for full stack health checks
- Plugin development tools: message log, plugin reload, layer tree
- Expression validation, project variables, settings access
- Non-blocking TCP socket server with length-prefixed framing
- Toolbar button with port configuration dropdown

plugins.name: PTHA Based Tsunami Inundation Tool

plugins.about: PTHA Based Tsunami Inundation Tool provides an automated workflow for mapping tsunami inundation zones using Probabilistic Tsunami Hazard Assessment (PTHA) derived water levels and high-resolution coastal elevation data. The tool integrates spatial analysis techniques including nearest-point association, water level computation at different exceedance rate, raster-based inundation detection, and polygon generation of hazard zones. plugins.name: Image Extractor
plugins.description: Clips and exports a basemap image and DEM raster to a vector AOI polygon extent, ready for 3D texture draping. Developed by Geocentric Environmental Inc. to streamline importing terrains in CSM 3D Vis(tm).
plugins.about:
Image Extractor automates the process of clipping a basemap (e.g. Google Satellite) and a DEM raster to a user-defined AOI polygon, producing georeferenced outputs ready for 3D texture draping workflows. Developed by Geocentric Environmental Inc. to streamline internal DEM and texture draping processes.

The tool renders the visible map canvas to a high-resolution image, applies a precise vector mask from the selected AOI layer, auto-crops to the opaque pixel boundary, and clips the DEM to the exact same geographic extent. Both outputs share identical spatial extents, eliminating skirt artifacts in 3D visualization software.

Outputs:
- Tile__0__0.png — masked and cropped basemap image (PNG)
- [Output Name].tif — DEM clipped to matching extent (GeoTIFF)

Inputs configured through a simple dialog:
- Basemap layer (raster)
- DEM layer (raster)
- Cropping Extent layer (vector polygon)
- Output folder and file name
- Output CRS — recommended WGS84 (EPSG:4326) for broadest compatibility
- Cropping layer CRS — CRS of the vector layer used for cropping
- Basemap CRS — CRS of the basemap imagery (Google Satellite is typically Web Mercator, EPSG:3857)

plugins.name: VAST Visual-Ambient Street Stress Tool
plugins.description:
VAST (Visual-Ambient Street Stress Tool) is a QGIS plugin designed to quantify street-level environmental stress caused by excessive outdoor advertising, limited urban greenery, urban enclosure effects, and surface heat conditions.

The plugin integrates multiple spatial indicators including advertising density, building enclosure ratio, canopy coverage, and land surface temperature to produce a composite Street Environment Stress Index (SESI).

VAST supports evidence-based urban design and planning interventions by identifying corridors with high visual and thermal stress and recommending targeted mitigation strategies such as tree planting, advertising regulation, façade management, and cool pavement implementation.

The tool is designed for applications in:
1. Urban visual pollution assessment
2. Outdoor advertising regulation and control
3. Street corridor environmental quality evaluation
4. Urban heat and shading diagnostics
5. Sustainable streetscape and public space planning
plugins.about:
VAST provides an integrated spatial analysis framework to evaluate environmental stress along urban streets using geospatial indicators and composite index modelling.

The plugin combines concepts from urban morphology, environmental design, spatial analytics, and urban climate research to measure how advertising clutter, street canyon morphology, vegetation deficit, and thermal conditions influence street-level environmental quality.

The analysis workflow includes road segmentation, corridor buffering, spatial indicator extraction, normalization of variables, and weighted aggregation to construct the Street Environment Stress Index (SESI).

Weighting schemes can be defined using expert-defined parameters or derived statistically using Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Results are produced at both segment and corridor levels, enabling planners to identify spatial hotspots of visual and thermal stress.

The plugin generates multiple analytical outputs including stress index maps, corridor summaries, hotspot diagnostics, policy recommendation indicators, and visual analytics charts.

VAST is intended for research, urban policy analysis, and spatial decision-support systems related to urban environmental quality, streetscape management, and advertising regulation.

plugins.name: FeatureNavEd
plugins.description: Navigate and edit vector layer features one by one with attribute display, sorting, and auto-zoom. Dockable panel with previous/next navigation.
plugins.about:
FeatureNavEd is a dockable panel that lets you navigate and edit features of a vector layer one by one, similar to the Identify tool but with full navigation and editing control.
<br><br>
<b>Layer Selection</b> — Select a vector layer from the dropdown or drag-and-drop directly from the Layers panel. Supports all vector layer types (point, line, polygon).
<b>Feature Navigation</b> — Step through features with First, Previous, Next, and Last buttons. Sort features by any field in ascending or descending order. Each feature is automatically selected, zoomed to, and flashed on the map canvas.
<b>Attribute Form</b> — Displays the native QGIS attribute form for each feature. Supports inline editing when the layer is in edit mode.
<b>Multi-Edit</b> — Select 2 or more features while in edit mode to edit shared attribute values simultaneously via a native multi-edit form. When not in edit mode, a passive M(n) counter is shown in the navigation bar.
<b>Auto-zoom</b> — Configurable map scale control adjusts the zoom level when navigating between features.
<b>Pick from Map</b> — Click a feature on the map canvas to jump directly to it in the panel.
<br><br>
<b>Top Toolbar</b> — Quick-access icons for Pick from Map, Filter, Find, and Open Attribute Table.
<b>Find</b> — Search for features by field value with autocomplete dropdown, without filtering the navigation list.
<b>Filter</b> — Collapsible filter bar with expression-based filtering and selected-features-only mode.
<b>Sort Value Display</b> — The Sort By group title shows the current feature's sort field value for quick reference.

plugins.name: Traffica UE Analytics
plugins.description:
Traffica UE Analytics is a QGIS plugin designed to perform indicative traffic flow analysis using spatial network modeling and synthetic origin-destination generation.

The plugin converts road network geometry, population distribution, and point-of-interest (POI) data into a synthetic mobility demand model
and assigns the resulting flows onto the road network using transport assignment algorithms.

The analytical framework integrates gravity-based trip generation, grid-based zoning, and network-based route assignment
to estimate traffic flow patterns where traditional OD survey data is unavailable.

The plugin supports both deterministic All-or-Nothing (AoN) assignment and probabilistic multi-path assignment using a Path-Size Logit (PSL) formulation,
enabling the exploration of route choice variability within urban transport systems.

Optional User Equilibrium (UE) iterations using the Bureau of Public Roads (BPR) congestion function and Method of Successive Averages (MSA)
allow approximate congestion feedback within the synthetic traffic model.

The plugin includes the following main analytical components:
1. Network Preparation – splits road networks at intersections and filters non-vehicular links to build a clean transport graph.
2. Grid-Based Zoning Generator – creates spatial zones within a study boundary to serve as origin and destination units.
3. Synthetic OD Generator – estimates trip flows using a gravity model based on population mass and POI attraction.
4. Traffic Assignment Engine – assigns OD flows to the network using AoN or probabilistic multi-path route choice models.
5. Congestion Simulation – applies BPR travel time functions with optional User Equilibrium iterations.
6. Mobility Output Generator – produces edge flow layers, OD desire lines, and zone-level mobility indicators.
plugins.about:
Traffica UE Analytics provides an integrated spatial analytics framework for exploring urban mobility patterns
using open spatial datasets and network modeling techniques.

The plugin is designed to support transport planners, urban researchers, and spatial analysts
in conducting preliminary traffic flow assessments when detailed mobility survey data is unavailable.

By combining spatial zoning, gravity-based demand modeling, and network assignment algorithms,
the framework enables rapid evaluation of potential traffic corridors, congestion hotspots,
and accessibility relationships within urban regions.

The resulting outputs can support corridor screening, scenario comparison,
infrastructure planning analysis, and urban mobility research within a GIS environment.

plugins.name: Groundsource Indonesia Flood Profiler
plugins.description:
Groundsource Indonesia Flood Profiler is a QGIS plugin designed to analyze and profile historical flood events across Indonesia using the Groundsource global flood dataset.

The plugin extracts and analyzes flood events reported in the Groundsource dataset within user-defined administrative or study boundaries. It generates spatial and temporal flood intelligence profiles that summarize historical flood occurrence patterns for cities, districts, watersheds, or planning regions.

The Groundsource dataset compiles flood events extracted from global news reports and structured into a geospatial dataset, enabling retrospective analysis of flood occurrence patterns.

This tool allows planners, disaster risk analysts, and researchers to transform raw Groundsource event data into actionable spatial intelligence through automated profiling workflows.

The plugin is designed for applications including:
1. Historical flood event profiling within planning boundaries
2. Flood hotspot identification and spatial clustering
3. Temporal flood trend analysis and event seasonality
4. Flood exposure assessment for urban and regional planning
5. Disaster risk intelligence and decision-support mapping
plugins.about:
Groundsource Indonesia Flood Profiler provides a geospatial analytical framework to convert the Groundsource flood event dataset into interpretable flood intelligence indicators.

The tool automatically downloads and caches the Groundsource dataset and performs spatial intersection with user-defined boundaries to identify flood events relevant to a specific study area.

Analytical outputs include flood event density mapping, temporal trend analysis, hotspot identification, and computation of the Historical Flood Intelligence Index (HFII). The workflow also produces multiple visual analytics including temporal charts, hotspot maps, and spatial summaries.

The plugin is designed to support disaster risk analysis, spatial planning, climate adaptation studies, and flood risk communication for Indonesian regions.

Dataset Citation:
Mayo, R., Zlydenko, O., Bootbool, M., Fronman, S., Gilon, O., Hassidim, A., Kratzert, F., Loike, G., Matias, Y., Nakar, Y., Nearing, G., Sayag, R., Sicherman, A., Zemach, I., & Cohen, D. (2026). plugins.name: InSAR Suite
plugins.description: Integrated suite for loading, processing and analysis of PSI displacement data
plugins.about:
InSAR Suite is an integrated QGIS plugin that brings together six tools for PSI (Persistent Scatterer Interferometry) data analysis into a single dedicated toolbar.

- InSAR Load: loads PSI point layers from GeoPackage, Shapefile or GDB files using a polygon index layer, or reactivates an index already present in the project.
- InSAR EWUD: decomposes LOS velocities from ascending/descending SAR data into East-West and Up-Down components, with automatic resampling grid creation (square or hexagonal cells). Outputs include Na and Nd fields (number of PS points used per cell).
- InSAR VIS: calculates the detectable movement percentage (pc_mov) based on SAR acquisition geometry and terrain morphology derived from a DEM. Output can be saved as a permanent GeoPackage.
- InSAR TS: time series analysis tools including data quality and homogeneity check (with skewness and kurtosis), automatic kinematic analysis, seasonal decomposition (STL), piecewise non-linear analysis, temporal anomaly detection, and multi-zone comparison. Supports DYYYYMMDD and YYYYMMDD date field formats.
- InSAR Polygons: automatic delineation of deformation areas from PS data using buffer and geometric dissolve by velocity class, with hierarchical clipping and optional morphological smoothing. Output can be saved as a permanent GeoPackage.
- InSAR Report: generates a PSI summary sheet for a study area (hand-drawn, loaded from a polygon file, or picked from a layer already in the project), with PS count, density, areal coverage, kinematic coherence, mean visibility and velocity ± standard deviation for both ascending and descending datasets, plus the mean EWUD vector (angle ± circular standard deviation, velocity, E, U components ± standard deviation), all automatically filtered to the study area. Exportable as PNG or CSV.

plugins.description: Creates point vector layers from data sources with coordinate fields (lat/lon). Supports OGR/GDAL URLs, Google Sheets, GeoJSON, WFS and existing QGIS layers. Custom CSV separator and field options. Bilingual ITA/EN interface. Compatible with QGIS 3 and QGIS 4.
plugins.about: GeoPoint Manager lets you create point vector layers from any data source that contains latitude/longitude fields. It supports OGR/GDAL URLs, Google Sheets (via CSV export), GeoJSON, WFS services, and existing QGIS layers. Custom CSV separator (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, custom) and record/field options (skip rows, decimal comma, trim fields, discard empty fields). The bilingual ITA/EN interface can be switched on the fly. Data from Google Sheets is downloaded and stored persistently in a local GeoPackage with on-demand manual refresh. Compatible with both QGIS 3 (Qt5/PyQt5) and QGIS 4 (Qt6/PyQt6).
plugins.author: gbvitrano

plugins.name: Forest Plots Checker
plugins.description: Review forest plots with Sentinel-2/Planet satellite imagery in 2020. Confirm each plot is forested (1) or not forested (0).
plugins.about: This plugin supports scanning forest plots in the room using Sentinel-2 or Planet 2020 satellite imagery. Import the forest plot shapefile, browse each plot by ID, view the satellite imagery, and record the confirmation result (0 = no forest, 1 = forest present).
plugins.author: Nguyen Trong Cuong _ VNUF

plugins.name: LK-Technik Path Planner
plugins.description: Import and export guidance and field data for agricultural machinery — ISOXML (v3/v4), John Deere Gen4, and AgGPS in one plugin.
plugins.about:
LK-Technik Path Planner brings guidance line and field data import and export together in one streamlined workflow.

Just pick your terminal — over 30 models across Case/Steyr, Claas, Fendt, John Deere, New Holland, Trimble and more are supported — and the plugin automatically writes the right format: ISOXML v3/v4, John Deere Gen4, or AgGPS. No manual format guessing.

At its core is a field catalogue that acts as the single source of truth for every field: organize your data in a clear Customer → Farm → Field hierarchy, add, rename, or delete fields on the fly, and pick them from a dropdown instead of hunting for IDs. Optional contour segments are available for Fendt One.
plugins.author: Florian Köck

plugins.name: Color Snap & Polygon Extractor
plugins.description: Advanced color-based polygon extraction and geometry smoothing toolset.
plugins.about: A suite of tools for precise GIS digitization. Optimized for high-quality topo-vector workflows.

plugins.name: QGIS Ledger
plugins.description: IT: Controllo di versione stile Git per progetti QGIS: diff geometrici, rollback e sincronizzazione multi-cloud. / EN: Git-like version control for QGIS projects: geometric diffs, rollback and multi-cloud sync.
plugins.about:
============================================================
ITALIANO
============================================================
QGIS Ledger — Versioning di Livello Enterprise per QGIS
Sistema di tracciamento storico e sincronizzazione cloud progettato per l'integrità dei dati spaziali, senza dipendenze esterne. Ottimizzato per QGIS 3.x e QGIS 4 (Qt6).

FUNZIONALITÀ PRINCIPALI:
- Architettura a Snapshot: Commit atomici di layer e progetti in SQLite locale.
- Diff Semantico-Visuale: Analisi geometrica delle differenze tra versioni.
- Rollback Deterministico: Ripristino istantaneo di dati e stili.
- Sincronizzazione Cloud: Supporto nativo per Nextcloud, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive e GDrive.
- Merge Wizard: Gestione conflitti in split-screen.

============================================================
ENGLISH
============================================================
QGIS Ledger — Enterprise-Grade Version Control for QGIS
Comprehensive historical tracking and cloud synchronization engine engineered for geospatial data integrity, operating entirely dependency-free across QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4 (Qt6).

CORE FEATURES:
- Snapshot Architecture: Atomic commits of layers and projects in local SQLite.
- Semantic Visual Diff: Geometric analysis of differences between versions.
- Deterministic Rollback: Instant restoration of data and styling.
- Cloud Synchronization: Native support for Nextcloud, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive, and GDrive.
- Merge Wizard: Split-screen conflict resolution.
plugins.author: Dott. Sarino Alfonso Grande

plugins.name: BKompV Rechner
plugins.description: Automated ecological impact assessment according to BKompV.
plugins.about: Dieses Plugin automatisiert die Eingriffs-Ausgleichs-Bilanzierung nach BKompV. Es bietet ein Einzelbaum-Modul, Habitat-Boni (+3 WE) und ein intelligentes Projektions-Management. This tool reduces manual processing time and minimizes errors in environmental impact assessments, ensuring results for official approval processes.
plugins.author: Lienus Rob

plugins.name: Transmittance Layer ctl
plugins.description: Group layers and control their opacity, order, and labeling as a single blended layer.
plugins.about:
Tag any QGIS layer group as a "Transmittance Group" to open an interactive 2D control panel.

The canvas plots each layer as a draggable dot — X axis controls stacking order, Y axis controls opacity. Drag a dot to adjust both at once. Click a dot to toggle its visibility.

Key features:
- Real-time opacity and order editing with immediate map feedback
- Label control: a △ indicator selects which layer displays its QGIS label
- Exclusive Control mode: click any dot to show only that layer and its label; cycle through layers with arrow keys
- Opacity clamping: define an upper/lower opacity range applied across all layers
- Presets (×4): save and restore full panel states, including order, opacity, clamping, and exclusive control settings

Designed for workflows that involve comparing multiple overlapping layers — such as elevation models, orthophotos, and feature layers — where visual blending and quick layer switching matter.
plugins.author: Hideharu Masai

plugins.description: 面向国土空间规划与测绘工作的 QGIS AI 助手，支持问答、处理算法执行、图层操作和按规程符号化。

面向国土空间规划、土地整治、调查监测和部分测绘场景的停靠面板式 QGIS AI 助手。
支持自然语言问答、多步 Processing 执行、图层管理、字段计算、短会话记忆、最近操作记录、MCP 上下文桥接，以及按规划规程进行标准化符号化。

plugins.about: This plugin calculates and analyses the Residential Vulnerability Index (IVR) using cadastral data from Spain. In some cases, data are distributed as split compressed files, requiring 7-Zip for extraction.

plugins.about: Qgis2OnlineMap is a zero-config hosting bridge for QGIS. Securely publish 2D and 3D maps to the cloud and manage them via a professional dashboard. Optimized for secured and rapid stakeholder sharing. Compatible with QGIS 3.x and 4.0.

plugins.description: Generates the Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND).
plugins.about: This plugin computes the Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND), a terrain descriptor defined as the elevation difference between a surface point and the nearest drainage network point to which it drains.

plugins.description: Fast coordinate reference system (CRS) reprojection with custom shortcuts.

plugins.description: Dynamic real-time intersection angle analyzer for lines.
plugins.about: A QGIS plugin providing real-time analysis of intersection angles between route and obstacle layers. Features high-visibility 1.6m color-coded markers (Red <70°, Blue 70-80°, Green >80°) and automatic top-layer rendering. Part of the 'Ineffable Tools' suite.
plugins.author: Vicky Sharma

plugins.name: Horizon Projector
plugins.description: Horizon Projector is a complete plugin for nautical and geodetic calculations in QGIS.
plugins.about:
Key features:
1) Distance to horizon calculation based on observer height,
2) Maximum distance calculation for object viewing,
3) Geodetic projection via magnetic azimuth and distance with declination correction,
4) Creation of distance rings in nautical miles with color gradient,
5) Export to GPX, KML, Shapefile, and GeoJSON. Ideal for maritime navigation, route planning, visibility studies, search and rescue, and geodetic applications.

All calculations consider the curvature of the Earth using precise geodetic formulas.
plugins.author: Alberto Rodrigues

plugins.name: Canva Focus
plugins.description: Plugin to view and control the focus in the central area of ​​the map.
plugins.about:
Canva Focus is a plugin that helps identify and work with the center of the map window in QGIS. With this plugin you can:
Display an adjustable border that delimits the central focus zone of the map
Adjust the size of the focus zone using a slider
Activate/deactivate the focus mode with a toggle button
Display the exact center of the focus zone with a crosshair marker
Automatically center the map when clicking outside the focus zone when the mode is activated
Ideal for work that requires precision in positioning and visualizing the center of the map.
plugins.author: Alberto Rodrigues

plugins.name: Atlas Pro Germany
plugins.description: Access and download 1m resolution German elevation data (DEM/DSM) directly within QGIS.
plugins.about: Atlas Pro Germany integrates the Atlas web application (https://atlas.geo-code.de) into QGIS as a dock widget. It allows you to browse, select, and export 1-meter resolution Digital Elevation Models (DEM) and Digital Surface Models (DSM) covering all of Germany. Downloaded GeoTIFF/COG files can be loaded directly into your QGIS project with a single click. Requires an internet connection. Registration on atlas.geo-code.de is required for data export. Prices start at 5 Euro.

plugins.name: QGarage
plugins.description: Modular app-hosting framework for QGIS with per-app uv/pixi environments, Processing integration, and a unified dashboard for isolated mini-tools.
plugins.about: QGarage is a plugin-within-a-plugin framework for QGIS that installs, manages, and runs isolated mini-tools from a single dashboard. Version 2 adds dual uv/pixi backends for app environments, asynchronous environment preparation during installs, clearer setup error reporting, Processing Toolbox integration for declarative apps, richer scaffolding with backend selection and custom destinations, and bundled TestToolbox examples for both uv and pixi workflows. Install the plugin from the QGIS Plugin Manager, then configure uv and/or pixi in QGarage settings based on the apps you want to run.

plugins.about: Download raster tiles from ArcGIS ImageServer REST services at their native resolution and assemble them into Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs). Supports large-area downloads via a draw-on-canvas bbox tool and parallel tile fetching. Includes a dock widget for browsing and selecting services, plus Processing algorithms for scripted and batch workflows. Zero external dependencies — requires only QGIS and its bundled GDAL. Compatible with QGIS 3.28+ (Qt5) and QGIS 4.x (Qt6). Ships with GIS Steiermark pre-configured; custom servers can be added.
plugins.author: Harald Kristen

農水省(MAFF)筆ポリゴンデータ(GeoJSON)からそれらを構成している各ポイントの座標(平面直角座標系)を取得しCSVファイルに出力します。

Exports the coordinates of the constituent points of features selected from Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries brush polygons (GeoJSON) to CSV in a plane orthogonal coordinate system.

Define rules for attribute completeness, domain values, range checks, geometry validity, topology, and spatial relationships. Run rules in the background, inspect errors in a dockable inspector, assign/status-manage errors, export reports, and apply safe auto-fixes.

A QGIS plugin for importing and exporting XML and TXT files in NF EN 13508-2 format from Wincan or other sources.

plugins.name: Text2Map
plugins.description: Convert pasted text (lat/lon, JSON, GeoJSON, WKT) into temporary geometry layers. Works with both QGIS 3 and QGIS 4.
plugins.about:
Text2Map lets you quickly visualise spatial data from plain text without leaving QGIS.
Compatible with QGIS 3.16+ (Qt5) and QGIS 4.0+ (Qt6).

Supported input formats:
- Decimal lat/lon pairs (comma, space, or semicolon separated; one per line)
- DMS coordinates (Degrees Minutes Seconds)
- JSON objects / arrays with lat/lon key variants
- GeoJSON (FeatureCollection, Feature, or bare geometry)
- WKT (POINT, LINESTRING, POLYGON and MULTI variants)

Features:
- Automatic format detection
- Creates a temporary memory layer in EPSG:4326
- Preserves JSON / GeoJSON properties as attribute fields
- Custom layer naming
- Auto-zooms map canvas to the new layer
- Full error messages on parse failure
plugins.author: Pradip

plugins.name: UrbisMap Click
plugins.description: Open UrbisMap in an external browser by clicking a point on the map
plugins.about: Click the plugin button, then click on the map to open UrbisMap with the latitude and longitude of the selected point.
plugins.author: Roberto Pilleri

plugins.name: Service Access Mapper
plugins.description: Generate travel-time catchments (isochrones) to services using road networks, estimate population coverage using WorldPop data, and summarize statistics by admin boundaries.
plugins.about:
Service Access Mapper computes travel-time catchment areas (isochrones) around service points such as health facilities, schools, and other amenities using road network analysis.

Features:
- Travel-time and distance isochrone generation with customizable thresholds
- Three speed models: field-based, road class mapping (with Ghana defaults), constant
- Automatic WorldPop population raster download with country auto-detection
- Per-threshold population coverage breakdown (band and cumulative)
- Coverage statistics by administrative boundaries with population percentages
- Underserved area identification with population estimates
- Distance decay analysis from demand points to services
- Service point snapping to road networks
- Background processing with progress feedback
- Profile save/load for reusable configurations
- CSV export of admin and population statistics

No external Python packages required — uses only PyQGIS, QGIS Processing, and Python standard library.
plugins.author: Ben Emunah Aikins

plugins.description: Generate center (centroid) point from line features using processing algorithm

Streamline your web mapping workflow without switching between tools.
plugins.about: LizPack Publisher connects QGIS to your LizPack instance, enabling you to publish project folders, manage remote files via SFTP, download QGIS projects with all their dependencies, and import vector layers into your LizPack PostGIS database. plugins.name: Layer Slider
plugins.description: Navigate and compose ordered layers with a slider, keyboard shortcuts, and dynamic raster compositing.
plugins.about:
Layer Slider is a QGIS plugin for navigating and composing ordered layers or layer groups with an intuitive slider, keyboard shortcuts, and dynamic layer compositing.

It is designed for any workflow where you need to flip through a sequence of layers — whether they represent increasing depth (e.g. GPR depth slices), successive points in time (e.g. historical satellite imagery), or alternative visualizations of the same area (e.g. DTM hillshade, slope, aspect). Key features include slider and keyboard navigation, dynamic averaged raster composites, full layer tree integration, caching, and GeoTIFF export.

For a demo, instructions and comparison to alternatives, see the homepage.

If you use Layer Slider in your academic work, please cite it:
Obermayer, M. (2026). Layer Slider – QGIS Plugin (v1.2.0). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20597604 . Available at: https://github.com/mobermayer/layer-slider

For collaboration and research- or software-related inquiries, visit my homepage https://mobermayer.at .

plugins.description: Edit aerial & satellite imagery with AI: land cover classification, building footprint extraction, super-resolution upscaling, object removal, cloud removal and flood simulation, all from a text prompt. Georeferenced output.

Select an area, write what you want -> get the result back as a georeferenced layer

• Works on any data on your map: rasters (GeoTIFF, JPG, PNG), vector layers, OpenStreetMap, and online basemaps (WMS, XYZ tiles)

• Guide the result: add reference images or layers, sketch directly on the map, and compare before/after with a slider

• Vectorize results: turn a generated map into clean vector polygons (buildings, parcels, land cover) ready for SHP or GeoJSON

• 100+ ready-made prompt templates, or write your own

• One AI model for almost anything: describe a task and it handles it, from urban planning and solar studies to crop mapping, archaeology, or restoring old maps

• Universal: Windows, macOS, Linux. Powered by the best generative AI model from Google

Access Kentucky's KyFromAbove geospatial data directly from QGIS.
Search by county or map extent, download tiles with concurrent transfers,
mosaic into VRT, and generate hillshade — all from the Processing toolbox.
Powered by abovepy. No credentials required.

plugins.name: Elevation Profile

plugins.about:
Elevation Profile is an essential tool for Network Planning and Optimization (NPO) Engineers and GIS professionals. It allows users to instantly generate highly accurate 2D elevation profiles directly from loaded local DEM/Raster data.

Features included in this Standard version:
* Offline DEM Profiling: Seamlessly generate profiles from local Raster files (e.g., DEMNAS, SRTM, AW3D30).
* Interactive Line Drawing: Draw a path on the map with real-time live tooltips displaying Azimuth and Distance.
* Dynamic Terrain Smoothing: Adjust Sigma values on the fly to filter noise from raw DEM sources.
* QGIS 4 Ready: Fully refactored to support PyQt6 while maintaining seamless backward compatibility with QGIS 3.x.
* Real-Time Summary: Automatically calculates total distance, minimum, maximum, and average elevation.
* High-Res Export: Export elevation profiles to PNG or scalable SVG formats for professional technical reporting.

🔒 UPGRADE TO PRO VERSION:
Unlock advanced RF Audit tools and global datasets by upgrading to the Pro version! Pro features include:
* Advanced LoS Viewer: Microwave link planning with Tx/Rx tower heights, Earth bulge, K-Factor, and 60% Fresnel Zone clearance.
* Online DEM APIs: Access Open-Meteo 90m & OpenTopoData 30m globally without needing local raster files.
* Population Metrics: Extract 1D demographic density profiles and estimate total population within your corridor.
* Dual Mode UI: Instantly toggle between Dark Mode and elegant Ivory Light Mode.
* Bonus: Includes the Embed Legend Pro plugin for free!
