IOF Assistent utilitza «defusedxml» per a l'anàlisi segura del feed XML del Cadastre; s'inclou vendoritzat a ext_libs/, no cal instal·lar-lo manualment.
plugins.author: David Campeny

plugins.name: RoadDigitizz
plugins.description: Interactive road digitizing with automatic centerline and polygon creation using real-time buffer preview.
plugins.about:
RoadDigitizz: Smart Road Digitizing for QGIS

Draw a road centerline and let the plugin automatically create both the centerline and the corresponding road polygon with a real-time buffer preview.
Perfect for transportation mapping, urban planning, and GIS data creation.

Features:
• Real-time buffer preview
• Configurable road width
• Multiple cap & join styles
• Snap support & undo
• Optional road width attribute storage (RDZWidth)
• Automatic CRS-aware distance handling

Digitize once, get both layers instantly.
plugins.author: Dwi Wahyu Utomo

plugins.name: PL-QGIS-Demografia
plugins.description:
Automatyczna integracja danych demograficznych GUS BDL z granicami PRG GUGiK dla planowania przestrzennego.

English 
Automated integration of GUS BDL demographic data with PRG GUGiK administrative boundaries – ready-to-use choropleth cartograms for spatial planning.
plugins.about:
Wtyczka automatyzuje pobieranie danych statystycznych z Banku Danych Lokalnych GUS
i ich łączenie z granicami administracyjnymi z Państwowego Rejestru Granic (PRG/GUGiK).
Wynik generowany jest w formie gotowego kartogramu choropleth z paletą ColorBrewer.
Przeznaczona dla urbanistów, analityków samorządowych i planistów przestrzennych
tworzących Plany Ogólne Gmin (reforma planowania przestrzennego.

English 

This plugin automates the process of combining statistical data from Poland’s Local Data Bank (BDL GUS) with administrative boundaries from the National Register of Boundaries (PRG/GUGiK). It eliminates the tedious manual work of downloading BDL spreadsheets and matching them to vector layers — the entire process runs automatically within QGIS.
plugins.author: Mikołaj Matwiejuk

plugins.name: Cutbacks Detector
plugins.description: Find oversized segments (gaps) and sharp-angle vertices (kinks) in line and polygon layers.
plugins.about: Cutbacks Detector inspects line and polygon vertices for two kinds of defect. In "gaps" mode it flags every segment whose length between two consecutive vertices exceeds a user-defined threshold. In "kinks" mode it flags every vertex where the line changes direction by at least a chosen number of degrees - from a gentle bend in a should-be-straight line to a spiky hairpin - the breaks that sit between short segments and that a distance check cannot catch. For polygons every ring (the outer boundary and any inner holes) is checked, including the corner that closes each ring. Distances are measured with a CRS-aware QgsDistanceArea (works for projected and geographic CRSs) or in raw map units. Results are delivered as a styled, severity-coloured point layer on the canvas plus optional CSV and GeoJSON reports. Processing runs on a background task with a progress bar and a working Cancel button, so large layers stay responsive.
plugins.author: Mustafa Nehad Elghazaly

plugins.name: PANSA DroneMap Downloader
plugins.description: Pobieranie i filtrowanie struktur przestrzeni powietrznej oraz stref geograficznych BSP bezpośrednio z serwerów PAŻP (DroneMap). / Downloading and filtering airspace structures and UAS geographical zones directly from PANSA (DroneMap) servers.
plugins.about:
[PL]
Wtyczka pozawala na bezpośrednie pobieranie z oficjalnego interfejsu serwerowego PAŻP (api.dronemap.pansa.pl) pliku KML, obrazującego strefy przestrzeni powietrznej i strefy geograficzne BSP, konwersji w locie do zgrupowanych warstw tymczasowych wraz ze stylizacją.
Pozwala na:
1. Pobieranie struktur z podziałem hierarchicznym i zaawansowanym grupowaniem.

2.Selektywne filtrowanie wysokości do zadanego progu w metrach AGL.

3. Ograniczanie zasięgu na podstawie warstwy buforowej/maski lotów.

4. Dynamiczne etykietowanie stref i definiowanie kontrastowych podświetleń.

Wtyczka do poprawnego działania wymaga zestawu standardowych bibliotek. W środowiskach Windows i OS X instalatory QGIS dostarczają je domyślnie. W niektórych dystrybucjach Linux konieczna może być ich manualna weryfikacja. Przed uruchomieniem wtyczki upewnij się, że w środowisku interpreterów Pythona QGIS zainstalowane są pakiety: requests i urllib3

[EN]

The plugin allows for direct download of KML files representing airspace structures and UAS geographical zones directly from the official PANSA server interface (api.dronemap.pansa.pl), with on-the-fly conversion into styled, grouped memory layers. It features:
1. Downloading structures with hierarchical division and advanced grouping.

2. Selective altitude filtering up to a specified threshold in meters AGL.

3. Restricting the extent based on a buffer layer or a flight mask.

4. Dynamic zone labeling and defining high-contrast highlights.

The plugin requires a set of standard libraries to function properly. In Windows and OS X environments, QGIS installers provide them by default. In some Linux distributions, manual verification may be necessary. Before running the plugin, make sure that the 'requests' and 'urllib3' packages are installed in the QGIS Python interpreter environment.
plugins.author: Marcin Kelm (KELM Solutions) supported by Gemini and Claude AI

plugins.name: Grid-Generator
plugins.description: An adaptive tool to generate tight grids, centroids, and buffers across multi-format layers (SHP, KML, KMZ, Lines, Polygons).
plugins.about: This plugin automatically handles single/multi-polygons, lines, and tight gaps. It provides custom orientation angles along with centimeter/millimeter buffer support.
plugins.author: Sandeep Shinde

plugins.name: GeoAccuracy
plugins.description: Generate confusion matrices and advanced mapping accuracy statistics (Overall, User, Producer, Balanced Accuracy, Cohen's Kappa, MCC, F1-Score, Quantity/Allocation Disagreements) comparing classified maps with ground truth rasters.
plugins.about: Generate confusion matrices and advanced mapping accuracy statistics (Overall, User, Producer, Balanced Accuracy, Cohen's Kappa, MCC, F1-Score, Quantity/Allocation Disagreements) comparing classified maps with ground truth rasters. Fully compliant with modern QGIS versions and optimized for large datasets.
plugins.author: Rahul

plugins.name: IGN PluginsManager
plugins.description: PluginsManager allowing the installation, update and organization of IGN extensions in the IGN menu and/or toolbars according to a defined profile.
plugins.about:
PluginsManager is a dedicated manager for IGN plugins in QGIS.
It allows users to:
- Install IGN plugins from available repositories (qgis.org or GitHub) based on a given profile
- Automatically detect available updates for installed IGN plugins and install new versions
- Organize IGN plugins into IGN menu and customizable toolbars according to user needs

The goal of this plugin is to simplify the deployment, maintenance and daily use of IGN extensions within QGIS.
plugins.author: Gérôme PECHEUR (IGN)

plugins.name: IGN ShortestPath
plugins.description: Route selection based on the 'shortest path' algorithm, the "IGN PluginsManager" plugin must be installed beforehand.
plugins.about: Route selection based on the 'shortest path' algorithm
plugins.author: Gérôme PECHEUR (IGN)

plugins.name: Spatial Bookmark Extents
plugins.description: Displays QGIS spatial bookmark extents as toggleable map-canvas rectangles with buffered, overlap-aware bookmark names, and exports extents to GeoPackage and other vector formats.
plugins.about: Adds a toolbar toggle that displays spatial bookmarks from the current project and the application bookmark store as transient canvas overlays. No temporary layers are added to the project. An export action saves bookmark extents as polygons to GeoPackage, Shapefile, GeoJSON, or KML.
plugins.author: Ian Hay

plugins.name: IGN DigitizingDirection
plugins.description: Displays the digitizing direction of features by drawing directional arrows, making it easier to verify geometry orientation during editing and quality control
plugins.about:
Displays the digitizing direction of features by drawing directional arrows, making it easier to verify geometry orientation during editing and quality control
The IGN Plugins Manager must be installed first.
plugins.author: Gérôme PECHEUR (IGN)

plugins.name: HandModel
plugins.description: QGIS plugin for hydrological and geomorphological analysis using DEMs, with slope quartiles and drainage extraction.
plugins.about: HandModel Plugin is a QGIS extension designed to support hydrological and geomorphological analysis using digital elevation models (DEMs). It provides slope calculation in degrees or percentage with automatic quartile symbology, drainage network extraction using GRASS algorithms, workspace integration to save results as GeoTIFF, simple dialogs for parameter selection and progress monitoring, and automation to add outputs directly to the QGIS project.
plugins.author: Ivan Listo (Cemaden)

plugins.name: Garmin Export
plugins.description: Professional Garmin IMG export for QGIS 3.22+ with Qt5/Qt6 dual support, modern localized UI, 12 languages and reliable mkgmap workflows
plugins.about: Professional Garmin Export tool with a Processing Toolbox provider for QGIS Modeler and batch workflows, converting QGIS vector layers to Garmin IMG format using the mkgmap compiler. Supports QGIS 3.44/Qt5 and QGIS 4.2/Qt6 through a shared compatibility boundary. The UI provides live/restart-safe translation, SVG language flags, RTL Arabic, readable combo/check controls, retranslate-safe dialogs, tooltips and actions. Features: one-click download of the full mkgmap/splitter distributions (zip archives with all dependency libraries; QGIS forbids bundling jars), automatic TYP styling generated from QGIS layer symbology, JSON-based type mapping, multi-level map support, advanced mkgmap tuning and logging options, comprehensive label code-page support (UTF-8 plus Windows/DOS/CJK pages), batch processing of all project layers, and a 12-language interface (EN, RU, DE, ES, FR, PT, ZH, HI, AR, ID, TH, VI). Requires Java (JRE 8+) which the plugin can auto-detect.
plugins.author: Alex Kobyakov

plugins.name: Batch KMZ Exporter
plugins.description: Export one or multiple selected layers (with symbology, labels, and attributes preserved exactly as shown on the map) into a single combined KMZ file.
plugins.about: Batch KMZ Exporter allows you to export multiple selected QGIS layers into a single KMZ file, with each layer organized as a separate folder in Google Earth. Placemark labels are exported only for layers with labeling enabled, preserving the configured field or expression, text color, and relative text size. All geometries are clamped to the ground by default: lines and polygons are tessellated to accurately follow terrain, while point markers are anchored at their true center. Data-defined point rotation is preserved using KML's native icon heading, ensuring correct per-feature orientation. The plugin reads QGIS symbology directly from single, categorized, and graduated renderers and recreates it in KML using the SimpleKML library. Additional features include automatic reprojection to WGS84, a progress dialog during export, and a one-click option to open the exported KMZ directly in Google Earth.
plugins.author: Shyam Mishra

plugins.name: Mega Batch POI Scraper
plugins.description: An enterprise-level PyQGIS algorithm engineered to automate Point of Interest (POI) data extraction across multiple APIs simultaneously. Built for urban planners and geospatial analysts to easily map global amenities. Features include dynamic batch looping, semantic spatial anti-duplication, and local API caching.
plugins.about: Automates POI data extraction across multiple APIs with spatial anti-duplication and quota-saving cache.
plugins.author: Rizal Brilliant Nugraha

plugins.name: Mega Batch Intersect & Calculator Global
plugins.description: An enterprise-level PyQGIS algorithm engineered to automate spatial intersection across multiple layers simultaneously. It intelligently detects geometry types, reprojects to metric CRS, auto-calculates Area (M2 & HA) or Length (M & KM), and instantly exports the results into both Shapefiles and Excel spreadsheets.
plugins.about: Automates batch intersection, reprojection, geometry calculation, and multi-format exports.
plugins.author: Rizal Brilliant Nugraha

plugins.name: QuickMapLink
plugins.description: Right-click the map canvas to instantly open that location in Google Maps, Bing Maps, Apple Maps, OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, or Wikimedia Maps.
plugins.about: QuickMapLink adds a one-click "Open in <Provider>" entry to the map canvas right-click menu, using whichever map provider and mode you've chosen in Settings. Choose an embedded, dockable webview that can live-follow your QGIS map canvas as you pan and zoom, or open the location in your system's default browser (as a snapshot, or optionally live-following). Supports Google Maps, Bing Maps, Apple Maps, OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, and Wikimedia Maps.
plugins.author: Pixeled Dimensions

plugins.name: QGIS Dashboard
plugins.description: Build ArcGIS-Dashboards-style interactive dashboards from your QGIS project layers — indicators, charts, lists, a live map element, and cross-filtering selectors all wired together through a signal bus. By Isaac Enage (byZenterra).
plugins.about: QGIS Dashboard by Isaac Enage is an interactive dashboard builder for QGIS. Add data-driven elements (indicator, serial/bar chart, pie/donut chart, list) bound to vector layers via the QGIS expression engine, plus a live map element and a category selector that cross-filters every other element. Layout and configuration persist inside the .qgz project file. Developed and maintained by Isaac Enage of byZenterra. Guides, the dashboard gallery, and more QGIS plugins by Isaac Enage are at https://qgis.byzenterra.org/qdashboards
plugins.author: Isaac Enage

plugins.name: Basdonax Keyline from DEM
plugins.description: Computational design of Keyline infiltration lines from DEM/DTM.
plugins.about: Basdonax Keyline from DEM is a QGIS Processing plugin for computational design of infiltration lines, Keyline-inspired layouts and regenerative hydrological landscape planning from digital terrain models. It includes DEM validation, hydrological analysis, D8 flow accumulation, potential drainage detection, design units, intelligent mother lines and multicriteria optimization using WDI and ICL indicators.
plugins.author: Basdonax

plugins.name: GeoSpecies Tools
plugins.description: Herramientas GEE y preparación de datos para especies. / GEE tools and data preparation for species modeling.
plugins.about: Plugin para descarga de variables (WorldClim, SoilGrids, Variables Climáticas Actuales) con GEE y preparación de datos para MaxEnt. / QGIS Plugin providing Google Earth Engine tools for downloading environmental variables and utilities for species data preparation (MaxEnt).
plugins.author: Geomatica Ambiental

plugins.name: Connector for Kobo
plugins.description: Connect to KoboToolbox to download form submissions as map layers, with intelligent geometry detection, searchable survey list, and layer splitting.
plugins.about: Connector for Kobo is a focused QGIS plugin. Get Data connects to KoboToolbox (Global, EU, or custom servers), lists surveys with submission counts, and downloads submissions as GeoJSON map layers with intelligent geometry detection for mixed forms. Split Layer creates separate layers for each unique attribute value.
plugins.author: Felix Mutua

plugins.name: SkyStitch - Drone Orthomosaic
plugins.description: From drone photos to a finished map — a fast 2D orthomosaic, or full 3D photogrammetry (orthophoto, DSM, DTM, point cloud, 3D mesh) — all inside QGIS. Free, open-source, and your imagery stays on your machine.
plugins.about:
SkyStitch brings drone mapping right into QGIS — point it at a folder of GPS-tagged photos and get map-ready results without leaving QGIS or paying for the cloud.

Two engines, one plugin:
- Fast 2D — stitch a single georeferenced orthomosaic (GeoTIFF) in seconds. Great for quick previews and flat sites.
- Full 3D — real SfM/MVS photogrammetry on a local NodeODM node: a true orthophoto plus DSM, DTM/DEM, point cloud (LAZ) and a textured 3D mesh (OBJ), straight onto the canvas.

Why you'll like it:
- 100% free & open-source — and your imagery never leaves your machine.
- No cloud, no subscriptions, no Docker to wrestle — install one lightweight local engine (e.g. the free WebODM native installer) and run everything from QGIS.
- Survey-grade when you need it — drop in GCPs for centimetre-level accuracy.
- Background processing with a live log, progress bar and one-click Test Connection.

Requires QGIS 3.16 or newer.
plugins.author: Muhammad Kholifatkhur Rohman

plugins.name: koji DataQuery
plugins.description: CSV and GeoPackage preprocessing tools for QGIS. Aiming to be a Power Query-like workflow for QGIS.
plugins.about: koji DataQuery aims to provide a Power Query-like workflow for QGIS, with tools for CSV cleanup, GeoPackage cleanup, aggregation queries, and CSV/GeoPackage LEFT JOIN and UNION workflows.
plugins.author: Code4Construct

plugins.name: DDM Line Direction
plugins.description: Overlay and animate lines/polylines with per-field arrowhead styling.
plugins.about: Adds a live canvas overlay for line direction visualisation. Arrow density adapts with map scale: networks are sparse when zoomed out and more detailed when zoomed in. Direction follows vertex order, i.e. the original digitising direction of each line feature. Arrowheads can be styled based per field value: each styling rule matches a field value and sets its own fill, outline, opacity, size, density and animation speed, with a default style for the rest. Arrowheads can also be animated along the linework with customisable speed. Several line layers can be overlaid at once, each with its own styling rules and animation. Licensed under the GNU General Public License version 2 or later.
plugins.author: Davide Di Mauro

plugins.name: CotaGIS
plugins.description: Acotado estilo AutoCAD con Object Snap: cotas lineales, alineadas, continuas, línea base, angulares, radiales, diametrales, de arco y de coordenadas; acotado por lote de capas. / AutoCAD-style dimensioning with Object Snap: linear, aligned, continuous, baseline, angular, radius, diameter, arc-length and ordinate dimensions; batch layer dimensioning.
plugins.about: Genera cotas estilo CAD (líneas de extensión, línea de cota, ticks o flechas y texto rotado) para todos los segmentos de capas de líneas y polígonos, imitando los comandos DIM/DIMALIGNED de AutoCAD. Incluye etiquetas de área (m²), perímetro/longitud total, ángulos internos en vértices y una herramienta interactiva de cota manual (2 puntos + posición). Las cotas se crean como capas de memoria estilizadas listas para imprimir o exportar. / Creates CAD-style dimensions (extension lines, dimension line, ticks/arrows and rotated text) for every segment of line and polygon layers, mimicking AutoCAD's DIM/DIMALIGNED commands. Includes area labels (m²), perimeter/total length, interior angles and an interactive 3-click manual dimension tool. Dimensions are created as styled memory layers ready to print or export.
plugins.author: Luis Gámez

plugins.name: TopoTidy
plugins.description: Turn messy vector data into clean topology in QGIS: cleanup tools (snap, trim, extend, split, dissolve, fix geometry, simplify, remove duplicate/disconnected lines) and topology-rule checks, driven from one dockable panel that names the tool to fix each error — and every fixer can edit your layer in place.
plugins.about:
𝐌𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐲 𝐯𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫 𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐚 𝐢𝐧, 𝐜𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧 𝐭𝐨𝐩𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐠𝐲 𝐨𝐮𝐭 — 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐐𝐆𝐈𝐒. 𝐓𝐨𝐩𝐨𝐓𝐢𝐝𝐲 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐰𝐨 𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐯𝐞𝐬.

(1) 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐓𝐨𝐩𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐠𝐲 𝐩𝐚𝐧𝐞𝐥. Add your layers, tick the rules they must obey — no dangles, no overlaps, no gaps, no pseudo-nodes, must be single-part, must sit inside or along another layer, and more — set a tolerance, and hit Validate. A dockable report shows exactly what is wrong and, for every kind of error, names and opens the tool that repairs it. Click any error to zoom straight to it on the map; accept the legitimate ones (a cul-de-sac, a bridge over a river) as exceptions that stick across re-runs; then re-validate and watch the counts fall to zero. A manual-editing toolbar (vertex, split, trim/extend, snapping) is right there for the fixes only you can decide.

(2) 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐜𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨𝐨𝐥𝐛𝐨𝐱. Every fix is also a standalone algorithm you can run, batch, or drop into a model: Snap Network Endpoints, Trim, Extend, Find Dangling Endpoints, Remove Duplicate Lines, Remove Disconnected Network Lines, Split with Lines, Multipart to Singleparts, Dissolve, Fix Geometry and Simplify. Each one can write a brand-new fixed layer or edit the input layer in place.

Built for roads, rivers, parcels and utility networks. Runs in QGIS 3.16 through QGIS 4.0 (Qt6).
plugins.author: Muhammad Kholifatkhur Rohman

plugins.name: Profili, Sezioni e Comuni
plugins.description: IT: Profili altimetrici (con anteprima live ProfiloExpress), sezioni con volumi di sterro/riporto, download DTM, ricerca comuni via ISTAT e confronto prima/dopo. / EN: Elevation profiles (with a live ProfiloExpress preview), cross sections with cut/fill volumes, DTM download, ISTAT-based municipality search and before/after comparison.
plugins.about: IT: Strumento avanzato in grafica SPATIQON per profili altimetrici (con anteprima live ProfiloExpress durante il disegno) e con confronto affiancato dello stile "picchettato", sezioni trasversali reali con sterri/riporti/accumuli, disegni tecnici vettoriali, download raster da area SHIFT-draw dagli ZIP ufficiali TINITALY 1.1 e HR-DTM-5m Zenodo con progress/ETA e citazione/licenza, ricerca comuni e confini amministrativi ufficiali direttamente dall'archivio ISTAT (cache locale dopo il primo download, nessuna dipendenza da OpenStreetMap/Nominatim), confronto prima/dopo lavori tra GeoPackage generati dal plugin e tra DTM (raster differenza con volumi di scavo/riporto) con schede risultati separate per Profilo/Sezioni/Confronto, ed esportazioni PNG/PDF/CSV/GPKG/layout QGIS. --- EN: Advanced SPATIQON-style tool for elevation profiles (with a live "ProfiloExpress" preview while drawing) shown side by side with a classic "picchettata" comparison style, real cross sections with cut/fill/stockpile volumes, vector technical drawings, SHIFT-draw raster download from the official TINITALY 1.1 and HR-DTM-5m Zenodo archives with progress/ETA and citation/licence info, municipality search and official administrative boundaries fetched directly from the ISTAT archive (cached locally after the first download, no OpenStreetMap/Nominatim dependency), before/after works comparison between plugin-generated GeoPackages and between DTMs (difference raster with cut/fill volumes) with separate Profile/Sections/Comparison result tabs, and PNG/PDF/CSV/GPKG/QGIS layout exports.
plugins.author: Dott. Sarino Alfonso Grande

plugins.name: riverbank_erosion_accretion_v2
plugins.description: Regime-aware riverbank erosion and accretion analyzer that accepts satellite-derived waterbody polygons directly and produces both areal (km2) and linear (m/yr) change metrics with JRC occurrence-threshold uncertainty quantification.
plugins.about: RiverBankErosionAccretion_V2 quantifies riverbank erosion and accretion directly from satellite-derived waterbody polygons across three modules: (1) grid-based change detection with a dynamic riparian buffer, Minimum Mapping Unit filtering, connected-component labelling, braiding-index computation, and regime classification (REGULATED_SINGLE_THREAD / MEANDERING / BRAIDED / HYPER_BRAIDED / DELTAIC) - always runs; (2) optional transect-based bank retreat/advance rates with an automatic centerline extraction and a grid-transect Consistency Index, auto-disabled for braided/deltaic channels; (3) optional JRC occurrence-threshold (70, 85, and 100 percent) uncertainty quantification with a multi-epoch rate-acceleration metric. Unlike DSAS and manual-bankline QGIS tools, it requires no digitised banklines, reports area and rate together from the same input, adapts its processing to channel regime, and quantifies input-data uncertainty. REQUIRES additional Python packages not bundled with QGIS: geopandas, shapely, pandas. Install from the OSGeo4W Shell with: python -m pip install geopandas shapely pandas -- then restart QGIS. The plugin will show a clear message on first run if these are missing.
plugins.author: Srija Roy

plugins.name: Polygon & GMR
plugins.description: Join a polygon layer with an Excel file (GMR): reads the Excel workbook with its real column headers, matches on a join field you choose, and outputs only the polygons whose codes match, keeping the polygon attribute table enriched with the Excel columns.
plugins.about: Polygon & GMR links your plots (polygons) to a management table (Excel file, GMR). The plugin takes two inputs: a polygon layer (already loaded in QGIS or imported from a file such as Shapefile, GeoPackage or GeoJSON) and an Excel file (.xlsx / .xls). It reads every sheet of the workbook and extracts the real column headers, which are listed grouped by sheet, so you can pick exactly which header to join on. You then choose the join field on the polygon side and the matching header on the Excel side. The plugin performs the cross-check: the output layer contains only the polygons whose code matches a row of the Excel file, with the original polygon attribute table completed by the columns of the Excel file. Code comparison is robust (trimmed spaces, integers read as reals such as 12.0 versus 12, optional case-insensitive matching). A detailed log reports the number of matches, polygons with no match and Excel codes that were not found. Excel reading relies on GDAL/OGR shipped with QGIS, so there is no external dependency (no pandas, no openpyxl), and everything works fully offline with your local data. Typical use: matching agricultural or cadastral plots with a producer register, for example for EUDR due diligence in West African cooperatives. VERSION FRANCAISE - Polygon & GMR relie vos parcelles (polygones) a un tableau de gestion (fichier Excel, GMR). Deux entrees : une couche de polygones (chargee dans QGIS ou depuis un fichier) et un fichier Excel (.xlsx / .xls) dont il lit toutes les feuilles et les vrais en-tetes de colonnes, presentes regroupes par feuille. Vous choisissez le champ de jointure cote polygone et l'en-tete correspondante cote Excel, puis le plugin realise le croisement : la couche de sortie ne contient que les polygones dont le code concorde avec une ligne du fichier Excel, avec la table attributaire d'origine des polygones completee par les colonnes du fichier Excel. Un journal detaille indique le nombre de concordances, de polygones sans correspondance et de codes Excel non trouves. Fonctionne entierement hors ligne, sans dependance externe.
plugins.author: Jean David Konan

plugins.name: Road Shortest Path
plugins.description: Interactive shortest path routing on LineString road network layers.
plugins.about: Road Shortest Path is a QGIS plugin for interactive shortest path routing on vector road networks. It allows users to calculate the shortest route between two points by clicking directly on the map. The plugin automatically snaps selected points to the nearest road segment and computes the optimal route using Dijkstra's algorithm. Features include two-click route creation, customizable route color, start and end markers, route length calculation, support for any LineString road network layer, and persistent plugin settings.
plugins.author: Sergey Andreev

plugins.name: HydroSizer
plugins.description: Auditable hydraulic pipe sizing for water distribution networks using QGISRed or compatible simulation results.
plugins.about: HydroSizer sizes water-distribution pipes from hydraulic results already produced by QGISRed or compatible simulators. It supports Hazen-Williams and Darcy-Weisbach, a reusable product catalog, headloss, velocity, diameter and pressure criteria, batch review, optional audited attribute updates, and an engineering calculation memory in HTML with detailed CSV. It does not run the network simulation or transient analysis, has no external Python dependencies, and keeps QGISRed Options and Materials DBFs read-only.
plugins.author: Evanderson H. Aguiar

plugins.name: Thermal Temperature Reconstructor
plugins.description:
EN:
Thermal Temperature Reconstructor is a QGIS plugin that recovers temperature values from thermal orthomosaics generated via DJI FlightHub 2 cloud mapping, which lose radiometric data during processing. Using a reverse calculation based on the color palette and the min/max temperature scale set during the flight mission, it rebuilds a raster containing actual temperature values. 
Tested with the Rainbow ISO 2 palette on DJI Matrice 4TD and Matrice 400 (H30T) imagery.



IT:
Thermal Temperature Reconstructor è un plugin QGIS che recupera i valori di temperatura dagli ortomosaici termici generati con il cloud mapping di DJI FlightHub 2, che perdono i dati radiometrici durante l'elaborazione. Tramite un calcolo a ritroso basato sulla palette colori e sulla scala di temperatura min/max impostata durante la missione di volo, ricostruisce un raster contenente i valori reali di temperatura. 
Testato con la palette Rainbow ISO 2 su immagini DJI Matrice 4TD e Matrice 400 (H30T).
plugins.about:
EN:
The Thermal Temperature Reconstructor plugin allows the reconstruction of temperature values from maps created with DJI drones, such as the Matrice 4TD and Matrice 400 with H30T, processed in the cloud on the DJI FlightHub 2 platform (cloud mapping), generating a map containing the temperature values. Cloud mapping reconstructions, in fact, lose the radiometric temperature information.

The process is based on a reverse calculation of the color palette and of the maximum and minimum temperature values set in the temperature scale during the flight mission.

The color palette we tested the workflow with is Rainbow ISO 2; under normal conditions, the ideal temperature scale is 0 to 130 °C. The temperature scale must be adjusted for each mission to prevent the cloud from failing to correctly reconstruct the thermal map: since the output is an orthophoto, it is essential that the thermal images are as little monochromatic as possible. Do not leave the temperature scale in dynamic mode, otherwise you will never obtain correct data!



IT:
Il plugin Thermal Temperature Reconstructor permette di ricostruire i valori di temperatura delle cartografie realizzate con droni DJI, come Matrice 4TD e Matrice 400 con H30T, elaborate in cloud sulla piattaforma DJI FlightHub 2 (cloud mapping), generando una mappa contenente i valori di temperatura. Le ricostruzioni in cloud mapping, infatti, perdono l'informazione radiometrica di temperatura.

Il processo si basa su un calcolo a ritroso della scala colori e dei valori di temperatura massima e minima impostati nella scala di temperatura durante la missione di volo.

La scala colori con cui abbiamo testato il flusso di lavoro è la Rainbow ISO 2; in condizioni normali, la scala di temperatura ideale è da 0 a 130 °C. La scala di temperatura deve essere adattata a ogni missione, per evitare che il cloud non riesca a ricostruire correttamente la mappa termica: trattandosi di un'ortofoto, è fondamentale che le foto termiche siano il meno monocromatiche possibile. Non lasciare la scala di temperatura in modalità dinamica, altrimenti non otterrai mai dati corretti!
plugins.author: Drone Agri Tech

plugins.name: Thermal to Polygon
plugins.description:
EN:
Thermal to Polygon is a QGIS plugin that automatically extracts heat zones from thermal maps reconstructed with the Thermal Temperature Reconstructor plugin. By applying a temperature threshold, it creates a binary raster, polygonizes it, buffers and dissolves the results into a single polygon per zone, loaded with user-defined styling. Ideal for wildfire and mop-up monitoring, it helps quickly direct ground and airborne response teams where intervention is needed. Available in English, Italian, French and German.



IT:
Thermal to Polygon è un plugin QGIS che estrae automaticamente le zone di calore dalle mappe termiche ricostruite con il plugin Thermal Temperature Reconstructor. Applicando una soglia di temperatura, crea un raster binario, lo poligonizza, genera buffer e dissolve i risultati in un unico poligono per zona, caricato con lo stile definito dall'utente. Ideale per il monitoraggio di incendi e bonifiche, aiuta a indirizzare rapidamente le squadre di intervento a terra e in aria dove è necessario intervenire. Disponibile in inglese, italiano, francese e tedesco.
plugins.about:
EN:
The Thermal to Polygon plugin highlights heat zones through an automatic sequence of operations, to be run after the reconstruction performed with the Thermal Temperature Reconstructor plugin: once a temperature threshold has been selected using a mathematical operator, it creates a binary raster, polygonizes it, removes the polygons with a value of 0, generates a buffer around the polygons (with a selectable distance) and dissolves neighboring polygons, so as to obtain a single polygon per zone.

The polygon layer is loaded with the fill and outline color settings chosen before processing.

After the thermal reconstruction, this makes it possible to quickly highlight fire or mop-up areas, to follow the evolution of the event, and to promptly indicate to ground or airborne response teams where intervention is needed.

The plugin is available in English, Italian, French and German; the language can be forced via: Plugins → Thermal to Polygon → Plugin language.



IT:
Il plugin Thermal to Polygon evidenzia le zone di calore attraverso una sequenza automatica di operazioni, da eseguire dopo la ricostruzione effettuata con il plugin Thermal Temperature Reconstructor: selezionata una soglia di temperatura tramite un operatore matematico, crea un raster binario, lo poligonizza, rimuove i poligoni con valore 0, genera un buffer attorno ai poligoni (con distanza selezionabile) e dissolve i poligoni vicini, in modo da ottenerne uno solo per zona.

Il layer di poligoni viene caricato con le impostazioni di colore di riempimento e perimetro scelte prima dell'elaborazione.

Questo permette, dopo la ricostruzione termica, di evidenziare rapidamente le zone di bonifica o di incendio, di seguire l'evoluzione dell'evento e di segnalare tempestivamente alle squadre di intervento, a terra o in aria, dove è necessario intervenire.

Il plugin è disponibile in inglese, italiano, francese e tedesco; la lingua può essere forzata da: Plugins → Thermal to Polygon → Lingua plugin.
plugins.author: Drone Agri Tech

plugins.name: HidroModelagem
plugins.description: Complete hydraulic modeling platform for water distribution networks in QGIS: builds and runs EPANET models, diagnoses the network by simulation or by hydraulic head alone (elevation and demand), recommends air-valve locations, automatically suggests pressure-reducing valve (PRV) and isolation-valve locations for pressure zoning and DMA sectorization, calibrates the model, extracts elevations from the Copernicus DEM and analyzes water losses, PRV, sectorization, DMA, DMC using the IWA methodology.
plugins.about: HidroModelagem is a hydraulic engineering platform for QGIS focused on water distribution networks. It builds EPANET models from node and pipe layers (or opens an existing .inp file) and runs steady-state or extended-period simulations, bringing pressures, flows, velocities and head loss (Hazen-Williams) to the map, with automatic highlighting of pipes that need reinforcement. It goes beyond simulation: it diagnoses the network in plain language, evaluates an area by hydraulic head alone - using only elevation and demand, with no need to simulate - and recommends where to install air valves in transmission mains and networks (high points, slope changes and long stretches). It also includes: elevation extraction from the Copernicus GLO-30 DEM directly into the node attribute table; Thiessen polygons and automatic identification of critical sectors; assignment of service connections to the nearest influence node; roughness calibration against field-measured pressures; hydraulic calculators (design flows, pipe and pump sizing, water hammer, fire flow); and water-loss analysis using the IWA methodology - water balance, ILI index, FAVAD (pressure management), economic level of leakage and energy efficiency. Requires the WNTR library for EPANET simulation.
plugins.author: Antonio A. Coelho Neto

plugins.name: Spatial Attribute Appender
plugins.description: Transfer attributes from a source layer to a target layer by spatial relationship (intersect/touch or nearest feature), with automatic field creation, optional Manual Field Mapping support, and undoable edits.
plugins.about: Spatial Attribute Transfer copies attributes (fields and values) from a source vector layer onto a target vector layer based on a spatial relationship. Two matching modes are available: Intersect/Touch and Nearest Feature (with an optional maximum search distance, powered by QgsSpatialIndex). By default, all matching fields are transferred automatically and missing fields are created in the target layer, preserving type, length and precision. An optional Field Mapping table lets you take manual control instead: Auto Match to pre-fill suggestions, then freely edit which source field goes to which target field, retarget a value to a differently named field, or create a brand-new target field on the fly. Geometries are never modified, and all changes happen inside an edit session grouped into a single undo command, so one Ctrl+Z reverts the whole transfer. Supports Point, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon and MultiPolygon layers, and handles differing CRSs via on-the-fly reprojection.
plugins.author: Mustafa Nehad Elghazaly

plugins.name: GPX Batch Converter
plugins.description: Batch-converts GPX layers to Shapefile, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, KML or CSV, with optional merging, background processing, cancellation and detailed results.
plugins.about:
GPX Batch Converter processes all GPX files in a selected folder and converts waypoints, routes, route points, tracks and track points to common GIS formats.
Features include:
* Batch conversion of GPX sublayers.
* ESRI Shapefile, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, KML and CSV/WKT output.
* Optional merging into one output per GPX layer type.
* Background execution through the QGIS Task Manager.
* Safe cancellation of active GDAL operations.
* Detailed results panel and UTF-8 CSV report export.
* Source provenance fields in merged outputs.
The plugin has no external Python package dependencies. It requires ogr2ogr and ogrinfo from the GDAL installation bundled with or available to the active QGIS environment. It is intended for Windows, Linux and macOS.
plugins.author: Jubilio Filiano Mausse

plugins.name: ArchaeoAstroInsight
plugins.description: Detects archaeological features in satellite and aerial imagery and computes their archaeoastronomical alignment by using AI algorithms.
plugins.about: ArchaeoAstroInsight is a QGIS plugin for the archaeoastronomical analysis of ground-level archaeological features. It detects features in satellite or aerial rasters using a YOLO model, estimates each feature's orientation (azimuth) with a ResNet classifier, derives the local horizon from either the HeyWhatsThat online service or user-provided SRTM elevation data, and computes the astronomical declination of each alignment. It also generates azimuth and declination curvigrams (kernel-density plots with significance thresholds) and writes all results to a single CSV for further analysis. It requires external Python packages (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Ultralytics and others) that are not bundled with the plugin; see the installation instructions in the repository README.
plugins.author: Andrei Ancuta, Helga Hochbauer, Maitane Urrutia, Marc Frincu

plugins.name: GPS Road Builder (RidgeSlide)
plugins.description: Reconstructs a connected road/path network (graph) from raw GPS tracks using the RidgeSlide density method
plugins.about:
GPS Road Builder reconstructs a connected road/path-network graph from raw
GPS tracks of any kind — forestry haul roads, logistics, sports (running,
cycling), off-road, vessels, OSM traces and more. Its core is RidgeSlide — a
Python/NumPy/Numba density method conceived, generalized, developed and
completed by Alexander Kobyakov (building on Guo et al. 2020 and the Slide
method, with his own corrections and additions): build a density surface,
compact trajectories onto road ridges, extract a centerline skeleton, then
weight, clean and connect the edges. A KDE mode is available for very sparse data. Designed
for large inputs (tens of millions of points) with background processing that
keeps the QGIS UI responsive. Heavy optional accelerators (scikit-image,
numba) are installed on demand from a dialog — no silent auto-install.
Interface in 12 languages: Russian, English, Chinese, Hindi, Spanish,
Arabic, French, Portuguese, German, Indonesian, Thai and Vietnamese.
plugins.author: Alex Kobyakov

plugins.name: PeruSpatial Hub
plugins.description: Explore official geospatial services exclusively from Peru via ArcGIS REST and WMS, and load native raster and vector layers in QGIS.
plugins.about: PeruSpatial Hub consulta en vivo directorios ArcGIS REST y servicios WMS oficiales cuya disponibilidad ha sido verificada. Descubre servicios y subcapas, carga capas mediante proveedores nativos de QGIS y permite registrar conexiones oficiales en el panel Explorador.
plugins.author: Jordan Zavaleta

plugins.name: Jeomatik NCZ Reader
plugins.description: Imports NetCAD NCZ drawing files into QGIS and converts supported entities into editable vector layers.
plugins.about: Imports NetCAD NCZ drawing files directly into QGIS and converts supported entities into editable point, line, and polygon memory layers while preserving geometry and attributes. Designed for geomatics, surveying, engineering, and GIS professionals working with legacy or project-based NetCAD data.
plugins.author: Erdinç Örsan ÜNAL

plugins.name: Flood Simulation Studio
plugins.description: Interactive flood simulation and return-period flood assessment tools for QGIS 3.x and 4.x.
plugins.about: Flood Simulation Studio is a standalone QGIS workspace for planning-grade flood simulation and return-period screening. Load an AOI, optional buildings, optional soil/drainage/surface-water layers, or let the Studio fetch DEM, SoilGrids soil parameters, and mapped surface water. Set rainfall, infiltration, drainage, channels, blockages, and timing, then run an animated 2D/3D flood scenario or T5-T100 return-period assessments. Outputs include maximum and final flood depth, flood extent, hazard, speed and direction proxies, water-surface raster, affected-structure counts, CSV summaries, scenario JSON, and transferable DEM/soil/surface-water context layers. Engineering certification should use calibrated local hydrology and approved hydraulic solvers.
plugins.author: Valentine Adolsum Anaba

plugins.name: Sen Hydro - Watershed Delineation
plugins.description: Sen Hydro delineates the upstream watershed of any point clicked on the map, using the free Global Watersheds API (mghydro.com), based on MERIT-Hydro/HydroSHEDS data. Useful for hydrology, water resource management, flood risk assessment and land-use planning. Includes a built-in Senegal boundary layer for clipping and stream-order-based river styling. Requires an internet connection.
plugins.about:
Click anywhere on the map to instantly delineate the upstream watershed boundary of that point, together with the associated river network and outlet point. Powered by the free "Global Watersheds" HTTP API (mghydro.com), which applies the method of the Python package "delineator" (MIT License, Matthew Heberger) to global MERIT-Hydro/HydroSHEDS data - no local Python dependencies required, but an internet connection is needed for each delineation. Includes configurable calculation options (precision, simplification, beautification), custom styling, an on-screen watershed report (area, perimeter, river length), and optional clipping of results to Senegal's official commune boundaries. Ideal for hydrological studies, irrigation planning, flood risk analysis, integrated water resources management (IWRM), and teaching hydrology in West Africa and beyond.

Sen Hydro delimite le bassin versant en amont de tout point clique sur la carte, via l'API HTTP gratuite Global Watersheds (mghydro.com), basee sur les donnees MERIT-Hydro/HydroSHEDS. Comprend des options de calcul, un style personnalisable, un rapport du bassin versant, et un decoupage optionnel selon les limites communales du Senegal. Necessite une connexion internet.
plugins.author: Adiouma FALL - Geo Senegal

plugins.name: QuickMapCompare
plugins.description: Build a grid of side-by-side viewports in a dockable panel to compare QGIS layers, built-in tile basemaps, and web map providers at once, with per-viewport live sync to the main map canvas.
plugins.about: QuickMapCompare builds a grid of side-by-side "viewports" in a dockable panel, each showing a QGIS layer, a native WMS/XYZ tile basemap (OpenStreetMap, Esri, CartoDB, Google Maps, Bing Maps, and more), or an embedded Web Map Provider. Every viewport can live-sync to the main QGIS canvas as you pan and zoom, and layer/tile viewports support an on-canvas "Swipe Compare" gesture (hold S and drag) to compare directly against the live canvas with no separate window.
plugins.author: Pixeled Dimensions

plugins.name: Style Reloader for GeoServer
plugins.description: A QGIS plugin to sync layer styles from QGIS to GeoServer via REST API
plugins.about: Style Reloader allows you to export layer styles as SLD and push them directly to your GeoServer instance with one click.
plugins.author: Josep Quevedo i Pau Morell

plugins.name: PRA Divider
plugins.description: Divide polígonos em partes de áreas iguais para o Programa de Regularização Ambiental (PRA) do Brasil – APP e Reserva Legal.
plugins.about:
Plugin profissional para automatizar a divisão de polígonos em ciclos conforme exigido pelo Programa de Regularização Ambiental (PRA). Divide automaticamente áreas de APP em 5 partes iguais e áreas de Reserva Legal em 10 partes iguais, utilizando algoritmo otimizado de divisão por faixas com busca binária.

Automates the division of polygons into equal-area parts as required by Brazil's Programa de Regularização Ambiental (PRA). Automatically splits APP (Permanent Preservation Area) polygons into 5 equal parts and Reserva Legal (Legal Reserve) polygons into 10 equal parts, using an optimized strip-division algorithm with binary search. Requires layers in a projected UTM coordinate system.
plugins.author: Davi Kilmer

plugins.name: Natural Earth Downloader
plugins.description: Browse and download multiple Natural Earth vector datasets directly into QGIS.
plugins.about: Natural Earth Downloader provides a clean searchable catalogue for Natural Earth vector data. Select several datasets, choose GeoPackage, GeoJSON, ESRI Shapefile, or temporary QGIS layers, and download them as one batch. Downloads use QGIS network settings and are cached locally. Natural Earth data are public domain. This is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Natural Earth or NACIS.
plugins.author: ash2o

plugins.name: GeoCAR Amapá
plugins.description: Ferramenta de apoio para consulta e recorte da Base de Referência do CAR no Amapá. / Support tool for consulting and clipping the CAR Reference Database in Amapá.
plugins.about: O GeoCAR Amapá é uma ferramenta de apoio desenvolvida para auxiliar proprietários, possuidores, responsáveis técnicos e demais usuários na consulta e utilização da Base de Referência do Cadastro Ambiental Rural (CAR) no Estado do Amapá. O complemento permite realizar recortes das camadas de referência a partir do polígono do imóvel e disponibiliza informações e cálculos orientativos para apoiar a elaboração do cadastro. As informações geradas possuem caráter orientativo e não substituem a análise realizada pelo órgão ambiental competente.
plugins.author: Luís Lopes e Pedro Américo Jr

plugins.name: Floating Info Tool
plugins.description: Hover over features to see their attributes in a modern floating popup, with clickable hyperlinks and multi-layer support.
plugins.about: A toolbar-toggled hover identify tool. When enabled, hovering over a feature on the active layer shows its attributes in a clean floating popup next to the cursor. Hold Ctrl while hovering to query the topmost visible vector layer under the cursor, regardless of which layer is active. Press Shift to pin the popup in place so hyperlinks (web URLs, file paths and UNC shares) become clickable, and Shift again (or Esc) to release it. The mouse wheel scrolls the popup when its content overflows instead of zooming the map. While pinned, footer buttons let you copy the displayed attributes as tab-separated text, copy the feature itself (geometry and attributes) onto the QGIS clipboard like Edit - Copy Features, or edit attribute values inline and save them back to the layer through an undoable edit command. Light and dark popup themes are available (auto-follows the QGIS interface theme by default). Field aliases are respected, fields hidden in the attribute form are not shown, and values are rendered through their editor widget formatters (value maps, dates, checkboxes). Works alongside the current map tool without replacing it.
plugins.author: Ian Hay

plugins.name: Pobieranie Sentinel
plugins.description: Masowe pobieranie zdjęć Sentinel-2 (L2A/L1C) i Sentinel-1 (GRD) z Copernicus Data Space z gotowymi produktami: kompozycje RGB, CIR, SWIR, GEO oraz wskaźniki NDVI, NDWI, NDMI, NBR, NDSI, NDRE i mapa klas SCL — wszystko z gotową symbolizacją. / Bulk Sentinel downloader with ready-made composites and indices (Polish UI, simplified English description below).
plugins.about:
*** ENG description below ***
.
NARZĘDZIE W CAŁOŚCI PO POLSKU
Wyszukiwanie i masowe pobieranie zdjęć satelitarnych z oficjalnego serwisu Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. Wymagane darmowe konto na dataspace.copernicus.eu (wtyczka podpowiada, jak je założyć).
.
CO MOŻNA POBRAĆ:
- Sentinel-2 L2A — zdjęcia optyczne z korekcją atmosferyczną (polecane),
- Sentinel-2 L1C — surowe zdjęcia optyczne,
- Sentinel-1 GRD — obrazy radarowe (widzą przez chmury i w nocy).
.
OBSZAR ZAINTERESOWANIA:
- warstwa poligonowa z projektu QGIS albo plik GeoPackage (.gpkg).
.
FILTRY I WYBÓR SCEN:
- zakres dat, maksymalne zachmurzenie, limit liczby scen,
- strategie: wszystkie sceny / ręczny wybór z listy z ptaszkami / filtr miesięcy / automatycznie 3 najmniej zachmurzone sceny z każdego miesiąca.
.
POBIERANIE:
- do 4 pobierań równocześnie, automatyczne ponawianie po błędach,
- wznawianie przerwanych sesji (pominie to, co już jest na dysku),
- raport CSV z podsumowaniem, opcjonalne zapamiętanie loginu i hasła.
.
AUTOMATYCZNE PRODUKTY (GeoTIFF z gotową symbolizacją — od razu kolorowe w QGIS):
- kompozycje barwne: RGB (kolory naturalne), CIR (roślinność na czerwono), SWIR (rolnicza), GEO (geologiczna); obrzeża scen przezroczyste,
- wskaźniki z gotowymi paletami kolorów i legendą (pliki QML wczytywane automatycznie): NDVI (kondycja roślinności), NDWI (woda powierzchniowa), NDMI (uwodnienie roślin, susze), NBR (pogorzeliska), NDSI (śnieg i lód), NDRE (chlorofil, wczesny stres roślin),
- SCL — mapa klas terenu ESA z kolorową legendą (roślinność / gleba / woda / śnieg / chmury / cienie), idealna do maskowania chmur.
- Gotowe produkty mogą być automatycznie wczytane do projektu QGIS.
.
*** ENGLISH (SIMPLIFIED) ***
Polish-language QGIS plugin for bulk downloading Sentinel-2 (L2A/L1C) and Sentinel-1 (GRD) imagery from the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. Area of interest from a project layer or a GPKG file; date and cloud-cover filters; scene picker (all / manual checklist / month filter / 3 least cloudy scenes per month); up to 4 parallel downloads with automatic retries, session resuming and a CSV report. Automatic GeoTIFF products with ready-made symbology loaded into QGIS: RGB, CIR, SWIR and GEO composites (transparent scene edges), NDVI, NDWI, NDMI, NBR, NDSI and NDRE indices with colour ramps and legends (QML files), plus the ESA SCL scene classification map with a class legend.
plugins.author: Grzegorz Górniak

plugins.name: Coleta Rural
plugins.description: Imports Coleta Rural PDF survey reports and other memorial descritivo formats (any Brazilian state), automatically creating polygon features in QGIS vector layers — and generates memorial descritivo PDF reports from selected polygons, recognizing SIGEF/CAR public layers.
plugins.about: Plugin developed by Dihêgo Augusto Gomes Malvim de Barros, Technical Assistant for Land Governance at INCRA Pernambuco. It automatically imports Coleta Rural PDF survey reports from any Brazilian state (or memoriais descritivos from other sources, via text/PDF or a KML/GeoJSON/SHP/DXF geometry file), extracts parcel information and coordinates, generates polygon geometries, and saves features directly into configured QGIS vector layers. It can also generate a memorial descritivo PDF report (matching the official Coleta Rural layout, with a satellite basemap croqui) directly from one or more polygons already selected in a project layer — merging adjacent polygons into a single boundary when more than one is selected, and automatically recognizing SIGEF Brasil and CAR/SICAR public layer schemas to pre-fill CIR, Matrícula, Imóvel, Município and UF.
plugins.author: Dihêgo Augusto Gomes Malvim de Barros - INCRA Pernambuco

plugins.name: Map to HTML
plugins.description: Publish any number of QGIS layers as a standalone Leaflet/HTML/JS web map, each keeping its own symbology and labels.
plugins.about: Pick any number of layers from the current QGIS project and export a self-contained web map (HTML + per-layer GeoJSON/style JSON) that runs in any browser without a server, qgis2web-style. Each layer's symbology (marker color/size/shape, line, fill and hatch patterns, transparency, labels) is extracted from QGIS and carried over as-is, with a toggle panel to show/hide layers, a cross-layer text search bar, a sortable per-layer attribute table, and feature selection with CSV/GeoJSON export.
plugins.author: rinyu

plugins.name: QuickMapGif
plugins.description: Capture a sequence of map canvas frames and export them as an animated GIF.
plugins.about: QuickMapGif lets you manually capture a sequence of map canvas frames (with an extent-lock helper that detects and lets you correct accidental pan/zoom drift between captures) and assemble them into an animated GIF with configurable frame rate, loop count, scale, and ping-pong playback. No external dependencies (Pillow/ffmpeg) required — GIF encoding is fully self-contained.
plugins.author: Pixeled Dimensions

plugins.name: CRS Converter
plugins.description: Convert coordinates between reference systems: single point, CSV, and multi-sheet Excel files with per-sheet CRS, plus reprojection of already-loaded vector layers.
plugins.about: CRS Converter is a QGIS plugin for converting coordinates between coordinate reference systems (CRS). It supports manual entry of a single point, import/export of CSV files, and import/export of multi-sheet Excel (.xlsx) workbooks with automatic detection of X/Y columns and an individual source CRS per sheet. It can also reproject a vector layer already loaded in the current QGIS project and add the result to the project as a new layer. When the target CRS is geographic, coordinates are also displayed and exported in degrees-minutes-seconds (DMS) format. A detailed error log (.log) can be generated for CSV and Excel conversions, and a contextual Help button is available on every tab.
plugins.author: Dr EDEA O. Emile

plugins.name: 02truesize - Map Truth Lab
plugins.description: Drag countries or downloaded ADM0/ADM1 administrative vectors anywhere to compare true size, grade projection honesty and explore geodesy.
plugins.about: Maps lie: every flat map must distort the globe, and the everyday web map (Mercator) inflates whatever sits far from the equator — Greenland is drawn like a continent yet Africa is about 14 times larger. 02truesize brings the much-loved thetruesize.com idea natively into QGIS and then goes further. The True Size tool lets you grab any country from the bundled offline world layer, any polygon from your own layers, or country-selected ADM0/ADM1 vectors, and drag it across the map; the outline is re-projected on the fly through an equal-area azimuthal projection centred under your cursor, so it always covers its true ground area. ADM0 comes instantly from the bundled world data; ADM1 is filtered from Natural Earth's official public-domain 10m states/provinces archive, downloaded once per panel session. Size Duel is a built-in game: 4 countries are drawn in a 2x2 grid with individual bounding box zoom and you guess which one is really the biggest — the plugin keeps score and confesses how much the projection lied each round. The Distortion tab features a Projection Recommender & Optimizer, CRS report card, Tissot indicatrix circles and live canvas HUD. Truth Tools adds an antipode finder, great-circle comparison, interactive 2D Origin-Destination (OD) Area Ratio Matrix dialog with CSV export, and single-file interactive HTML Map Truth Lab report exporter. The core remains dependency-free with pure-Python geodesy and native QGIS map tools. A playful, accurate companion for teaching projections, scale and spatial reasoning. Developed with feedback from educational workflows at Dokuz Eylul University, Department of City and Regional Planning. Online User Manual & Documentation: https://yusufeminoglu.github.io/zero2truesize/ | If you find this plugin helpful, please consider starring the repository on GitHub (https://github.com/YusufEminoglu/zero2truesize)!
plugins.author: Yusuf Eminoglu

plugins.name: 02Urban Portrait - City as a Face
plugins.description: Create live urban portraits from built-in OSM downloads or project vectors, with luminance styling and print-ready export.
plugins.about: 02Urban Portrait transforms vector infrastructure into optical portraits, cartographic engravings, and graphic masks. Load a profile image, map it to a geographic frame, and style roads, buildings, points, or other vector layers from sampled pixel luminance without changing source geometries or attributes. Features interactive 3-stage visual workflow stepper with numbered circular badges, algorithmic vector stippling & halftone engraving generator, 10 curated artistic colorway presets with JSON import/export, prominent built-in OSM acquisition with live safety badges, live pan and zoom updates, and PNG/PDF/SVG export. Online User Manual & Documentation: https://yusufeminoglu.github.io/zero2urbanportrait/ | If you find this plugin helpful, please consider starring the repository on GitHub (https://github.com/YusufEminoglu/zero2urbanportrait)!
plugins.author: Yusuf Eminoglu

plugins.name: 02GeoQuest - Playable Map Studio
plugins.description: Turn any vector layer into a polished geography game, classroom challenge or public-engagement quest.
plugins.about: 02GeoQuest transforms ordinary QGIS vector layers into playful, useful challenges. Play Map Hunt directly on the QGIS canvas, compare attribute values, estimate distances, recognise polygon silhouettes, and test geodetic bearings in Compass Quest. Build mixed quests, import/export Quest Packs, keep local scoreboards, generate printable Achievement Certificates, and export standalone privacy-friendly HTML games that run fully offline. No account, API key, server or pip dependency is required. Developed with feedback from educational workflows at Dokuz Eylul University, Department of City and Regional Planning. Online User Manual & Documentation: https://yusufeminoglu.github.io/zero2geoquest/ | If you find this plugin helpful, please consider starring the repository on GitHub (https://github.com/YusufEminoglu/zero2geoquest)!
plugins.author: Yusuf Eminoglu

plugins.name: Hatt2GreekGrid
plugins.description: Georeference scanned Hatt-projection topographic diagrams and maps (small or large sheets) and transform them to the current Greek Grid / GGRS87 (EPSG:2100). Users add control points on an embedded Georeferencer-style UI canvas, define the map sheet by name or geographic coordinate centre (φ, λ), and export a world-file-ready TIFF or JPEG.
plugins.about: Hatt2GreekGrid converts topographic diagrams or maps referring to the Hatt azimuthal-equidistant projection (old Bessel datum) to the Greek Grid (EPSG:2100). It supports the small-to-large sheet centre change and former-to-new Bessel Helmert step, then applies the official OKXE per-sheet polynomials (or an analytic PROJ path) with live per-point and total RMS.
plugins.author: Assist. Professor Sevasti Chalkidou and Assist. Professor Angeliki Tsorlini (School of Rural and Surveying Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki,Greece)

plugins.name: Coordinate List Generator
plugins.description: Lists the coordinates of selected points, lines, and polygons under the desired heading in a projection system chosen by the user. Coordinates update automatically as the CRS is changed.
plugins.about: Coordinate List Generator lists the vertex coordinates of selected vector features (points, lines, and polygons) directly in a dockable panel, reprojected on the fly to any coordinate reference system you choose. Select a layer, pick an attribute field to use as the label for each feature, and select features on the map -- the list updates automatically whenever the selection or the target CRS changes. It works with multipart geometries and polygons with holes (interior rings listed separately), automatically calculates line length and polygon area in the target CRS (switching between metric units based on magnitude), and prompts for a second, distinctive field if several selected features share the same label value. A one-click "Copy Coordinates" button puts a tab-separated list on the clipboard ready to paste into Excel, and "Export to CSV" saves the full list (Label, Part, No, X, Y, Length, Cumulative Length, Heading, and Area) to a CSV file and opens it automatically. The panel automatically switches the map tool to feature selection when it opens, and back to Pan when it closes. Compatible with both QGIS 3 (PyQt5) and QGIS 4 (PyQt6).
plugins.author: LPRYLL

plugins.name: ColorGPX
plugins.description: GPX轨迹按速度/高度/坡度渲染及批量处理工具，支持工程图层、单个或多个GPX和extensions扩展字段。 / Render and batch-process GPX tracks by speed, elevation or slope from project layers or one/many GPX files, including extension fields.
plugins.about: 提取GPX轨迹的速度、高程和坡度信息，生成点、线或渐变线图层并进行彩色化渲染。统一支持QGIS工程图层、单个/多个GPX及文件夹批量输入，提供字段预检查、模拟速度、临时/独立文件/单一GeoPackage输出和结果报告。 / Extracts and renders speed, elevation and slope from GPX tracks. Supports project layers, one or many GPX files, and folder batches through a unified queue with capability checks, simulated speed, temporary/separate/single-GeoPackage outputs, and result reports.
plugins.author: OpenQGIS

plugins.name: SuperLayer
plugins.description: 使用分组树、文件夹树、思维导图、矩形树图或图层属性看板管理工程图层，支持地图主题过滤、同组拖动排序，以及移动、复制、备份物理文件和完整图层样式。/ Manage project layers with group and folder trees, mind maps, treemaps, or a layer property board, with map-theme filtering, same-group drag ordering, physical file operations, and complete layer-style transfer.
plugins.about: 通过分组树、文件夹树、思维导图、矩形树图和属性看板查看与管理 QGIS 图层。支持按当前画布或 QGIS 地图主题过滤图层、同组原生拖放排序、重复数据源大小去重、多选批量修改，以及移动、复制、备份物理文件并保留完整图层配置。/ View and manage QGIS layers through group and folder trees, mind maps, treemaps, and a property board. Filter by live canvas visibility or QGIS map themes, reorder layers within a group, avoid duplicate treemap sizes for shared data sources, batch-edit layer properties, and move, copy, or back up physical files while preserving complete layer configuration.
plugins.author: OpenQGIS

plugins.name: SWMM Sewer Builder
plugins.description: Professional QGIS plugin for sewer network design, longitudinal profile generation, drainage catchment delineation, cost estimation and EPA SWMM model creation.
plugins.about: SWMM Sewer Builder is a QGIS plugin for designing and analysing gravity sewer networks. It supports interactive pipe and manhole editing, longitudinal profile generation, hydraulic checks, drainage catchment creation, design storm definition, EPA SWMM INP export, SWMM simulation, storage nodes, pumps, weirs, orifices and GIS-based result mapping.
plugins.author: Marco Buoso

plugins.name: Raisz-style Relief
plugins.description: Presentation-quality relief rendering from a DEM in the style of Erwin Raisz hand-drawn physiographic maps: two algorithms (hybrid landform and classic oblique hachures) with a shared decoration layer - hypsometric or thematic draped fill, overlay layers for waters, roads, settlements, land cover textures, sheet decoration (frames, graticule ticks, scale bar, compass rose) and old-print emulation.
plugins.about: The plugin builds presentation-quality physiographic relief graphics from a DEM (Alpha & Winter 1971; Raisz 1931; oblique view with proportional displacement - Ridd 1963). Contour levels are made invisible; each relief point is shifted north proportionally to its height, so the higher the mountain, the taller its profile; fall lines with light-dependent density and hidden-surface removal by a floating horizon form the correct oblique view. Two algorithms: "Landform map" (a hybrid of Mower-style morphometry and hachures at working resolution with variable plains density) and "Classic physiographic" (full resolution, uniform hachuring, memory control with optional strip tiling). A shared decoration layer (all optional): monochrome sepia paper, hypsometric fill from elevation (Patterson, Bartholomew, Peucker, Imhof palettes) or thematic fill colored from the QGIS layer style; the fill is draped over the displaced relief; separate water layers (rivers, lakes, seas, marshes) drawn in ink on paper presets and in blue on colored fills; roads; settlements with labels; land cover textures; large-form shading (flat shadow or anaglyptography engraving); sheet decoration (frames including a checkered map border, graticule tick labels in D°MM', old-style scale bar, compass rose) and old-print emulation (dot screen, paper grain, color misregistration). Vector layers are reprojected and clipped to the DEM extent automatically. Output - PNG, SVG or PDF. Requires numpy, scipy, matplotlib, rasterio, shapely (>=2.0), pyproj and affine -- all bundled with QGIS/OSGeo4W.
plugins.author: Maksim Boiko

plugins.name: Vectorel Digitizer Pro QGIS3
plugins.description: Vectorel Digitizer Pro QGIS3 is a QGIS3 plugin for creating and editing vector features by entering, pasting or modifying numerical vertex coordinates. Includes a map-based polygon drawing tool with live area calculation. Also simultaneously converts coordinates according to CRS selection.
plugins.about:
Vectorel Digitizer Pro QGIS3 adds three tools to the QGIS3 vector editing toolbar.
1. Add By Coordinates: create new features by typing vertex coordinates with real-time area calculation.
2. Coordinate Editor: edit existing features numerically, with copy/paste and reprojection support and real-time area display.
3. Drawing Digitizer: draw polygons directly on the map canvas with an editable coordinate table and real-time area display.
Supports Point, Line, Polygon, Multi-part and Z/M geometries. Coordinate reprojection on the fly.
plugins.author: LPRYLL

plugins.name: GEE LULC Toolkit
plugins.description: Land-use/land-cover mapping with Google Earth Engine: load Sentinel-1/2 and Landsat composites, compute spectral indices, create and label sample points, run supervised or unsupervised classification with accuracy assessment, and build a print-ready map.
plugins.about: An end-to-end land-use/land-cover (LULC) classification workflow powered by Google Earth Engine inside QGIS. One combined window guides you from image loading to a finished map: composites and spectral indices, stratified sample points, point labeling (LULC, ESA WorldCover, or custom schemes) with a 4-view labeling window, Random Forest / GBT / CART / SVM or unsupervised clustering, Olofsson area-adjusted accuracy with 95 percent confidence intervals, Jeffries-Matusita separability, and a map layout builder. Requires the earthengine-api Python package in the QGIS Python environment and a Google Cloud project registered for Earth Engine.
plugins.author: YAM Sarath

plugins.name: Podaris
plugins.description: Podaris tools for transport and accessibility analysis in QGIS. Our first tool downloads DfT Transport Connectivity Metric scores (unofficial, unaffiliated with the Department for Transport) for any area of England and Wales as a styled, ready-to-analyse layer.
plugins.about: Podaris is a growing toolkit of transport-planning tools for QGIS. Tools appear in the Processing Toolbox under the "Podaris" provider. The first is "Download connectivity data", which fetches DfT Transport Connectivity Metric scores (walking, cycling, public transport, driving; by journey purpose) for a chosen extent at grid100, OA, LSOA, LAD or Region level and loads them as a styled polygon layer. Please note: that connectivity tool is unofficial, created by Podaris and unaffiliated with the Department for Transport; the DfT has had no involvement in creating it. Data is fetched from the free Podaris connectivity API. A free API key is required and can be requested from within the plugin. Data source: Department for Transport, Transport Connectivity Metric 2025. Contains public sector information (c) Crown copyright 2025, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
plugins.author: Podaris

plugins.name: ABCoord
plugins.description: Interactive tool for coordinate conversion, plotting, and inspection across multiple systems.
plugins.about: ABCoord is an interactive QGIS plugin designed for dynamic coordinate transformation. It allows users to input, parse, and plot coordinates from various text formats (such as Decimal Degrees, GMS, and WKT). Additionally, it features a map canvas inspection tool that captures mouse clicks to instantly display coordinates across multiple Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS) simultaneously.
plugins.author: Matheus Durso Neves Caetano

plugins.name: Observearth
plugins.description: Discover, visualize, and analyze satellite imagery with advanced spectral indices directly in QGIS.
plugins.about:
Observearth is a powerful QGIS plugin developed by the makers of Observearth (https://observearth.com) for discovering, visualizing, and analyzing satellite imagery directly within QGIS. The plugin integrates seamlessly with STAC (SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog) services, allowing users to search, preview, and process Earth observation imagery without leaving their GIS workflow.

Designed for GIS professionals, researchers, agronomists, environmental analysts, and remote sensing specialists, Observearth simplifies satellite data analysis with a fast, intuitive, and efficient interface.

Key Features:
• Search satellite imagery using STAC catalogs.
• Filter imagery by date range, cloud cover, satellite mission, and area of interest.
• Generate and visualize spectral indices such as NDVI, EVI, and many more.
• Display imagery directly within QGIS.
• Automatic raster rendering with optimized visualization.
• View raster statistics including minimum, maximum, mean, and standard deviation.
• Fast loading and efficient processing for large datasets.
• Cloud-optimized workflows with seamless Observearth integration.

Whether you're monitoring crop health, assessing vegetation, tracking environmental changes, or analyzing land cover, Observearth provides a streamlined workflow for accessing and analyzing satellite imagery—all from within QGIS.
plugins.author: Observearth

plugins.name: Parametric Process
plugins.description: Parametric Generative Design and Multi-Objective Evolutionary Optimization Studio for QGIS.
plugins.about: Parametric Process is a standalone generative urban design and multi-objective evolutionary optimization lab for QGIS. Build reusable Grasshopper-style visual rule workflows, select urban block/parcel layers, run NSGA-II evolutionary simulations across density, daylight, carbon, and urban quality metrics, analyze Pareto trade-offs, preview 3D phenotypes in real time, and sync reviewed solutions directly into QGIS vector layers. Online User Manual & Documentation: https://yusufeminoglu.github.io/parametric_process/ | If you find this plugin helpful, please consider starring the repository on GitHub (https://github.com/YusufEminoglu/parametric_process)!
plugins.author: Yusuf Eminoglu

plugins.name: Zapisz projekt do GPKG (warstwy i style)
plugins.description: Zapisuje wybrane warstwy projektu do jednego pliku GeoPackage razem z symbolizacją (styl domyślny w GPKG) i kolejnością warstw — cały projekt w jednym pliku, idealny do wysyłki. / Exports selected layers to a single GeoPackage with embedded default styles and preserved layer order — your entire project in one file.
plugins.about:
NARZĘDZIE W CAŁOŚCI PO POLSKU
Cały projekt w jednym pliku — bez zgubionej symbolizacji. Wtyczka zapisuje wybrane warstwy wektorowe do JEDNEGO pliku GeoPackage (.gpkg) razem z ich kolorami, etykietami i stylami, zachowując kolejność warstw z panelu.

DLACZEGO TO WYGODNE:
- jeden plik .gpkg zamiast dziesiątek shapefile'ów — wysyłasz mailem jak zwykły załącznik,
- symbolizacja jest osadzona W ŚRODKU pliku jako styl domyślny — odbiorca po przeciągnięciu pliku do QGIS widzi mapę dokładnie taką jak u Ciebie,
- koniec z klasycznym problemem "po eksporcie wszystko szare",
- opcjonalnie w pliku osadzany jest też cały projekt QGIS (kolejność i widoczność warstw) — odbiorca otwiera go przez Projekt -> Otwórz z -> GeoPackage.

WYBÓR WARSTW:
- tylko wyświetlane warstwy (domyślnie),
- wszystkie warstwy projektu,
- ręczny wybór z listy z ptaszkami (z przyciskami zaznacz/odznacz wszystkie).

DODATKOWO:
- kolejność warstw na mapie i na liście zostaje zachowana,
- nazwy warstw są automatycznie czyszczone i unikalne,
- warstwy rastrowe są grzecznie pomijane (z informacją w logu),
- pasek postępu i czytelny log po polsku.

*** ENGLISH ***
YOUR ENTIRE PROJECT IN ONE FILE, WITH SYMBOLOGY PRESERVED
The plugin exports selected vector layers to a single GeoPackage file (.gpkg) together with their colors, labels, and styles. Styles are embedded directly in the GeoPackage and set as default styles. As a result, when the recipient drags the file into QGIS, the map is displayed with the same symbology as in the original project. The layer order is preserved. Optionally, the complete QGIS project can also be stored inside the GeoPackage.

INSTALLATION:
1. In QGIS, open Plugins > Manage and Install Plugins...
2. Select the Install from ZIP tab.
3. Select the zapisz_projekt_gpkg.zip file and click Install Plugin.
4. The "Zapisz projekt do GPKG" button will appear on the QGIS toolbar.

HOW TO USE:
1. Open your QGIS project and click the plugin button.
2. Select the location where the .gpkg file should be saved.
3. Select the layers to export: visible layers only (default), all layers, or selected layers chosen manually from the checklist.
4. Click ZAPISZ DO GPKG and monitor the export progress on the progress bar.

HOW TO OPEN THE FILE:
- Drag the .gpkg file into the QGIS window — the layers will be loaded with their predefined symbology.
- Or select Project > Open From > GeoPackage to open the complete project layout with a single action.

NOTES:
- Only vector layers are exported to the GeoPackage; raster layers are skipped and reported in the log.
- An existing file with the same name will be overwritten after confirmation.
- QGIS 3.16 or later is required; no additional software or dependencies are needed.
plugins.author: Grzegorz Górniak

plugins.name: Raster Statistics Along Line
plugins.description: Computes raster statistics along vector line features.
plugins.about:
Extracts raster pixel values intersected by each line feature using
Amanatides-Woo traversal and computes per-feature statistics.
Supports optional directional raster band.
plugins.author: fwedya

plugins.name: SateAIs API for QGIS
plugins.description: Run SateAIs SAR satellite detection (ship, oil slick, new building, disappear building, time series) directly from QGIS.
plugins.about: SateAIs is a SAR satellite image analysis platform (currently supporting Sentinel-1). This plugin lets GIS users invoke detection jobs from QGIS, view results as map layers, and manage jobs without leaving the QGIS environment. Requires a SateAIs API key from https://console.spcsft.com.
plugins.author: SpaceShift Inc.

plugins.name: Flash Features
plugins.description: Flash all, selected, or individual features on the map canvas — from the Layers panel, attribute table toolbar, attribute table right-click menu, or the plugin toolbar.
plugins.about:
Adds quick "flash" actions in three places:

Plugin toolbar (two buttons):
• Flash selected features — flashes selected features on the active layer (red)
• Flash selected vs rest — flashes selected features red and all other visible features blue simultaneously

Layers panel context menu (right-click a vector layer):
• Flash selected features
• Flash selected vs rest

Attribute table:
• Toolbar buttons — same two actions as above, acting on the table's own layer
• Row right-click — "Flash this feature" flashes the individual row you right-clicked
• Hover — moving the mouse over a row flashes that feature (debounced, 120 ms)

Compatible with QGIS 3 (Qt5/PyQt5) and QGIS 4 (Qt6/PyQt6) via runtime detection.
No external dependencies.
plugins.author: Ian Hay

plugins.name: quickdraw tools
plugins.description: Draw simple shapes fast and add them straight to the Map Registry as memory& shape layers.
plugins.about: quickdraw Tools speeds up on-the-fly digitizing in QGIS: point, line, rectangle, circle, polygon and buffer tools that write straight into memory layers, with configurable fill/stroke colors, stroke width, remembered layers and attribute field name, all saved between sessions.
plugins.author: leonya ivanchikov

plugins.name: Kakao QGIS Bridge
plugins.description: Dock-based Kakao Map and Roadview viewer with bidirectional QGIS synchronization and Local search.
plugins.about: Shows Kakao Maps JavaScript API content inside a QGIS dock widget and synchronizes QGIS, Kakao Map, and Roadview in both directions. Includes Local place/address search, Roadview position/direction display, Kakao Mobility route search, route guidance, and route history import/export. Requires user-provided Kakao JavaScript and REST API keys. Kakao tile URLs are not extracted or used as XYZ/TMS layers.
plugins.author: yjkim

plugins.name: GeoAutomation BR
plugins.description:
Labels automaticos de area em poligonos, com unidades agrarias brasileiras, SRC UTM SIRGAS e filtro por camadas selecionadas.
Automatic area labels for polygon layers, with Brazilian agrarian units, SIRGAS UTM CRS and multi-layer selection filter.
plugins.about:
GeoAutomation BR aplica labels de área automaticamente em camadas de polígonos do QGIS.
