O calculo usa SRC projetado (UTM SIRGAS 2000, SAD69 e Polyconic), com sugestão de zona UTM a partir do mapa, validação de CRS geográficos e SRC favoritos. Unidades disponíveis: m², ha, km², acre, alqueire, alqueire paulista, alqueire do norte, alqueirão, tarefa baiana e braça quadrada (ordem alfabética, com favoritos). Inclui barra de ferramentas para exibir/ocultar labels, filtrar por camadas selecionadas no painel (múltipla seleção com Ctrl+clique, independente de Exibir labels) e dialogo de configuração com fonte, cor, buffer e casas decimais. Opcao de aplicar labeling somente em camadas novas adicionadas ao projeto, preservando camadas já existentes quando desejado.

GeoAutomation BR applies automatic area labels to polygon vector layers in QGIS. Area is calculated in a projected CRS (SIRGAS 2000 UTM, SAD69 UTM and Brazil Polyconic), with automatic replacement of geographic CRS, UTM zone suggestion from the map extent and favorite CRS presets. Supported units include m², ha, km², acre and Brazilian agrarian measures (alqueire, alqueirao, tarefa baiana, braca quadrada and others), listed alphabetically with favorites. Toolbar controls toggle all labels, filter by layers selected in the layer tree (Ctrl+click for multiple layers, independent from the global labels toggle) and a settings dialog for font, color, buffer and decimal places. Optional auto-apply on newly added layers only.
plugins.author: Jurubeba

plugins.name: Plantation Tools (Community Edition)
plugins.description: Professional Spatial Analysis Tools for Oil Palm Plantations and Infrastructure.
plugins.about: Professional Spatial Analysis Tools for Oil Palm Plantations. Supports road network analysis, drainage, hydrology, intercropping, planting distance mapping, AI-based palm tree detection, and drone mission planning.
plugins.author: Ahza Studio

plugins.name: Cadastral Parcel Extractor
plugins.description: Identifies all cadastral land parcels affected by transmission line safety corridors using native QGIS processing algorithms.
plugins.about: Automated PyQGIS plugin for calculating transmission line corridor buffers, auto-detecting UTM projections, extracting affected cadastral land parcels, generating CSV reports, and merging outputs.
plugins.author: Vicky Sharma

plugins.name: ClipToCAD
plugins.description: Copy selected QGIS features to AutoCAD as PLINE/POINT command text. Multi-layer selections, projected metres only, unit presets, and auto parcel-ID labels.
plugins.about:
ClipToCAD copies selected vector features from QGIS to the clipboard as AutoCAD command-line text (_PLINE, _POINT, _TEXT) for Ctrl+V into AutoCAD, AutoCAD LT (Real World mode), BricsCAD, or ZWCAD — no DXF export.
Select features on one or more layers. Coordinates stay in projected metres (geographic CRS is blocked). Multi-layer copy uses one destination CRS and matching CAD layers.
Local mode (AutoLISP) inserts at a clicked point and scales metres to metric links, Gunter links, feet, yards, or inches.
Parcel labels use Auto: each layer's parcel_id or Sy.No if present. FID is never copied as a label.
Designed for land surveyors, civil engineers, and subdivision draftsmen.
plugins.author: B Mehaboob, SIFA Geolabs

plugins.name: Attribute Batch Editor
plugins.description: Batch edit attribute values with prefix, suffix, replace, find and replace, auto increment, fill empty, boolean, and date operations.
plugins.about: A powerful plugin for batch editing attribute values in vector layers. Supports multiple operations: Add Prefix/Suffix, Replace Values, Remove Text (with regex), Find and Replace (with regex and exact match), Auto Increment (numbers and letters), Fill Empty (only null/empty values), Boolean (Set True, Set False, Toggle), and Date/Time (Set Date, Add Days, Subtract Days). Works with all features or selected features only. Includes undo support, live preview, and field type validation.
plugins.author: LPRYLL

plugins.name: RegenGIS Landscape Analysis Toolkit - for Regenerative Land Design
plugins.description: This plugin gives access to spatial analysis tools that support Regenerative Land Design such as agroforestry, permaculture and food forests.
plugins.about:
This plugin provides spatial analysis tools for regenerative landscape design, including hydrology, microclimate and CRS preparation workflows.
Some algorithms require the QGIS GRASS Processing Provider and may not run until that provider is installed and available.
GRASS support depends on the operating system, QGIS version and installation package. See the README for platform guidance and installation notes.
plugins.author: RegenGIS.com

plugins.name: CRS Doctor
plugins.description: Detect and fix coordinate reference system (CRS) problems across all project layers in one click.
plugins.about:
CRS Doctor scans every layer in your project and reports CRS health with severity levels:
missing or invalid CRS (critical), suspicious extents suggesting a wrongly assigned CRS (critical),
layers not matching the project CRS (warning), and geographic-CRS layers where distance/area
measurements would be computed in degrees (warning). Each issue comes with a one-click fix:
assign a CRS, reproject a single layer, or batch-harmonize the entire project into one target CRS
(with automatic UTM zone suggestion). Vector layers are reprojected with the native engine and
raster layers with GDAL warp. All fixes are non-destructive: original layers are preserved and
reprojected copies are added to the project. No external dependencies required.
plugins.author: Lokesh Sahu

plugins.name: STAT GEOM QC
plugins.description: Quality control and geometric statistics for vector layers, with a correctness score and exportable report.
plugins.about: STAT GEOM QC analyses QGIS vector layers and detects quality issues: null or empty geometries, invalid geometries, self-intersections, overlaps/intersections between polygons, duplicates, small polygons (optional, configurable m² threshold), duplicate vertices (optional), holes in polygons (optional, with an area threshold so that large justified holes are kept) and multipart features. Overlap detection is strictly topological — interiors that intersect, however slightly, with no metric tolerance — so a shared boundary or a single point of contact is never reported. An "Extras" section adds three optional checks: sharp angles (spike vertices), vertices that are too close together, and the height of nested polygons - when a polygon lies entirely inside another, its elevation must be strictly greater than the containing polygon's. The AGL and HEIGHT fields are matched case-insensitively and each is compared with its own counterpart; only the inner polygon is flagged, a missing or non-numeric value makes the pair "not verifiable" rather than compliant, and a layer carrying neither field marks the check as not run instead of reporting zero. The overlap check has exactly two exceptions, both off by default and presented as sub-choices of the check itself: ignore overlaps caused by a missing vertex on the shared wall, and ignore polygons entirely contained in another. Neither has any threshold to set. Duplicate vertex detection is likewise threshold-free: only exactly superimposed vertices count. The panel header shows the installed version. Any indicator tied to a control that did not run is labelled "not requested" instead of a misleading zero, and such a control is excluded from the correctness score and its breakdown, so a score is never a verdict on a dimension that was never measured. It computes a weighted correctness score (0-100), shows a modern summary (gauge, indicators, breakdown) and produces an exportable report (HTML/CSV/JSON). Built-in QGIS actions: select flagged features, create a point error layer locating each issue exactly (self-intersection nodes for invalid geometries, representative point otherwise), and selective geometry repair (checkboxes) that writes the result to a NEW file without modifying the source layer. Native PyQGIS port of the STAT GEOM application, with no external dependencies.
plugins.author: Adel.bchini@gmail.com

plugins.name: Georef-Ar
plugins.description: Complemento oficial para acceder a las funcionalidades de la API Georef desde QGIS.
plugins.about:
Georef-Ar es el complemento oficial que integra las principales funcionalidades de la API Georef directamente en QGIS, facilitando la consulta y utilización de información geográfica oficial de la República Argentina sin salir del entorno de trabajo.
A través del complemento es posible consultar unidades territoriales, normalizar y georreferenciar direcciones, realizar geocodificación inversa y localizar establecimientos y organismos públicos cercanos. Los resultados se incorporan al proyecto como capas geográficas o se presentan como información asociada, según la funcionalidad utilizada.
El complemento utiliza la API Georef, servicio del Sistema de Normalización de Direcciones y Unidades Territoriales de la República Argentina, desarrollada y mantenida por la Dirección de Datos Abiertos de la Secretaría de Innovación, Ciencia y Tecnología de la Nación, que integra información proveniente de fuentes oficiales para brindar servicios de normalización y georreferenciación de datos geográficos.
Este complemento es un desarrollo oficial de la Dirección de Datos Abiertos y constituye la forma recomendada de utilizar la API Georef desde QGIS.
plugins.author: Datos Argentina

plugins.name: GeoClick Capture
plugins.description: Verify locations across online, offline and QGIS sources with evidence, review and auditable reports.
plugins.about: GeoClick Capture 2.0.1 provides a unified Location Verification Workspace for comparing online search results, institutional gazetteers, existing QGIS features, polygon or line centroids and manual coordinates. Users explicitly select a preferred source after reviewing transparent trust, agreement and recommendation scores; attach local files or URLs with SHA-256 evidence hashes; create a temporary comparison layer; persist the workspace in the QGIS project; import candidate CSV or shareable workspace packages; and export a ZIP verification bundle containing JSON, HTML, CSV tables, a manifest and copied attachments. Version 2.0.1 corrects workspace persistence on QGIS 4 by using the QgsProject entry API. Earlier capabilities include Review Queue, Offline Gazetteer, Match & Verify, Nominatim search, coordinates, map URLs, snapping, sessions, reverse geocoding and CSV, GeoJSON and GeoPackage export. The plugin supports QGIS 3.28+, QGIS 4 / Qt 6 and has no external Python dependencies.
plugins.author: Jubílio Maússe

plugins.name: Flurstückssuche DE
plugins.description: Flurstücke deutschlandweit finden und darstellen
plugins.about:
Dieses Plugin ermöglicht eine fast deutschlandweite Suche nach Flurstücken (Bayern wird aktuell nicht unterstützt).
Funktionsweise:
- Eingabe von Gemarkung / Flur / Flurstück oder Flurstückskennzeichen
- Flurstück wird über WFS-Anfragen gesucht
- Treffer wird als Layer in QGIS eingebunden

Es ist auch eine inverse Flurstückssuche (Klick in die Karte) möglich.

[EN]: This plugin enables parcel searches across almost all of Germany (Bavaria is currently not supported).
plugins.author: David Koster

plugins.name: GeomorphKit
plugins.description: A high-performance, multiscale geomorphometry suite featuring memory-chunking and Numba-accelerated Geomorphon generation.
plugins.about: GeomorphKit calculates Slope, Aspect, Profile Curvature, Planform Curvature, Multiscale TPI, Multiscale TRI, and Geomorphons without crashing on massive DEMs.
plugins.author: Dr. Anass Marzouki

plugins.name: Easy Layout
plugins.description: A step-by-step wizard for creating guides, zones, thematic maps, multimaps, cartographic headers, footers, text, titles, and maps in QGIS Print Layout.
plugins.about: Developed by Prof. Dr. Antonio Henrique Cordeiro Ramalho and Flávio Hebert da Silva Fonseca (Grupo Amazônico de Pesquisas Geoespaciais GAPEG).
plugins.author: Prof. Dr. Antonio Henrique Cordeiro Ramalho and Flávio Hebert da Silva Fonseca

plugins.name: Collaboration
plugins.description: Real-time QGIS collaboration with shared cursors and geographic annotations.
plugins.about:
Collaboration connects QGIS users over a local network through an integrated TCP relay.
Participants can see each other's presence and cursors, create geographic annotations,
edit any shared annotation, and delete annotations for everyone. Users who connect later
automatically receive the current annotation state. The plugin does not create or modify
vector layers and requires no external Python dependencies. Annotations remain available
while the host relay is running. The current protocol has no encryption or authentication,
so it should be used on trusted networks or through a VPN.
plugins.author: Fernando Bojorquez

plugins.name: Sen Couverture Terrestre
plugins.description: Per-commune analysis for Senegal: Sentinel-2 land cover (Living Atlas), soil type and estimated fertility (Morpho_Pedo), and relief (DEM).
plugins.about:
This plugin lets you pick a commune (municipality) in Senegal, zoom to it automatically, download and clip Sentinel-2 10m land cover (ArcGIS Living Atlas, 2017-2024) to its exact boundary, and display soil type statistics (estimated fertility) and relief statistics from reference layers bundled with the plugin (communes and pedology, no manual import needed). Relief includes min/max/mean altitude, elevation range, mean/min/max slope, and FAO slope-class breakdown. The DEM can be selected as an external file, processed entirely in the background and never added to the layers panel.
French description: Ce plugin permet de selectionner une commune du Senegal, de zoomer automatiquement dessus, de telecharger et decouper la couverture terrestre Sentinel-2 10m (ArcGIS Living Atlas, 2017-2024) sur sa limite exacte, et d'afficher des statistiques de type de sol (fertilite estimee) et de relief a partir des couches de reference integrees au plugin (communes et pedologie embarquees, aucun import manuel necessaire). Le relief inclut l'altitude min/max/moyenne, le denivele, la pente moyenne/min/max et sa repartition par classes FAO. Le MNT peut etre selectionne en fichier exterieur, traite entierement en arriere-plan sans jamais etre ajoute au panneau des couches.
plugins.author: ADIOUMA FALL -Géo

plugins.name: Multiband Zonal Stats
plugins.description: High-throughput continuous and categorical zonal statistics for multiband rasters and multipart polygon layers.
plugins.about: A QGIS Processing plugin for producing tidy zonal-statistics CSV files from multiband rasters and polygon or multipolygon layers. It is purpose-built for multiband rasters, processing every band in one pass — something QGIS's own zonal-statistics tools do not do.
plugins.author: Mukesh Ray

plugins.name: 法术网优工具
plugins.description: 通信网优专用工具，支持基站扇区图层生成、邻区关系规划、PCI规划等
plugins.about: This is a tool for sector creation, neighbor planning, and PCI planning. 这是一个基站扇区制作、邻区规划、PCI规划的工具 Functions: 1. Batch import station Excel data 2. Generate cell coverage vector layer 3. Neighbor planning 4. PCI planning Developed for telecom engineers.
plugins.author: 法术沉默

plugins.name: SwathProfile4QGIS
plugins.description: 横截面剖面提取工具 / Swath profile extraction tool
plugins.about: 从栅格数据沿基线提取横截面剖面，支持交互式图表面板、一键曲线平滑、动态自定义纵坐标、参数覆盖与数据导出。 / Extract swath profiles from raster along baselines with interactive chart, curve smoothing, custom Y-axis, parameter override and export.
plugins.author: OpenQGIS

plugins.name: GeoSTAT AI
plugins.description: Automatic quality analysis of vector layers: invalid geometries, duplicates, small/thin polygons, self-intersections, empty attributes... with a quality score out of 100 and an HTML/PDF report.
plugins.about: GeoSTAT AI is a quality-assurance (QA/QC) plugin for QGIS. To use it: open the plugin (toolbar icon or Vector menu), select a vector layer, tick the checks you want to run and adjust thresholds if needed, then click "Run analysis". The plugin automatically scans the layer and detects invalid geometries, duplicate features, very small polygons, very thin polygons, multipart geometries, empty attributes, very short segments and self-intersections. It computes a quality score out of 100 and generates a detailed report with statistics and recommendations, which you can export to HTML or PDF. Interface available in French and English.
plugins.author: Wassim Lamloumi

plugins.name: MJ Centerline
plugins.description: Extract medial axis centerline from polygon layers (roads, rivers, canals, drainage networks)
plugins.about: MJ Centerline is a QGIS plugin for extracting centerlines from polygon features using medial axis approach. Users can select polygon layers such as roads, rivers, canals, drainage channels and other linear features. The plugin generates separate centerline features for each polygon branch while maintaining original geometry information. Suitable for road network analysis, river mapping, irrigation channels, drainage studies, GIS surveys, and infrastructure projects. Developed by MJNETWORK. You can support development via donation using PhonePe: <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mmjayswal/QG_Code/main/GIS_Donation.JPG"><b>Click here to View UPI QR Code</b></a>
plugins.author: MJNETWORK

plugins.name: AcuGIS Cloud Publisher
plugins.description: Publish entire QGIS project directories to AcuGIS Cloud and update existing published projects.
plugins.about: Publish and update QGIS projects on AcuGIS Cloud (QGIS Publish Service).
plugins.author: AcuGIS

plugins.name: TECRS Building Height Extractor
plugins.description: Extracts building heights from VHR satellite imagery shadows using vertex-comb ray casting.
plugins.about: The TECRS Building Height Extractor is a geospatial processing tool designed to estimate building heights from Very High-Resolution (VHR) satellite imagery. By inputting 2D building footprints, shadow polygons, and the image capture time, the plugin automatically computes the solar azimuth and elevation angles. It utilizes a Vertex Comb ray-casting algorithm to accurately associate buildings with their cast shadows, calculates the maximum shadow length, and computes the building height in meters using ellipsoidal trigonometry. This tool is ideal for urban planning and remote sensing workflows where 3D extraction from 2D optical imagery is required.
plugins.author: TECRSLab

plugins.name: Reference Grid Labeler
plugins.description: Add a ready-made atlas-style reference grid - lettered columns, numbered rows - to any map in a few clicks.
plugins.about: Adds the classic atlas-style search grid - lettered columns, numbered rows - to any QGIS project, with ready-to-use grid and label layers. See the bundled user guide for full installation and usage instructions.
plugins.author: Abdul Fuseini

plugins.name: Parcel Annotation Pro
plugins.description: Automatically annotate parcel polygons with side lengths, area, perimeter, bearings, azimuths, vertex numbers and parcel information. Built for land surveyors and cadastral mapping professionals.
plugins.about: Parcel Annotation Pro is a professional cadastral annotation toolkit for QGIS. It generates side-length, area, perimeter, bearing, azimuth and vertex-number labels for one, many, or all parcels in a layer, keeps them live-updated when geometry changes, and exports finished annotation sets to DXF, PDF layouts, Shapefile or GeoPackage. Includes coordinate tables, bearing & distance tables, parcel schedules and automatic parcel numbering.
plugins.author: Yussuf Waridi

plugins.name: Stack Bands S2
plugins.description: Stack raster bands (e.g. Sentinel-2) into a single GeoTIFF while preserving each band's name
plugins.about: This plugin lets you select a folder of raster bands (e.g. Sentinel-2 R10m bands), choose the stacking order, and generate a GeoTIFF where each band's original name is preserved in the GDAL metadata. The resulting layer is automatically loaded into QGIS.
plugins.author: Dr EDEA O. Emile

plugins.name: xDEM
plugins.description: A wide range of high-level operations required for analyzing elevation data.
plugins.about:
This plugin is part of the xDEM Python package, a collaboration between CNES (the French space agency) and GlacioHack (a group of glaciology researchers).

Python dependencies are installed automatically the first time the plugin runs. The installation may take a few minutes, please do not close QGIS during this process.
plugins.author: CNES GlacioHack

plugins.name: Topo
plugins.description: L'outil "Topo"/"Topo" tool
plugins.about: En: Transform the boundaries of geological formations and structural elements into polygons, with attributes derived from the input point layer codes. Fr: Transforme les contours des formations géologiques et les éléments structuraux en polygones ayant comme attribut les codes issus de la couche ponctuelle d'entrée.
plugins.author: Alexandre Demidov BRGM

plugins.name: Planes, Trains and Automobiles (plus others)
plugins.description: Animate point to point transport routes without the need for temporal attributes.
plugins.about: The plugin builds animated routes from point layers. Choose a fan-in destination (legs from every place to one hub) or an ordered multi-leg route, and a marker travels along each trail. Vehicles include plane, ship, car, train, or a custom SVG/PNG marker. Every layer is collected into a "route-tracker" layer group and all layers animate together off one shared clock. Playback and the set of animation layers are saved with the QGIS project and restored when it is reopened. Frames can be exported as a PNG sequence (with an ffmpeg command) or a self-contained HTML viewer. This is a visualisation aid, not a navigation product: the coastline mask is coarse and routes may not use canals or narrow straits.
plugins.author: Ian Hay

plugins.name: Template Peta Desa
plugins.description: Automated layout generator and professional presentation tool for Village Maps based on Indonesian Geospatial Agency (BIG) standards.
plugins.about: A professional QGIS 3.x plugin to automatically generate Village Map Layouts (Imagery, Infrastructure, and Land Cover) complete with map frames, legends, insets, scale bars, and SRGI 2013 metadata.
plugins.author: Ahza Studio

plugins.name: Layer or Table Comparison Tool
plugins.description: Compares vector layers and tables to find differences between selected fields
plugins.about: Professional tool for comparing vector layers and tables based on an alphanumeric field (codes, IDs, names, etc.). Offers three comparison modes: Only in Layer 1 (values present solely in the first layer), Only in Layer 2 (values present solely in the second layer), and Matches (identifies values existing in both layers but with different record counts). Generates detailed statistics such as total records per layer, unique values per layer, exact matches, quantity differences, and exclusive elements from each layer. Automatically creates a temporary table with the analysis results. Includes a progress bar for visual tracking, a log panel with real-time process details, and a user-friendly interface with color-coded buttons. Ideal for validation and quality control of geographic data, data migration, source integration, inventory auditing, and detection of missing or surplus records.
plugins.author: Raul Viquez

plugins.name: Géométrie RATF
plugins.description: Validation géométrique RATF pour QGIS
plugins.about: Outil permettant de valider les géométries polygonales selon les normes RATF/PRAN. Validates polygon geometry according to the RATF/PRAN standard.
plugins.author: JFB

plugins.name: Sen Climate
plugins.description: Automatic calculation of spectral and climate indices (NDVI, NDWI, NDBI, LST, brightness temperature, VHI, land cover, etc.) by commune/region, by year and optionally by month in Senegal, with an exportable interpretation report.
plugins.about: This plugin automatically downloads the required Landsat bands (Esri Landsat/MS service, no file needed) for a chosen commune or region of Senegal, a chosen year (2013-present) and optionally a specific month, computes 19 spectral indices (NDVI, EVI, GNDVI, SAVI, DVI, NDWI, MNDWI, LSWI, NDBI, UI, CVI, TVI, RVI, DPSI, VARI, ARVI, BSI, NDSI) as well as brightness temperature, land surface temperature (LST), the vegetation health index (VHI, optional) and a simplified rule-based land cover classification (water/built-up/bare soil/vegetation), with automatic color symbology and an exportable text interpretation report. The thermal algorithms are adapted from the QGIS plugin RS&GIS (NITK_RS-GIS_17) by Prathamesh Barane and G S Dwarakish, GPL v2-or-later license.
plugins.author: ADIOUMA FALL Geo

plugins.name: FricMaps
plugins.description: FricMaps: A Tool for Modeling Landscape Connectivity and Fence Permeability.
plugins.about: Resistance surfaces underpin ecological connectivity modelling, yet their construction is often hard to reproduce because it depends on heterogeneous input data and poorly documented preprocessing choices. FricMaps automates the generation of standardised land-cover and resistance surfaces through modular vector preprocessing and a rule-based rasterisation engine driven by a user-editable classification table. It explicitly integrates underrepresented anthropogenic barriers such as fences, applies attribute-dependent buffering of roads and railways, and uses wildlife crossing structures to locally restore permeability at validated locations. Contextual weighting by slope and by distance to any class or custom source supports scenario generation. Outputs are directly compatible with graph-based connectivity software such as Graphab. Source code is GPL-3.0-or-later; documentation and the default classification table are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE).

Each point includes: filepath, filename, coordinates, altitude, azimuth (compass direction), flight direction,

an OVER node in the Browser panel (source type -> organization -> dataset), a global search filter that reveals a dataset in the tree, whole-file GeoJSON/CSV loading, a live datastore layer filtered to the current map view, an advanced WHERE/SQL query builder with a field picker, and access to previous versions.

הפלאגין מאפשר לצפות, לטעון ולהוריד את הנתונים שבמאגר.
מתאפשרת טעינה של השכבות עם הסימבולוגיה שלהן
שאילתות SQL ברמת השכבה וברמת המאגר כולו
והתאמות נוספות.

plugins.description: Search French addresses (BAN) and IGN cadastral parcels with GIS tools and A4 print layout.

plugins.description: Export layer geometries (polygons, lines, points) to a GML file in the reference-geometry import format of eWniosekPlus (ARiMR, Poland), campaign 2026.
plugins.about: Generates a GML file compliant with the reference-geometry import schema of eWniosekPlus (geometrie_referencyjne_schema.xsd, namespace .../lpis/geometrie/referencyjne). Keeps the required structure (GeometriaReferencyjna: geometria, identyfikator, etykieta, optional dlugosc/powierzchnia, fid attribute), EPSG:2180 with the correct axis order (easting, northing), handles polygon holes, multipart, reprojection, and validation (rule-based offline and optionally against the bundled XSD). Bilingual UI (English/Polish), auto-selected by the QGIS locale. Made for Polish agri-environmental (ARiMR / PS WPR) work by ARENARIA.

plugins.description: Predicts future urban growth, traffic-density pressure, population density, nighttime activity (economic proxy), heat-risk, green-space-loss, and urban land-use-transition indicators from AOI-only Earth Engine trend data in QGIS 3.x and 4.x.
plugins.about: Urban Growth Predictor uses Google Earth Engine datasets and a spatial allocation model to forecast urban indicators from only an area of interest, a future year, and the desired urban indicator. It creates styled raster outputs and can optionally create polygon vector outputs with class/value attributes and XLSX/CSV trend reports. It reuses the Environmental Assessment Studio Earth Engine dependency and project settings when available.

plugins.name: Q-CensosBo
plugins.description: Query and map the microdata of Bolivia's population censuses (1976-2024) directly in QGIS
plugins.about: Access the Bolivian census microdata published by the censosbo project. Pick a census year and table, aggregate any variable by department or municipality (count, mean, median, sum, standard deviation, mode, or the share of a category), review a summary of the result and get a styled choropleth layer. Data is queried remotely with DuckDB, so the large Parquet files are never downloaded. Also covers the finest level of the 2024 census: 268,604 urban blocks and rural communities with the 194 indicators of the INE summary sheet (245 options, counting those that add up both sexes). Includes two Processing algorithms for graphical models and batch runs. Interface and documentation are in Spanish.

plugins.name: Parallel Folds & Structural Tool
plugins.description: QGIS plugin for parallel fold digitization & geological cross-sections.
plugins.about: Tool for constructing geological cross-sections. Projects bedding orientations, geological boundaries, and parallel fold geometries onto topographic profiels. Features: DEM profile extraction, strike-dip and apparent dip projection, parallel fold digitization with geometric constraints, stereonet analysis (Schmidt projection), GeoPackage import/export for layer persistence, and publication-ready SVG export. Compatible with QGIS 3.4+ and QGIS 4.x.

plugins.name: Road Video Tracker
plugins.description: View road survey videos synced with GPS tracks on the map
plugins.about:
Simplified road survey video viewer. Select a video file and a GPX track file, synchronize them, and view the vehicle position on the map in real-time while the video plays. Shows coordinates, heading, speed, and elevation. Supports mpv player with JSON IPC and Qt Multimedia fallback. Requires QGIS 3.14 or higher. For the latest version, check the GitHub Releases page: https://github.com/Danii791/RoadVideoTracker/releases.
Designer: A. Yusrizah S
Support: Okta
Technical Advisor: Syaeful
plugins.author: C.R Rhamdani

plugins.name: BlueMesh2D
plugins.description: Generate unstructured triangular meshes from bathymetry rasters (BlueMesh2D)
plugins.about:
Wraps the BlueMesh2D meshing library as QGIS Processing algorithms: from a bathymetry GeoTIFF to an unstructured triangular mesh, written as a UGRID NetCDF that loads directly as a QGIS mesh layer. The workflow runs as six stages:
• 1 - Extract the water polygon (coastline and domain) from the raster.
• 2 - Build a gradient-limited element-size raster: depth polynomial, wavelength (Hunt 1979) or a custom Python function, with optional finer detail regions.
• 3 - Resample the boundary to the element size, as an editable line layer.
• 4 - Generate the mesh: Delaunay or Frontal-Delaunay refinement, optional smoothing and smood orthogonalisation for Delft3D-FM.
• 5 - Classify the boundary nodes into open, closed and island, editable in QGIS.
• 6 - Export: UGRID NetCDF, Delft3D-FM open-boundary files (.pli / .bc / .ext) or ADCIRC .grd.
Each stage produces an ordinary QGIS layer, so every intermediate result can be inspected and hand-edited before the next step; an all-in-one algorithm is also available for a single-dialog run.
Step-by-step tutorial (PDF): https://github.com/GeoOcean/BlueMesh2D/blob/develop/docs/Tuto_BlueMesh2D_Santander.pdf
Dependencies need no manual setup. On first load the plugin detects what is missing and installs it in one click (Plugins ▸ BlueMesh2D ▸ Check / install dependencies). pip runs in QGIS's own interpreter; on Debian/Ubuntu system Python (PEP 668) the packages go into a plugin-managed virtual environment instead, leaving the system Python untouched. Installing bluemesh2d brings numpy, scipy, shapely, rasterio, matplotlib, netCDF4, xarray and triangle with it.
plugins.author: Geomatics and Ocean Engineering Group

plugins.name: SCIMAP Toolkit
plugins.description: SCIMAP tools for sediment, network index, and flood risk mapping within a catchment, using FD8 routing, flow-path trace connectivity, and flood impact-point workflows.
plugins.about: Calculates SCIMAP spatial indices including network connectivity, erosion risk, in-channel risk, and flood mean/stdev outputs using native WhiteboxTools hydrological processing (BreachDepressions, FD8FlowAccumulation, D8Pointer, CostDistance) and a flow-path trace connectivity approach. The plugin includes standalone SCIMAP Network Index from DEM and SCIMAP Flood tools. Main SCIMAP workflow inputs are DEM, Land Cover Risk Weighting, and Rainfall rasters; the Flood workflow operates on pre-computed connectivity, runoff, rainfall, and overland flow distance rasters. Outputs include erosion, connectivity, in-channel risk rasters, a vector stream network, flood mean/stdev rasters, and an overland flow travel-distance raster. Depends upon the WhiteboxTools executable also being installed. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ecolmodel.2010.08.022
plugins.author: Sim M. Reaney, Durham University

plugins.name: Map Frame Storyboard
plugins.description: Export the current map canvas as a structured video shot brief.
plugins.about: Map Frame Storyboard records the active canvas CRS and extent together with a shot title, motion, camera direction, setting, and duration. It writes a local JSON file for review or use in a separate media workflow. The plugin does not upload project data, contact external services, or require additional Python packages.
plugins.author: Foster Martyn

plugins.name: Spatial Aggregation Mean
plugins.description: Batch-aggregates monthly gridded climate CSV files to district means, with nearest-grid fallback for districts containing no grid points.
plugins.about: Developed by Mr. Akmaul Hoque, Dr. Manish Kumar Naskar, Dr. Debasish Chakraborty and Dr. Koushik Bag, Water Management Section, Division of System Research and Engineering (DSRE), ICAR Research Complex for NEH Region. This portable QGIS Processing plugin converts longitude-latitude climate grids in CSV format into polygon-wise monthly means, detects coordinate and month columns, performs point-in-polygon aggregation, and fills polygons without internal grid points using the mean of the nearest grid points.
plugins.author: Mr. Akmaul Hoque; Dr. Manish Kumar Naskar; Dr. Debasish Chakraborty; Dr. Koushik Bag

plugins.name: QReplace
plugins.description: Find and replace values in vector layer attribute fields, spreadsheet-style (Excel/OpenOffice). Triggered with Ctrl+F from the attribute table, or from the Vector menu/toolbar by picking a layer and field.
plugins.about: Plugin for finding and replacing text in vector layer attribute fields. If launched with Ctrl+F while a layer's attribute table is open and active, it automatically preselects that layer (and, if possible, the current field/column). If launched from the Vector menu or the toolbar, it asks you to pick a layer and field. Supports match case, whole word, regular expressions, "all features" or "selected only" scope, Find Next, Replace and Replace All. Not to be confused with the existing "Field find/replace" plugin (right-click in the attribute table, based on the field calculator's regex_replace): QReplace works from the toolbar/Vector menu/Ctrl+F, with a step-by-step Find Next preview as well as Replace All.
plugins.author: Vertical Srl

plugins.name: LISFLOOD-FP Preprocessor
plugins.description: Automated pre-processing tool for LISFLOOD-FP with topology checks, optional diffusive solver, and optional rainfall forcing
plugins.about: Automates the generation of LISFLOOD-FP input files (.river, .bci, .bdy, .n, .par) from a DEM raster. Includes robust topology validation, fallback to mainstem, stable temp handling on Windows, optional diffusive solver, and optional rainfall (fixed or time series).
plugins.author: Antigravity Pair Programmer

plugins.name: Coffee Stain
plugins.description: Realistic, procedurally generated coffee stains for QGIS print layouts.
plugins.about: Adds procedurally generated, realistic coffee stains (cup ring, spill, drip) to the current QGIS print layout. Deegan edge profile + fBm + stick-slip, with paper porosity, a Marangoni central spot and a dewetting interior network. Composited with the Multiply blend mode and rendered at export-aware DPI. Uses numpy (bundled with QGIS); optionally uses scipy.ndimage for sharper edges and falls back to a radial approximation when it is unavailable. Licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.
plugins.author: Maksim Boiko

plugins.name: GISCraft Coordinate Extractor
plugins.description: Extract Geographic (Lat/Lon) and UTM (Northing/Easting) coordinates from point layers, with automatic UTM zone detection per point.
plugins.about: GISCraft Coordinate Extractor is a QGIS Processing tool that extracts point coordinates in two coordinate systems and writes them into new attribute fields: Latitude/Longitude (WGS84, 5 decimal places) and Northing/Easting (UTM, 3 decimal places), along with the automatically detected UTM zone (e.g. "48S"). The UTM zone is calculated independently for each point, making the tool suitable for datasets that span multiple UTM zones such as roads, pipelines, or transmission line surveys. Coordinate transforms are cached per zone for optimal performance on large datasets. Ideal for GIS surveying, QA/QC, and coordinate reporting workflows. Contact: indragiscraft@gmail.com
plugins.author: GISCraft

plugins.name: Conversor Geoespacial
plugins.description: Tools for converting coordinates and angles (Bearing, Azimuth, DMS, DD, UTM).
plugins.about: Este plugin oferece ferramentas para conversão de rumo para azimute, azimute para rumo, GMS para decimal, e coordenadas geográficas para UTM e vice-versa.
plugins.author: AIGEO Mapas - Prof. M.Sc Antonio Idêrlian Pereira de Sousa

plugins.name: CAD Toolbar Pro
plugins.description: Toolkit CAD completo para QGIS — linha de comando estilo AutoCAD, curvas, geoprocessamento, transformações e exportação.
plugins.about: Plugin de produtividade para agrimensores e topógrafos. Adiciona barra única com dezenas de ferramentas: Fillet, Chamfer, Extend, Offset numérico, Scale/Rotate by reference (com correção de CRS geográfico), Align, Divide, Measure Along, Lengthen, Join Lines, Wipeout, Coordinate Tracker, Feature Counter, Buffer, Mirror, Array, linha de comando estilo AutoCAD (F, MI, AR, SC, RO, DIV…), criação de camadas, carregamento de imagens de satélite (Google, Bing, ESRI, OSM, INPE, USGS) e exportação (DXF, KML, SHP, GeoJSON, GeoPackage). Portabilidade: sem dependências externas além do QGIS. Inclui lógica portada e adaptada do PlanX CAD Toolset (Yusuf Eminoglu, GPL v3).
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: Classificador de Declividade
plugins.description: Classifies a DEM into polygons by user-defined slope ranges and calculates adaptive earthwork by class.
plugins.about: Processa MDT (GeoTIFF) via GDAL/QGIS: aplica filtro de declividade (gdal:slope), reclassifica em faixas configuráveis, vetoriza os polígonos resultado e exporta Shapefile. O módulo de Terraplanagem calcula o volume de corte/aterro por classe de declividade usando NumPy, e gera seções transversais e relatório de volumes.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: HidroQGIS
plugins.description: Automated watershed delineation from a DEM: depression filling, D8 flow direction, flow accumulation, stream network and sub-basins.
plugins.about: Pipeline hidrológico completo sobre MDE (GeoTIFF): (1) preenche depressões, (2) calcula direção de fluxo D8, (3) fluxo acumulado, (4) extrai e vetoriza rede de drenagem, (5) delimita sub-bacias e corpos d'água. Utiliza WhiteboxTools (binário standalone MIT) para os algoritmos de análise de fluxo. Inclui validação estatística (Índice de Jaccard) contra camada de referência. Reprojeção automática para SIRGAS2000.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: Gerador de Pontos
plugins.description: Generates staking-out points from DXF geometries (lines and arcs) in SIRGAS 2000 coordinates with millimeter precision.
plugins.about: Lê arquivo DXF (linhas e arcos), extrai os vértices e pontos de tangência de arcos, reprojetar para SIRGAS 2000 e exporta camada de pontos com coordenadas milimétricas — prontos para locação em campo com estação total ou GNSS. Usa o driver DXF nativo do QGIS; se falhar, recorre à biblioteca ezdxf (pip install ezdxf) para leitura precisa de arcos.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: Precisa — Altitude Geoidal (hgeoHNOR2020)
plugins.description: Geoid undulation and normal height via IBGE's hgeoHNOR2020 grid (BRAZIL). Automatic offline download (~2 MB), bilinear interpolation, CSV and 3D DXF export.
plugins.about: Baixa automaticamente a grade hgeoHNOR2020 do IBGE (arquivo .GGF, ~2 MB) e armazena localmente. Para cada ponto da camada de entrada, aplica interpolação bilinear sobre a grade para obter a ondulação geoidal (N) e a altitude normal (h - N). Exporta CSV enriquecido e DXF 3D. Funciona também como script standalone fora do QGIS.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: Precisa — Cálculo Geodésico
plugins.description: Magnetic declination (offline WMM-2025), meridian convergence, UTM scale factor, inverse azimuth and DMS conversion. Requires pyproj and geopandas.
plugins.about: Calcula: (1) declinação magnética via modelo WMM-2025 offline (pygeomag/pyproj); (2) convergência meridiana e fator k UTM para qualquer zona; (3) azimute inverso entre dois pontos; (4) conversão DD↔GMS. Usa geopandas para leitura de camadas e pyproj para projeção. Funciona também como script standalone.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: Precisa — Cotas
plugins.description: Generates length, azimuth, area and perimeter labels rotated along vector feature segments.
plugins.about: Para cada segmento das feições selecionadas, cria uma camada de anotações com o comprimento e o azimute do segmento, rotacionados na direção do segmento. Opcionalmente adiciona área e perímetro para polígonos. Sem dependências externas.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: Precisa — DWG Batch Converter
plugins.description: Batch conversion of DWG/DXF to Shapefile or GeoPackage via GDAL, with fallback to ODA File Converter for natively unsupported DWG files.
plugins.about: Aba Converter: converte em lote DWG/DXF para SHP ou GPKG usando GDAL/OGR. Para DWG sem suporte nativo do GDAL, instrui o usuário a usar o ODA File Converter (gratuito, externo) como pré-passo. Aba Exportar: exporta camadas do projeto QGIS para DXF. Cancelamento de worker em background.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: Precisa Perímetro
plugins.description: Reconstructs a boundary from Emlid RS+ TSV points (GTopo post-processed): detects chains, resolves duplicates, orders vertices and exports UTM DXF.
plugins.about: Motor de reconstrução de perímetro: lê TSV com pontos GNSS coletados em campo (Emlid RS+ pós-processado no GTopo), detecta cadeias por gap de tempo, resolve duplicatas, detecta pontos inseridos fora de sequência, reconecta cadeias minimizando cruzamentos e exporta DXF R2010 em UTM SIRGAS2000. Usa normalização unicode para compatibilidade de nomes.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: Precisa — RBMC / Efemérides / PPK
plugins.description: Automated download of RINEX, SP3, IONEX, ANTEX, hgeoHNOR2020 and a full PPK kit, with an optional AI co-pilot for ephemeris and RBMC (BRAZIL) station suggestions.
plugins.about: Automatiza o download de todos os dados necessários para pós-processamento GNSS PPK: RINEX 2/3 das estações RBMC mais próximas, efemérides IGS (final/rápida/ultrarrápida), IONEX, ANTEX, ERP, VMF3, DCB e hgeoHNOR2020. Inclui merge de blocos RINEX 1s e parser de cabeçalho RINEX 2.11/3.x. Co-piloto de IA opcional (Claude API / Ollama) que sugere a efeméride mais indicada e as estações mais próximas. Requer Precisa Agrimensura Suite instalada.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: ProGrid QGIS — Transformador de Datum
plugins.description: Offline coordinate transformation between SAD69, SAD69/96, Córrego Alegre 1961/1970 and SIRGAS2000 via IBGE NTv2 grids, equivalent to ProGrid.
plugins.about: Baixa automaticamente as grades NTv2 de transformação do IBGE e as injeta no data dir do pyproj. Suporta transformação ponto a ponto (interface) e em lote (CSV). Modos geográfico e UTM. Equivalente funcional ao ProGrid do IBGE, rodando offline dentro do QGIS.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: WebODM Precisa Agrimensura
plugins.description: WebODM integration: drone image upload, photogrammetric processing monitoring, GCP editor, and product download (orthomosaic, DSM, DTM, point cloud).
plugins.about: Módulo de integração com WebODM/OpenDroneMap para processamento fotogramétrico direto do QGIS. Funcionalidades: conexão com servidor WebODM, envio de imagens, editor visual de GCPs, monitoramento em tempo real, download de produtos e relatório de qualidade em DOCX.
plugins.author: Precisa Agrimensura LTDA

plugins.name: Gerador de Memoriais
plugins.description: Generates a georeferenced land survey description (memorial descritivo) from narrative text, a QGIS layer, or a SIGEF/INCRA PDF, with points and polygon.
plugins.about: Três modos de entrada em um só plugin: (1) Texto — cole ou carregue um memorial descritivo narrativo já pronto e gere pontos + polígono; (2) Camada QGIS — selecione uma camada de polígono em CRS UTM e gere o memorial descritivo georreferenciado (com detecção de curva) em DOCX; (3) SIGEF — leia o PDF oficial do SIGEF/INCRA e gere memorial em DOCX, pontos e polígono. Declara automaticamente o sistema de cálculo com base no CRS. Não inclui classificação automática de confrontantes (frente/fundos/laterais) — disponível nos produtos DANI e GEO RURAL.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: GeoInterpolation Analyst
plugins.description: Exploratory spatial data analysis, geostatistics, and advanced spatial interpolation (IDW, RBF, Ordinary Kriging) with LOOCV cross-validation optimization, plus GeoKriging Analyst (Beta), a full 11-step guided geostatistics workflow with 6 variogram models (all from gstat's real catalog), outlier detection, 3 interpolation-area modes (points/mask/custom), resolution/area reporting and contour-line generation (major/minor levels, Surfer-style), now also available as a standalone Post-Processing tool for the raster output of any interpolation method. / Análisis exploratorio de datos, geoestadística e interpolación espacial con LOOCV, más GeoKriging Analyst (Beta), un flujo guiado completo de 11 pasos con 6 modelos de variograma (todos del catálogo real de gstat), detección de outliers, 3 modos de área de interpolación (puntos/máscara/personalizada), reporte de resolución y área, y generación de curvas de nivel (maestras/intermedias, estilo Surfer), ahora también disponible como herramienta independiente de Post-Procesamiento para el raster resultante de cualquier método de interpolación.
plugins.about: QGIS plugin for exploratory data analysis, Voronoi (Thiessen) polygons, and advanced spatial interpolation methods (IDW, RBF, Ordinary Kriging) with automated Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOOCV) hyperparameter optimization. Includes GeoKriging Analyst (Beta), a new and separate guided tool (Preparar-Explorar-Estructura espacial-Smart Model-Validar-Seleccionar-Interpolar-Calidad-Resultados-Informe-Curvas de Nivel) for transparent, defensible variogram modeling, model selection, final interpolation, contour-line generation and reporting (HTML/PDF/Excel), with 6 variogram models, all from gstat's real catalog. In Post-Processing there is now also a standalone 'Curvas de Nivel (raster)' tool that generates the same contour lines and styling from the raster produced by IDW, RBF, Ordinary Kriging, GeoKriging Analyst, or any other raster loaded in the project. / Plugin para análisis estadístico de datos espaciales, polígonos de Voronoi e interpolación espacial avanzada (IDW, RBF, Kriging Ordinario) con optimización mediante validación cruzada (LOOCV). Incluye GeoKriging Analyst (Beta), una herramienta nueva y separada con flujo guiado completo (Preparar-Explorar-Estructura espacial-Smart Model-Validar-Seleccionar-Interpolar-Calidad-Resultados-Informe-Curvas de Nivel) para un modelamiento de variograma, selección de modelo, interpolación final, generación de curvas de nivel y generación de informes (HTML/PDF/Excel) transparente y defendible, con 6 modelos de variograma, todos del catálogo real de gstat. En Post-Procesamiento ahora también hay una herramienta independiente 'Curvas de Nivel (raster)' que genera las mismas curvas y simbología a partir del raster de IDW, RBF, Kriging Ordinario, GeoKriging Analyst, o cualquier otro raster cargado en el proyecto.

plugins.name: Basemap Loader
plugins.description: Load Swiss swisstopo and world WMTS basemaps with one click
plugins.about: Adds Switzerland (swisstopo) and World basemap layers in the correct group structure with a single toolbar click or keyboard shortcut. Sources are editable via Plugins > Basemap Loader > Edit Basemap Sources.
plugins.author: Florian Denzinger

plugins.name: QCT NZ Elevation & Imagery Importer
plugins.description: Streams LINZ nz-elevation LiDAR DEM/DSM tiles (via GDAL /vsicurl/) straight into the current project from a manageable dataset database. Part of the QCivilTools suite. No download required.
plugins.about: Registers under QCivilTools > NZ Elevation & Imagery Importer. Bundles THREE LINZ catalogs, switchable from a dropdown: NZ Elevation, NZ Coastal (84 coastal datasets including the nationwide Coastal 1m DEM/DSM and hillshades), and NZ Imagery (the aerial/satellite photo archive; its full dataset list is fetched on first use and saved). The elevation catalog: 218 datasets covering every region, survey year, DEM/DSM variant, hillshade, and the 8m contour-interpolated DEM. Catalog datasets ship with a lightweight entry; their tile list is fetched automatically from their STAC collection.json on first use and saved permanently. Opens a non-modal window -- the QGIS map stays fully usable while it's open -- listing every dataset in the plugin's database (title, path, CRS, tile count, whether a local tile index is bundled), with a Help/About panel alongside. The Northland LiDAR 1m DEM (2024) and nationwide New Zealand LiDAR 1m DEM additionally ship with prebuilt local tile indexes. A filter box makes the 218-dataset table quick to search. The nationwide New Zealand LiDAR 1m DEM heads the list. The plugin works with one dataset at a time: loading an index automatically unloads any other dataset's index layer. Defaults the project CRS to EPSG:2193 (NZTM2000), and every layer the plugin adds is kept in NZTM2000 so it displays in the right location. Features: Load Index (show and zoom to tile footprints; footprints fetched remotely for datasets without a bundled index are autosaved to a local GeoPackage so next time they load instantly), Click on Map to Load (click tile boundaries one at a time, with a continue/finish prompt after each tile), Load Tiles by Name (comma-separated tile IDs, or ALL for every tile), Export Raster (crop by a drawn polygon, a drawn crop box, any project layer's extent, or an existing polygon layer -- only the tiles and pixel blocks covering the crop area are read, then mosaicked and saved as GeoTIFF), Add Dataset from any LINZ STAC collection.json URL, and Remove Dataset (available only for datasets you added yourself -- the 218 default datasets cannot be removed; removal deletes the dataset from the database along with its local tile index, and it can be re-added any time from its collection URL). A progress bar with percent-complete backs every long-running action, and closing the window offers to unload every layer it added during the session. Rasters stream directly from LINZ open data over HTTPS via GDAL /vsicurl/ -- no download required.

plugins.name: Zone Blanche Finder

Zone Blanche Finder loads a CSV file of transmitter or antenna points,
counts them per municipality, then calculates a connectivity score combining

plugins.author: Hugo R.

plugins.name: AQGIS-Sivil3D
plugins.description: Corridor modelling on terrain: extrudes typical cross sections along an alignment, clips them against any DEM, builds the TIN, computes earthwork volumes and produces the drawings.
plugins.about: A Civil 3D reduced to the essentials, inside QGIS. FEATURES: (1) Typical cross section editor built by composing elements -- carriageway, shoulder, verge, kerb or wall, triangular or trapezoidal ditch, daylight slope and benched slope, which can be chained to build a slope that changes gradient at a given height --, with independent left and right branches and separate cut and fill groups, so each side decides on its own whether to excavate or fill; includes live preview over a configurable test hillside, error validation and a JSON section library with nine starting templates, from a road or a ditch to a concrete gravity dam, a rockfill dam with an upstream face slab and an embankment dam with berms. (2) Dynamic parameters: any value can be a number, a V:H slope, a reference to a layer field (@width) or a QGIS expression, resolved once per alignment feature. (3) Corridor computation: a different section per feature chosen by a field, stations at a configurable interval plus the alignment vertices placed on the angle bisector, axis elevation taken from the DEM, from the alignment Z or from a constant value or from an offset above or below the terrain, both of which can also be written into the layer Z (as a fixed elevation or draped onto the DEM) to keep editing it vertex by vertex, bilinear terrain sampling with tile caching, support for any raster GDAL can read and for mesh layers, and automatic warnings when sections cross on tight curves or when a slope fails to daylight. (4) TIN stitched by point code, which lets sections with a different number of benches mesh correctly, with optional merge with the base terrain to deliver a single continuous surface with no gaps or overlaps. (5) Grouped, ready styled outputs: TIN polygons coloured by zone -- cut, fill, at grade and natural ground -- with earthwork thickness; cross sections with red elevation and areas; feature lines and daylight lines; corridor footprint; axis with road symbol; stations labelled as km+m, rotated and offset from the axis; points for every vertex; earthwork table; and a 2DM mesh that QGIS loads as a native mesh layer. (6) Exact earthwork measurement by integration between design and terrain, volumes by average end areas or by the prismoidal formula, and mass haul diagram with a bulking factor. (7) Dockable profile viewer with longitudinal profile, cross section at the current station and mass haul diagram, station navigation synchronised with the map both ways, image export, and a checklist that overlays as many alignments as you want -- from the same corridor or from different alternatives -- in the longitudinal profile and in the mass haul diagram, each with its own colour, while the cross section follows the highlighted one. (8) Automatic drawings generated in paper space: plan sheets paginated with an atlas and rotated so the axis runs horizontally, with a choice of which layers reach the map and whether the whole set of drawings is the main alignment's -- with the others appearing only where they cut its planes -- or every alignment gets its own complete set, longitudinal profile of the main alignment with a data band showing station, ground elevation, design elevation and cut or fill depth, and the other corridors appearing where they actually cut its vertical plane, cross section sheets on a grid fitted to the paper size, and a closing earthwork sheet with totals; with the other corridors drawn wherever they cross or run close, dashed and clipped to the frame, both in the cross sections (their trace on that very cutting plane) and in the longitudinal profile (their grade lines); with standard scales, true 1:1 framing, automatic paper selection, .qpt templates for the title block and export to PDF and DXF. (9) Export and import of the whole corridor as a GeoPackage with its styles plus a JSON holding the resolved sections, which allows reopening it and going on measuring and drawing without the DEM and without recomputing. (10) Several corridors per session as comparable alternatives. (11) Processing algorithm aqgis:corredor for models, batch runs and the console. (13) Longitudinal profile editor: the vertical alignment is drawn with the mouse over the terrain profile using the same digitizing tools as in plan view -- straight, arc, Bezier and NURBS per segment, with control handles and weights -- plus symmetric parabolic vertical curves defined by their length L or by their K value, snapping to the terrain and to round stations and elevations, an editable table of PVIs, multiple vertex selection (Ctrl+click or rubber band) so a whole stretch can be raised or lowered without distorting it, automatic simplification when reading the layer Z so the grade line does not inherit the hundreds of vertices of the plan alignment, live cut and fill shading, feedback on the map in plan view, and writing the result into the layer Z with automatic densification so vertical curves are not lost. (14) Reservoir capacity curve: elevation, stored volume and flooded area of a reservoir or pond from the DEM of its basin, computed by histogram accumulation so the cost does not depend on the number of elevations, with optional clipping by a polygon layer, CSV and PNG output, and the clipped DEM loaded and styled as a water surface with the ramp stretched between its own minimum and maximum. (15) Calculated corridors survive closing QGIS: they are saved next to the project and recovered when it is reopened, or read from the JSON beside an exported GeoPackage. (16) Extensive help shipped inside the plugin. (17) Interface in English or Spanish, chosen inside the plugin itself and not tied to the QGIS locale: menus, dialogs, warnings, generated layer names and the labels printed on the drawings all follow it, and each language keeps its own starting library of typical cross sections. English is the default. Authors: Rafael Vazquez and Claude. Free software under the GNU General Public License v3 or later (GPL v3+).
plugins.author: Rafael Vázquez, Claude

plugins.name: Easting
plugins.description: Turn recorded deeds, easements, plats, and as-builts into validated parcel geometry. Easting extracts every boundary call with the source text it came from, recomputes the traverse, and checks closure and stated area before drawing anything. Batch folders, DXF and GeoPackage export, filable certificate.
plugins.about: Easting reads a recorded land document (PDF, TIFF, PNG, or JPEG) and returns geometry you can defend: every boundary call extracted with the sentence it came from, the traverse recomputed, and closure and stated area checked independently before anything reaches your map. Every result carries a GroundTruth verdict, the verification layer behind all Easting products: PASS (closes and corroborates), REVIEW (flagged for human eyes, with reasons), FAIL (not traversable). It refuses to draw geometry a document never described, and says which case it hit. Four document classes ship today: metes-and-bounds deeds, PLSS/aliquot deeds, recorded easements and rights of way, and recorded plats and utility as-builts. Export a GeoPackage, a DXF, or the one-page GroundTruth Certificate of Digitization. REQUIRES A SERVICE ACCOUNT: extraction runs on the hosted Easting API, so the plugin uploads each document you extract to easting.ai and needs an Easting API key to work. There is no offline mode. You can create an account from the plugin's own Settings dialog in about a minute: three documents are free, no card. The same account works in the browser at app.easting.ai and over the API. See https://easting.ai for keys, pricing, and terms.
plugins.author: Easting

plugins.about:
Labels de área automáticos em polígonos QGIS, com UTM global e SRC projetado.

-Funcionamento:

🔹 Labels Automáticos:
*Atualiza labels com a geometria. Barra para exibir/ocultar e filtrar por camadas selecionadas (Ctrl+clique).

🔹 Cálculo de Área:
*UTM global e brasileiro (SIRGAS/SAD69), Policônica. Sugestão de zona UTM, CRS geográficos e favoritos.

🔹 Unidades:
*m², ha, km², acre, are, ft², mi² e medidas agrárias brasileiras, com favoritos.

🔹 Automação:
*Aplicar automaticamente só em novas camadas.

🔹 Idioma:

Automatic area labels for QGIS polygons, with global UTM and projected CRS.

plugins.name: ColombiaCLC
plugins.description: Automatic assignment of official Corine Land Cover (CLC) symbology adapted for Colombia (IDEAM) to polygon vector layers
plugins.about:
ColombiaCLC permite asignar automáticamente la simbología oficial Corine Land Cover (CLC) adaptada a Colombia por el IDEAM a cualquier capa vectorial de polígonos.
Funcionalidades: colores oficiales por código CLC, soporte de niveles 2 a 6, detección automática del nivel presente en el campo, manejo diferenciado de valores NULL y códigos sin coincidencia, estadísticas de área (ha) por gran categoría (nivel 1), etiquetas opcionales con nombre de cobertura.
Compatible con QGIS 3.34 LTR y QGIS 4.x.
plugins.author: Carlos M. Fernández

plugins.name: CoverCraft - Internet Coverage Mapper
plugins.description: Turn BTS towers into coverage maps in QGIS: model cellular/internet signal, find the blank spots, and get suggested new tower sites — over real terrain and buildings.
plugins.about:
CoverCraft turns a set of BTS tower locations into planning-grade coverage intelligence, directly inside QGIS. It models best-server signal (RSRP) from sectored antennas over a real DEM + building DSM, accounting for terrain and building obstruction using COST-231 Hata / free-space path loss and 3GPP antenna patterns.

From that, it delivers three things: 
(1) a clear signal heatmap of who gets coverage and how strong, 
(2) blank-spot polygons with area and, with an optional population raster, the number of people left uncovered
(3) suggested new BTS locations that fill the largest gaps first, optionally ranked by administrative area (village / subdistrict / city / regency).

New BTS points, rasters, and coverage-radius polygons drop straight in via drag-and-drop from the .gpkg output, and the underlying methodology is grounded in peer-reviewed research. Think of it as a fast, honest first pass for network planning and digital-divide analysis a planning-grade approximation, not a full engineering RF planner.
plugins.author: Muhammad Kholifatkhur Rohman

plugins.name: IGN VueZ
plugins.description: Displays the elevations (Z) of all vertices in a layer's features.
plugins.about:
Le layer peut être de type ponctuel, ligne, polyligne ou polygone.
Si la sélection est vide ce sont toutes les entités du layer qui sont traitées, sinon seules les entités sélectionnées sont traitées.
plugins.author: Gérôme PECHEUR

plugins.name: Mapdex for QGIS
plugins.description: Nivo AI assistant for QGIS: ask questions about your layers and PostGIS in plain language, get measured spatial analysis on the map, run Processing, and georeference or digitize scanned maps with Mapdex.
plugins.about: Mapdex for QGIS adds Nivo, an AI GIS assistant that works from your map. Connect Mapdex once, then ask in plain language and let Nivo measure the answer instead of guessing it. You may use Mapdex models, your own provider key, or a local model after connecting. Model inference with your own provider goes directly from QGIS to that provider, while the Mapdex connection owns identity, project context, capability negotiation and the action lifecycle. Every action comes from a closed capability registry: no arbitrary Python, no arbitrary SQL, and consequential steps always ask first. Nivo profiles and styles layers, runs QGIS Processing after confirmation, and sends Mapdex georeference, digitization and validation tasks, adding completed results back as QGIS layers. Provider keys are stored only in the encrypted QGIS Authentication Manager. Needs network access to your Mapdex endpoint (mapdex.ai by default, configurable for self-hosted installs). No external Python packages are required beyond the QGIS standard runtime; works on Windows, Linux and macOS, with Qt5 (QGIS 3.34+) and Qt6 (QGIS 4).
plugins.author: Mapdex

plugins.name: Clip2Place
plugins.description: Clip vector layers to an extent centered on a place anywhere in the world - a rectangle or circle around a point settlement (city, town, village or hamlet), or an administrative boundary.
plugins.about: Clip2Place centers a clip extent on a single place - found worldwide via OpenStreetMap Nominatim search, entered directly as latitude/longitude, or picked from a layer already loaded in the project or from a folder on disk. Three extent shapes are supported: a rectangle sized from a chosen map scale (pick a common one or type your own) and paper dimensions (in mm/cm/in), a circle sized from a plain radius (in m/km/ft/mi), or the place's own administrative boundary - fetched automatically from OpenStreetMap Nominatim for a searched place, or picked as a feature from a boundary layer already in the project or on disk. The tool suggests a suitable projected CRS for the location (its UTM zone, always available worldwide, plus optional additional national/regional candidates when the pyproj library is present) and clips the chosen input layers to the extent. Besides the clipped layers, it also writes the extent itself as a polygon layer and as a line (outline) layer.

plugins.name: Attribute Form Toggle
plugins.description: Temporarily suppress the attribute form after feature creation without overriding the global QGIS setting.
plugins.about: Attribute Form Toggle temporarily suppresses the attribute form after feature creation for active vector layers without changing the global QGIS suppression option. It complements the Reuse last entered attribute values option.

plugins.name: Affecter ID Classe
plugins.description: Assigns a numeric code to each unique value of a classification field, for any vector layer (points, lines, polygons).
plugins.about: EN: This plugin reads the unique values of a chosen field (e.g. a "CLASS" field) on a vector layer loaded in the project, regardless of its geometry type, then lets you assign an integer code to each value. The field is created/updated directly on the loaded layer, so changes are visible immediately in QGIS (attribute table, symbology) without manual reload. plugins.name: QCT GIS2DXF Exporter
plugins.description: QGIS to AutoCAD DXF export: vectors and rasters in one drawing. Orthophotos and hillshades attach as georeferenced image xrefs, clipped to a rectangle or polygon. Points as blocks with attributes, Z elevation, symbology colours and lineweights. QCivilTools suite.
plugins.about:
Part of the QCivilTools (QCT) suite. Exports any mix of vector and raster layers to an AutoCAD R2000 (AC1015) DXF, clipped to a crop box drawn on the map canvas, taken from the canvas or layer extent, typed in, or defined by a drawn polygon or a selected polygon feature.
Vectors become LWPOLYLINE, 3D POLYLINE, POINT, TEXT and HATCH entities with symbology colour, lineweight and linetype carried across, and optional Z from geometry or an attribute field. Point layers can instead be inserted as blocks carrying every field as an attribute, ready for ATTEXT or Data Extraction in CAD.
Rasters are written as sidecar PNG, JPEG or GeoTIFF files and attached to the DXF as IMAGE xrefs (IMAGEDEF, IMAGEDEF_REACTOR and ACAD_IMAGE_DICT), so they open georeferenced and in place in AutoCAD, Civil 3D and BricsCAD, complete with a polygonal clip boundary. Styled rendering reproduces the QGIS symbology of DEMs, hillshades and pseudocolour rasters, and a colorize mode matching the QGIS Hue/Saturation renderer can produce greyscale or black and white backdrops, optionally attached alongside the colour version.
No third-party Python packages are required.

plugins.name: PE3D-Downloader
plugins.description: Downloads PE3D DEM, DTM and orthophoto tiles and creates optimized GeoTIFFs or draft VRT mosaics.
plugins.about: Locates 1:5,000 Pernambuco 3D grid tiles intersecting an area of interest and downloads DEM, DTM and orthophoto products. It can create an optimized GeoTIFF reprojected to EPSG:4674 and clipped to the AOI, or lightweight draft VRT mosaics grouped by source CRS without reprojection or clipping. plugins.name: 3D Track Viewer
plugins.description: 适用于QGIS 3和QGIS 4的三维轨迹分析工具，支持工程点线图层、本地GPX、时间裁剪、关键帧动画，以及可配置格式、分辨率和动画参数的多格式导出。 / 3D track analysis for QGIS 3 and QGIS 4 with project layers, local GPX, time clipping, keyframe animation, and multi-format export with configurable image format, resolution and animation settings.
plugins.about: 直接在QGIS面板中选择工程点线图层或打开本地GPX轨迹，以交互式三维视图展示高程、速度和坡度变化。支持QGIS 3/4与Qt 5/6、垂直夸张、轨迹样式、色阶范围、时间裁剪、跟随显示、原生单位设置、相机关键帧动画、可配置格式与分辨率的栅格图片导出，以及SVG、PDF和可配置GIF导出。 / Select project point/line layers or open local GPX tracks directly in the QGIS panel and inspect elevation, speed and slope in an interactive 3D view. plugins.name: Auto Contour Generator
plugins.description: Automatically generates styled major/minor contour lines from a DEM raster or an elevation point layer, with optional hillshade, slope, aspect and colour relief outputs.

plugins.name: Chak Star Alignment
plugins.description: Draws star-pattern chak-to-sub-chak alignments, with a toolbar button and its own dialog (not just a Processing script) - shortest distance or highest elevation, with optional DEM/contour-based auto outlet placement.

plugins.name: Przeliczanie warstw i rastrów wsadowa zmiana układu współrzędnych - Batch CRS Reprojection for Layers and Rasters
plugins.description: Wsadowa transformacja plikow wektorowych miedzy polskimi ukladami wspolrzednych (WGS84, PL-1992, PL-2000, PL-UTM, UTM, 1965, 1942, GUGiK-80) Poland batch CRS reprojection for vector and raster files

It supports vector formats (SHP, GPKG, GeoJSON, GeoParquet, FlatGeobuf, GML, KML, TAB/MIF, DXF) and raster formats (GeoTIFF/COG, IMG, ASCII Grid, JP2, BIL/BSQ/BIP, NetCDF, GeoPDF, and others supported by GDAL), offering options for resampling, compression, NoData handling, and forcing the GeoTIFF format.

plugins.name: Sentinel Download
plugins.description: Bulk download of Sentinel-2 (L2A/L1C) and Sentinel-1 (GRD) imagery from the Copernicus Data Space for an AOI from a layer or GPKG file, with automatic ready-symbolised products: RGB, CIR, SWIR, GEO composites, NDVI, NDWI, NDMI, NBR, NDSI, NDRE indices and the SCL classification map.
plugins.about:
BULK SENTINEL DOWNLOADS WITH READY-TO-USE PRODUCTS
The plugin searches and bulk-downloads satellite imagery from the official Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (a free account at dataspace.copernicus.eu is required — the plugin includes a built-in sign-up guide).
 
WHAT YOU CAN DOWNLOAD:
- Sentinel-2 L2A — atmospherically corrected optical imagery (recommended),
- Sentinel-2 L1C — raw optical imagery,
- Sentinel-1 GRD — radar imagery (sees through clouds and at night).

AREA OF INTEREST: a polygon layer from the project or a GeoPackage (.gpkg) file.

FILTERS AND SCENE SELECTION:
- date range, maximum cloud cover, scene limit,
- strategies: all scenes / manual checklist / month filter / automatically the 3 least cloudy scenes of each month.
 
DOWNLOADING:
- up to 4 parallel downloads, automatic retries after errors,
- resuming of interrupted sessions (already downloaded files are skipped),
- a CSV summary report, optional remembering of credentials.

AUTOMATIC PRODUCTS (GeoTIFF with ready-made symbology — coloured in QGIS from the first second):
- colour composites: RGB (natural colours), CIR (vegetation in red), SWIR (agriculture), GEO (geology); transparent scene edges,
- indices with colour ramps and legends (QML files applied automatically): NDVI (vegetation condition), NDWI (surface water), NDMI (vegetation moisture, droughts), NBR (burn severity), NDSI (snow and ice), NDRE (chlorophyll, early plant stress),
- SCL — the ESA scene classification map with a class legend (vegetation / soil / water / snow / clouds / shadows), perfect for cloud masking.
- Finished products can be loaded into the QGIS project automatically.
plugins.author: Grzegorz Górniak

plugins.name: ALHAMBRA
plugins.description: ALHAMBRA is a QGIS plugin for analyzing metropolitan agglomeration through road-network morphology, multi-origin fractal box counting, characteristic agglomeration scale, network centrality, and multi-epsilon spatial clustering.
plugins.about: ALHAMBRA - Agglomeration-level Heuristic Algorithm for Metropolitan-based Regional Analysis - is a research-oriented QGIS plugin developed from Firman Afrianto's doctoral dissertation in Urban and Regional Planning at Universitas Gadjah Mada. It operationalizes the Fraktal Morfogenesis (Fractal Morphogenesis) framework to examine metropolitan agglomeration as an evolving spatial process through the combined analysis of network structure, fractal scaling, and spatial clustering. The workflow extracts topologically meaningful road-network nodes, performs multi-origin box counting and classic global fractal scaling, estimates empirical characteristic agglomeration scales, calculates degree, closeness, betweenness, and eigenvector centrality, and evaluates spatial concentration using multi-epsilon DBSCAN. Outputs include box-counting statistics, agglomeration-scale indicators, topology diagnostics, centrality layers and profiles, DBSCAN cluster assignments and hulls, modern light-mode PNG figures, GeoPackage layers, CSV summaries, metadata JSON, and diagnostic run logs. ALHAMBRA is intended for metropolitan morphology analysis, comparative urban network research, agglomeration dynamics assessment, spatial structure interpretation, and reproducible urban and regional planning research. The theoretical framework has been published as "Beyond Static Boundaries: An Integrated Framework of Space Syntax, Fractals, and Spatial Clustering for Urban Agglomeration Dynamics", Journal of Regional and City Planning, 37(1):32-51, April 2026, DOI: 10.5614/jpwk.2026.37.1.2.
plugins.author: Firman Afrianto

It lets you, from one dialog: (1) load a vector layer from a file and preview its fields, feature count and geometry type before adding it to the map view, (2) inspect the field list (name and type) of any vector layer already loaded in the project, (3) copy selected (or all) fields to the clipboard for pasting into Excel/Notepad, (4) delete one or more selected fields, with a confirmation prompt, (5) add a new field (Text, Integer, LongLong, Double, Boolean, Date) with basic validation, (6) enable/disable labels on the layer, choose the field to display, the font size, and a single label color, with a white halo applied automatically for readability, and (7) optionally assign a different color to each distinct value of the labeling field (rule-based labeling), with an auto-generated color palette that can be adjusted per value.

Whenever a point's location changes, it compares the old and new position, shows the shift distance on the canvas next to the point, and displays a distance summary directly inside the dock panel (no popups). A configurable Warning Distance highlights shifts that exceed your set limit right in the panel. Page Up / Page Down keys (or on-screen buttons) let you jump between point features without leaving editing mode. Compatible with QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x (Qt5 and Qt6).

The optional turbine-driveway workflow uses a cached county OpenStreetMap query and falls back cleanly when offline.
