plugins.name: Bambi - QGIS Integration
plugins.description: Detect and track wildlife in drone videos/photos with geo-referencing
plugins.about:
A comprehensive QGIS plugin for detecting, tracking, and geo-referencing wildlife in aerial drone recordings (videos or still photos) from DJI Enterprise drones with thermal and/or RGB cameras.
Features include:
- Frame extraction and undistortion from drone videos (SRT timestamps) or photo collections (EXIF)
- Animal detection using YOLO models (auto-downloaded from HuggingFace)
- Multi-object tracking with built-in, BoxMOT, or geo-referenced backends; import of pre-computed TRex tracklets
- Geo-referencing of detections, tracks, and SAM3 segmentations onto a DEM (real-world UTM coordinates)
- Flight route visualization and perpendicular distance sampling for transect-based surveys
- Survey analytics: kernel-density heatmaps, line-transect distance-sampling density/abundance estimation (from detections or tracks), and transect-based population estimation (naive, bootstrap, zero-inflated negative binomial)
- Per-frame camera field-of-view footprints and coverage areas
- Georeferenced map products: per-frame GeoTIFFs, true orthomosaics, and ALFS light-field mosaics
- DEM import: automatic download (Austria), GeoTIFF conversion, or flat surface meshes for aquatic surveys
- Calibration wizards for camera intrinsics (single-camera SfM, stereo RGB+thermal) and per-flight pose corrections
- Companion tools: result video creator, radiometric thermal image viewer (DJI Thermal SDK), randomized transect flight planner, and interactive map-canvas inspectors
- Key-frame based labelling tool: review detections/tracks on extracted frames (thermal or RGB), draw and edit track bounding boxes with species/sex/age/occlusion classes, interpolate between key frames, and propagate boxes of one or several tracks across frames via DEM geo-referencing
- Transect splitting tool: split a flight into named transects (frame ranges) on the extracted frames, with a flight-route overview map, flight-path length measurement and an "end after X metres" helper
- Results stored in GeoPackages that carry their own meaning: every detection has an id the later steps refer to, user-defined fields travel through the whole pipeline, and each step records what it produced and what it invalidated
- Export to COCO, YOLO, MOT, TRex tracklets, GeoJSON, Camtrap DP and Darwin Core Archive (GBIF publishing)
- Several flights per QGIS project, each with its own target folder, configuration and layer group
- Built-in dependency manager to install all required and optional packages from within QGIS
All results are automatically added as styled layers to the QGIS project, grouped per flight.
plugins.author: Christoph Praschl, Anna Maschek, David C.Schedl

plugins.name: Aerial LiDAR Classifier

on first use, with no impact on QGIS's own Python. The model is
distributed under CC BY-NC 4.0; full documentation, the GPU
driver table and the CLI / Processing usage are on the project
homepage: https://github.com/akharroubi/AerialLidarClassifier

plugins.name: GeoPrompt Urban Scenario Visualizer
plugins.description:
GeoPrompt Urban Scenario Visualizer is a QGIS plugin designed to generate AI-assisted georeferenced urban and regional planning scenario visualizations from the active QGIS map canvas.

The plugin converts a selected QGIS canvas extent into an image, sends it to supported image-generation or image-editing providers, and writes the generated result back into QGIS as a georeferenced GeoTIFF layer.

GeoPrompt is designed to help planners, designers, researchers, and policy analysts communicate spatial planning alternatives through visually rich scenario images while preserving the original map extent and coordinate reference system.

The plugin supports planning-oriented visual workflows for detailed spatial planning, strategic environmental assessment, transit-oriented development, low-carbon districts, green infrastructure, sponge city strategies, complete streets, urban heat mitigation, and inclusive public realm design.

This tool allows urban and regional planning practitioners to transform QGIS map views into scenario-based visual intelligence for workshops, presentations, policy communication, and early-stage planning exploration.

The plugin is designed for applications including:
1. AI-assisted urban planning scenario visualization
2. Detailed spatial plan and land-use concept communication
3. Strategic environmental assessment and climate adaptation illustration
4. Transit-oriented development and mobility corridor visualization
5. Low-carbon, net-zero, sponge city, and green infrastructure scenario design
6. Urban design framework and public realm visualization
7. Planning communication for public consultation, workshops, and presentations
plugins.about:
GeoPrompt Urban Scenario Visualizer provides a geospatial AI workflow to convert QGIS map canvases into georeferenced planning scenario outputs.

The plugin exports a selected map extent from the QGIS canvas, sends the exported image and user-selected prompt preset to supported AI image providers, receives the generated image result, and writes it back into the project as a GeoTIFF layer with spatial reference, extent, prompt metadata, model metadata, and AI-use warnings.

Core capabilities include provider switching between OpenAI and Google Gemini Image, curated Urban and Regional Planning prompt presets, Basic / Intermediate / Advanced preset categories, preserve-geometry mode, no-zoom prompt guarding, ratio-locked selection, optional padding and crop alignment, direct loading into the QGIS Layers Panel, optional zoom-to-result, custom model ID support, and metadata embedding inside output GeoTIFFs.

The prompt preset library supports contemporary planning themes such as complete streets, walkability, 15-minute neighborhoods, transit-supportive development, bus priority corridors, sponge city planning, climate resilience, blue-green infrastructure, urban heat mitigation, net-zero districts, inclusive public realm, post-mining recovery, tourism corridors, land-use zoning, development control, urban growth boundaries, waterfront setbacks, and public facility reservation.

GeoPrompt is intended as a planning communication and scenario visualization tool. It does not produce official statutory maps, survey-grade spatial data, land parcel delineations, authoritative land-use classifications, or legally binding planning outputs. Generated images should be reviewed by qualified professionals before being used in reports, plans, consultations, or decision-support processes.
plugins.author: Firman Afrianto, Maya Safira

The tool models topographic suitability using a Digital Elevation Model, slope, curvature, relative topographic risk, suitability classes, potential access zones, suggested least-cost routes and access corridors. The plugin does not automatically detect roads, pastures, existing trails, land cover, hydrography or legal restrictions; these layers should be used as complementary evidence in QGIS. S.) as a product of his master's research in Biodiversity in Protected Areas, associated with the Escola Nacional de Botanica Tropical and Jardim Botanico do Rio de Janeiro, under the supervision of Leandro Freitas. Associated project: Herpeto Mantiqueira.

plugins.name: River Slope Calculator
plugins.description: Calculate river reach slope from a DEM using Average Slope or Equal Area Slope. Output unit selectable: m/m or %.
plugins.about:
River Slope Calculator computes the slope of each river reach feature (line or multiline) from an underlying DEM raster, supporting two methods:

1. Average Slope (Mean Gradient) — The absolute elevation difference between reach endpoints divided by the total reach length. The simplest and most commonly used slope measure.

2. Equal Area Slope — The slope of a line through the outlet that creates equal areas above and below the longitudinal elevation profile. Adopted in Australian Rainfall and Runoff (ARR, 1987) for the Bransby Williams time-of-concentration formula. Reference: Ladson (2017), NZ Ministry of Works (1980).

Both methods compute slope internally as dimensionless values (m/m). A new Output unit option lets you choose between m/m (dimensionless) and % (percent) — the result is multiplied by 100 when percent is selected. Slope values are added as new fields on a copy of the input reach layer. DEM elevation is sampled at a user-defined interval along each reach using trapezoidal integration for the Equal Area Slope.

Requirements:

- Python 3.11 or later
- Docker Desktop (for local InSAR processing)
- Free Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem account (dataspace.copernicus.eu)

plugins.name: QSWOT
plugins.description: Discover, download, visualize, and analyze SWOT satellite hydrology data (river reaches and lakes) from NASA PO.DAAC's Hydrocron API.

.
Requires QGIS 3.0+. Bundled Python packages used: numpy and matplotlib
(both ship with standard QGIS installs). scipy is optional and only
needed for Spearman / Kendall correlations; Pearson works without it.
To install scipy into QGIS's Python on Windows, see:
https://landscapearchaeology.org/2018/installing-python-packages-in-qgis-3-for-windows/
.
Network access required to soto.podaac.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov,
fts.podaac.earthdata.nasa.gov, and lakes.swot-lake.workers.dev. The
plugin uses QgsNetworkAccessManager so QGIS proxy and SSL settings are
honored automatically.
.
Coverage is global but only where SWOT has observed; data starts from
late 2022 (SWOT operational launch). Source code and issue tracker on
GitHub.

plugins.name: Raster Vectorizer
plugins.description: Vectorize scanned topographic maps using interactive HSV colour-range classification
plugins.about:
Converts scanned raster maps (JPEG/PNG/GeoTIFF) into polygon vector layers.

Workflow:
1. Draw a rectangle on the map to sample colours
2. K-means auto-clustering splits the region into colour groups
3. Adjust HSV ranges and tolerance per class
4. Run: median pre-filter → HSV classification → morphological clean-up → GDAL Polygonize
5. Result: a polygon vector layer with class_id and class_name attributes

Key features:
- HSV colour space matching (perceptually uniform, easy to tune)
- K-means auto-classification (2–25 clusters)
- Median filter preprocessing (removes JPEG noise without blurring edges)
- Morphological opening/closing (removes specks, fills gaps)
- Handles non-standard GeoTransform (rotated/flipped rasters via GDAL Warp)
- Live preview overlay while editing HSV ranges
- Export/import colour classes as JSON
- SciPy optional (NumPy fallback for all operations)

Developed as part of a research project under the supervision of
Pavel P. Lepekhin (Лепехин Павел Павлович).

plugins.name: Itinera – Least-Cost Pathways
plugins.description: Least-Cost Path, Corridor (LCC), FETE and PDI validation for archaeological movement modelling.
plugins.about: Anisotropic cost-surface analysis using scipy.sparse Dijkstra. Provides Processing algorithms (Slope Cost Surface, Friction Cost Surface, LCP, Stochastic LCP, Corridor, FETE, PDI Validation, Resample DEM) plus an interactive map-click tool for point-to-point LCP. No external pip dependencies required (uses numpy/scipy bundled with QGIS). Released under the MIT licence.
plugins.author: Patrick Leiverkus (DAO)

plugins.name: TAF Italia
plugins.description: IT: Scarica e converte i Punti Fiduciali (TAF) dell'Agenzia delle Entrate in CSV/GeoPackage WGS84. / EN: Downloads and converts Italian Revenue Agency Fiducial Points (TAF) into WGS84 CSV/GeoPackage.
plugins.about: ITA: TAF Italia automatizza il download dei Punti Fiduciali catastali dall'Agenzia delle Entrate, li converte dal sistema Cassini-Soldner/Gauss-Boaga al WGS84 (EPSG:4326) e li esporta in formato CSV caricabile direttamente in QGIS. ATTENZIONE: i dati potrebbero contenere punti outlier gia' presenti nel dato originale dell'Agenzia delle Entrate. Il plugin determina il sistema di riferimento dal valore della coordinata Est (soglie Gauss-Boaga Ovest/Est, Cassini-Soldner). Le coordinate Cassini-Soldner usano il modello delle 31 Grandi Origini nazionali, non le singole origini comunali, con possibili scostamenti di decine di metri. Include un editor visivo di origini locali (export template CSV, import da file, salvataggio configurazione), generazione automatica link monografie, tematizzazione QGIS (triangolo verde, label PF/FG/COM, azione apertura browser) e mappa interattiva OSM. ENG: TAF Italia automates the download of cadastral Fiducial Points from the Italian Revenue Agency, converts them from Cassini-Soldner/Gauss-Boaga to WGS84 (EPSG:4326) and exports them as CSV files directly loadable in QGIS. WARNING: data may contain outlier points already present in the original Italian Revenue Agency data. The plugin detects the CRS from the Easting value thresholds. Cassini-Soldner coordinates use the 31 Great National Origins model, not single municipal origins, with possible deviations of tens of meters. Includes a visual local origins editor, automatic monografia link generation, QGIS styling (green triangle, PF/FG/COM labels, browser action) and interactive OSM map.
plugins.author: Dott. Sarino Alfonso Grande

plugins.name: AgenticGIS
plugins.description: An in-QGIS agentic chat assistant that operates QGIS via PyQGIS. Connect with an API key, compatible endpoint, or local CLI agent.
plugins.about: AgenticGIS adds a chat dock to QGIS. Type a request in natural language and an LLM agent carries it out by generating and running PyQGIS code, giving it access to QGIS, Processing, project layers, and installed plugins. Requirements: QGIS 3.22 or newer (including QGIS 4) and an LLM connection using a provider API key, compatible custom endpoint, or installed local CLI agent. The plugin has no bundled Python package dependencies. Google Earth Engine features are optional and require the Google Earth Engine QGIS plugin to be installed and authenticated separately.
plugins.author: Muhammad Alichamdan

plugins.name: Arraymaker
plugins.description: Makes points in a circle around a central point
plugins.about: Defines points on a circle. Define radius of circle and number of points. Click once for the centre point and once in the direction of the first point
plugins.author: Morten Sickel

plugins.name: Instant WebGIS Viewer
plugins.description: Export QGIS vector and raster layers to a fully interactive shareable HTML WebGIS map in one click. No server, no Apache, no configuration needed.
plugins.about: Instant WebGIS Viewer exports any QGIS vector or raster layer to a beautiful self-contained HTML map that works in any browser. Features include: automatic QGIS layer colour and style application, colour picker for vector layers, statistics panel, attribute table with pagination, feature search, click-to-inspect feature info popup, 9 basemap options, opacity control, print button, QR code mobile sharing. Works offline. No server required.
plugins.author: Ballu Harish, Hrishikesh Tambe

plugins.name: Velantis Wind
plugins.description: Wind-farm pre-assessment in QGIS: Energy/AEP, Noise and Shadow Flicker workflows.
plugins.about: Experimental open-source QGIS plugin for early-stage wind-farm pre-assessment. It includes Energy/AEP workflows, wind-turbine noise screening and shadow flicker analysis. This package is marked as compatible with QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x. A Qt5/Qt6 compatibility layer is included, but QGIS 4 support should still be validated with real installations and user feedback. Important installation note: the Energy/AEP module requires PyWake to be installed separately in the same Python environment used by QGIS. PyWake is not a QGIS plugin and will not appear in the QGIS plugin manager. On Windows, open OSGeo4W Shell and run: python -m pip install py_wake==2.6.18. Then restart QGIS. Noise and Shadow Flicker can be tested independently without PyWake. This experimental release is intended for screening, layout comparison, workflow testing and technical feedback. It is not certified regulatory or bankable assessment software. Full installation instructions, documentation and troubleshooting are available on the project website and GitHub repository.
plugins.author: VelantisWind Project

plugins.name: Isoliner - грид и изолинии
plugins.description: 2D kriging (GSLIB KB2D) and isoline / contour-polygon generation in QGIS. Кригинг 2D (GSLIB KB2D) и построение изолиний/контурных полигонов в QGIS.
plugins.about:
A Processing toolset for point-data interpolation and isolines: 2D kriging (points to raster, GSLIB KB2D core), experimental variogram with model fitting, leave-one-out cross-validation, optional trend removal (regression kriging), isolines and contour polygons whose boundaries coincide with the lines, reusable processing profiles, and a sample-data generator. Suitable for roof elevations, thicknesses, geomechanical properties, chemistry and any numeric attribute. Bilingual (EN/RU) user manual (PDF) is bundled, opened by the language of the QGIS interface. Two companion plugins work alongside it: Isoliner3D (https://github.com/Valery35/qgis-isoliner3d) shows the surfaces and bodies in a 3D scene, and Topoliner (https://github.com/Valery35/topoliner) puts the topology of polygon and line layers in order before interpolation. Developed with the support of Inform++ LLC (www.informpp.ru).
.
Группа команд Processing для интерполяции точечных данных и построения изолиний: 2D Kriging (точки в растр, ядро GSLIB KB2D), экспериментальная вариограмма с подбором модели, кросс-валидация (leave-one-out), опциональное снятие тренда (регрессия-кригинг), изолинии и контурные полигоны с совпадающими границами, профили обработки и генератор учебных данных. Подходит для отметок пласта, мощностей, ФМС, химии и любых числовых атрибутов. Двуязычное руководство пользователя (PDF, EN/RU) в комплекте, открывается по языку интерфейса QGIS. Рядом работают два плагина того же набора: Isoliner3D (https://github.com/Valery35/qgis-isoliner3d) показывает поверхности и тела в 3D-сцене, а Topoliner (https://github.com/Valery35/topoliner) приводит в порядок топологию полигональных и линейных слоёв перед интерполяцией. Разработано при поддержке ООО «Информ++» (www.informpp.ru).
plugins.author: ООО «Информ++»

plugins.name: LasBuildSeg
plugins.description: An automated building footprint extraction pipeline and Python library from LiDAR point clouds.
plugins.about: LasBuildSeg is an automated processing pipeline and Python library designed for extracting accurate building footprints from LiDAR point cloud data (.las/.laz format). Key Features & Workflow: • Automatically calculates adaptive height and TRI (Terrain Ruggedness Index) thresholds based on coarse-scale nDHM analysis. • Utilizes CSF (Cloth Simulation Filter) for robust ground filtering and DTM generation. • Implements morphological opening and FXAA-style edge smoothing for noise reduction. • Offers advanced false-positive elimination tools, including height variance, convex hull ratio, and elongation filters. • Supports per-connected-component alpha shape extraction to prevent vegetation merging and deliver crisp building boundaries. • Exports ready-to-use vector footprints reprojected into Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) alongside debug layers for threshold tuning.
plugins.author: Mertcan Erdem-Berk Anbaroğlu

plugins.name: Easy-OTP
plugins.description: Automated temporal accessibility analysis using OpenTripPlanner.
plugins.about:
Automates temporal accessibility analysis for public transport using
OpenTripPlanner 1.5.0. Generates per-minute travel-time surfaces, counts
continuous service-time minutes per hexagonal grid cell, and classifies
cells into four categories.
Analysis algorithms: RunTemporalAccessibility (depart-at and arrive-by
modes, optional XLSX report), CountFromExistingSurfaces,
CompareTemporalAccessibility (delta analysis), GenerateHexGrid,
PrepareStudentLayer, PopulationOverlay, GenerateIsochrones (isochrone
polygons from/to 1..N points, one time, multiple cutoffs),
GenerateIsochronesOverTime (one point, isochrones across the day for the
Temporal Controller), RunServiceCoverage (count of service points
reachable per cell within a threshold at one time; raster + optional
grid), RunOriginDestinationTimes (per-origin trip stats to one
destination: duration, in-vehicle, walk, wait, transfers; parallelised),
RunTravelTimeMatrix (N×M origin–destination travel-time matrix),
RouteViaPoints (city tour planner: ordered route through optional
via-points using nearest-neighbour + 2-opt; modes: WALK, BICYCLE, CAR,
TRANSIT,WALK).
Realtime algorithms: RunRealtimeAccessibility (RT-1, live GTFS-RT feed
integrated into OTP), RecordGtfsRt (RT-2, GTFS-RT TripUpdates archiver
for offline analysis), BuildRealizedGtfs (RT-3, reconstructs a realized
static GTFS — P50 median and P85 85th-percentile feeds — from a
RecordGtfsRt snapshot archive; output feeds can be passed directly to
RunTemporalAccessibility; requires google.protobuf bootstrapped on first
use; v0.7 adds auto-detected MATCHING_MODE and SEGMENT_SOURCE_MODE
fallbacks for feeds whose trip_id namespace or message shape differs
from Gdańsk's, e.g. Poznań/Kraków).
Setup: DownloadJre (Eclipse Temurin 8 + OTP 1.5.0 jar, SHA-256
verified), DownloadTransitData (Geofabrik OSM + Transitland GTFS),
TestOtpServer.
plugins.author: Michal Kaczorowski

plugins.name: Entrance Snapper
plugins.description: A professional-grade spatial analysis tool to identify and refine building entrances by snapping footprints to logical road infrastructure using architectural logic
plugins.about: The Entrance Snapper is designed for advanced urban accessibility modeling. Unlike standard proximity tools, it uses rule-based algorithms—including road hierarchy weighting, cosine decay for wall alignment, and neighbor consensus—to ensure address points represent true architectural entrances.
plugins.author: Roopendra Kumar. Kristen Zhao under MMU Research Accelerator Grant Project ID 5121135 (PI Kristen Zhao)

plugins.name: HeatScape
plugins.description: HeatScape is a QGIS plugin for Land Surface Temperature, UHI, and UHII analysis from Landsat 8/9 thermal imagery.
plugins.about: HeatScape calculates Land Surface Temperature (LST), Urban Heat Island (UHI) maps, and Urban Heat Island Intensity (UHII) statistics from Landsat 8/9 Band 10 rasters.
plugins.author: Arif K Wijayanto, Divisi Analisis Lingkungan dan Geospasial Modeling, IPB University

plugins.name: QDebrisFlow
plugins.description: Modelling of post-fire debris flows (O'Brien quadratic rheology + LIA). Individual source hydrographs, 5-tab interface, output layer selection, LHS analysis.
plugins.about: Models post-fire debris flows based on the quadratic rheological model of O'Brien and Julien (1985, 1988) and the local inertial approximation of the shallow water equations (LIA). Based on the FLO-2D formulation. Outputs: maximum depth envelope (h_max), maximum velocity (V_max), final deposit (h_final), flow arrival time map.
plugins.author: Aidar Khaybulin, Anna Zatonskaya, Alexander Panchenko

plugins.name: UrbanMorphoBox
plugins.description: Download and analyse OSM building footprints for urban morphology studies.
plugins.about: UrbanMorphoBox is an experimental QGIS plugin for downloading OpenStreetMap building footprints within a user-defined area. It calculates basic urban morphology indicators such as building area, average building size and building density.
plugins.author: Harald Schernthanner

plugins.name: Check-a-Kea
plugins.description: Shortcut-based polygon validation for QGIS.
plugins.about: Check-a-Kea helps users jump between polygon features and quickly write configurable validation values to a single attribute field using keyboard shortcuts. It is designed for fast manual QA of land-use and polygon classification layers.
plugins.author: James Ardo

plugins.name: ArcGIS REST Attachments Viewer
plugins.description: View ArcGIS REST FeatureServer attachments directly from QGIS.
plugins.about: This plugin detects ArcGIS REST FeatureServer layers, reads one or multiple selected features, queries their attachments by OBJECTID, and opens an HTML gallery with photos and files. Public services work directly. Private services may require a valid ArcGIS session or token.
plugins.author: Jhon Vélez

plugins.name: Raise of Slopes
plugins.description: DEM profile analysis and slope stability with limit equilibrium methods (Bishop, Morgenstern-Price, Spencer)
plugins.about:
QGIS plugin for DEM profile extraction, slope stability analysis (grid/simplex) with limit equilibrium method, stratigraphy and groundwater handling, and results export as image, report and DXF.

If you use this plugin, please cite:
Lalicata, L.M., Bressan, A., Pittaluga, S., Tamellini, L., Gallipoli, D., An Efficient Slope Stability Algorithm with Physically Consistent Parametrisation of Slip Surfaces. Int J Civ Eng 23, 671-682 (2025). https://doi.org/10.1007/s40999-024-01053-1

-- Acknowledgements: funded by the European Union NextGenerationEU and MUR (NRRP, Mission 4, Component 2, Investment 1.5) project RAISE - Robotics and AI for Socio-economic Empowerment (ECS00000035).
plugins.author: S.Pittaluga, L.M. Lalicata, A. Bressan, L. Tamellini, D. Gallipoli

plugins.name: Lithica Cloud Sync
plugins.description: Synchronize Lithica Explorer and Mapper projects from Google Drive | Sincroniza proyectos de Lithica Explorer y Mapper desde Google Drive
plugins.about:
Lithica Cloud Sync bridges Lithica Explorer and Lithica Mapper projects stored in Google Drive with desktop GIS analysis in QGIS.

Key features:
- Direct connection to Google Drive using secure OAuth 2.0.
- Automatic detection of Lithica Explorer and Lithica Mapper project backups.
- One-click download and extraction of project ZIP archives.
- Instant loading of all layers and tables within the project's GeoPackage, preserving field data structure.

Designed for geologists and field mappers to instantly visualize structural data, observations, and media collected with the Lithica Explorer Android app.

--- ESPAÑOL ---

Lithica Cloud Sync cierra la brecha entre la recolección de datos en campo y el análisis en escritorio. Proporciona una sincronización fluida y de solo lectura de los proyectos de Lithica Explorer almacenados en Google Drive directamente a QGIS.

Características principales:
- Conexión directa a Google Drive mediante OAuth 2.0 seguro.
- Detección automática de copias de seguridad de proyectos de Lithica Explorer.
- Descarga y extracción de archivos ZIP del proyecto con un solo clic.
- Carga instantánea de todas las capas y tablas del GeoPackage del proyecto, conservando la estructura de datos del campo.

Diseñado para geólogos y mapeadores de campo para visualizar al instante datos estructurales, observaciones y elementos multimedia recolectados con la app móvil Lithica Explorer.
plugins.author: Jordan Zavaleta

plugins.name: Info Layers
plugins.description: Query configured vector and vector tile layers even when they are not visible in the current map view.
plugins.about:
Query configured project vector and vector tile layers, including layers not visible in the current map view.
Use layer and field selection, wildcard-based patterns, dynamic vector tile attribute filters,
HTML templates, tabular result views, clipboard copy, CSV/XLSX export and named profiles
persisted in QGIS settings and projects.
Spatial QgsVectorLayer layers keep per-layer field selection. QgsVectorTileLayer layers use
dynamic field pattern filtering at click time because tile attributes can vary by zoom and tile.
plugins.author: Diego Mérida López

plugins.name: Geohazard
plugins.description: Plugin with various tools for landslide analysis and management
plugins.about: The Geohazard plugin incorporates several specialized algorithms to evaluate the reliability of InSAR data in monitoring slow landslide phenomena (Groundmotion – C index), to assess slope susceptibility to shallow landslides (Landslide – Shalstab), and to perform a preliminary assessment of rockfall spatial hazard (Rockfall – Droka).
plugins.author: Campus S., Castelli M., Fasciano C., Filipello A.

plugins.name: GisBR
plugins.description: Load official Brazilian spatial data (IBGE/IPEA geobr + censobr) and run a municipal Master Plan diagnostic in QGIS, using only the native QGIS API.
plugins.about: GisBR brings the "one line -> one layer" access of the geobr/censobr packages (IPEA) into QGIS as a Processing provider, using only the native QGIS/Qt API and the Python standard library (no geopandas/requests/pandas). Phase 1: legacy GeoPackage backend (geobr v1.7.0), fully native. Phase 2: Parquet backend (geobr v2.0.0) read via the GDAL Parquet driver or a pyarrow fallback, plus a join with census tables from censobr. On top of the geobr mirror, GisBR adds a municipal Master Plan diagnostic: a dock panel (state -> municipality) that loads official layers organized in 8 axes (transport, sanitation, demography, environment, education, health, urban, administrative) from WFS and ArcGIS REST services, clipped to the municipality polygon and saved to a local GeoPackage, with an optional Esri World Imagery satellite basemap. Data in SIRGAS 2000 / EPSG:4674. Licensed under GPL-3.0.
plugins.author: Diego Camargo

plugins.name: GPBoost Spatial Predictor
plugins.description: Spatial prediction with GPBoost, combining tree boosting and Gaussian processes for point observations.
plugins.about: GPBoost Spatial Predictor trains GPBoost models for spatial prediction from point layers with numeric response and covariate fields. It combines tree boosting for nonlinear covariate-response relationships with a Gaussian Process component for spatial residual autocorrelation. External dependency: the Python package gpboost>=1.4.0 must be available in the same Python environment used by QGIS. Version 1.0.6 adds both author LinkedIn profiles to the Info tab and documentation, keeps the non-blocking Info tab, and maintains the guided in-plugin installer/update button for gpboost, avoiding manual console use when the platform allows pip installation. The plugin includes an interactive dialog, a QGIS Processing algorithm, model comparison/tuning tools, and English, Spanish, and Portuguese interface labels. Current limitation: when creating prediction rasters from selected covariate fields, covariates are fixed at their median values over the prediction grid; future versions should accept raster covariate layers for fully covariate-varying maps.
plugins.author: Jesús Enrique Flores-Riera, Santiago Gallego

plugins.name: Beaver Processor
plugins.description: Build and export finished, briefing-ready map products from a guided single-window workflow.
plugins.about: Beaver Processor turns an area of interest into a clean, borderless supplemental map graphic ready to drop into briefings and documents. Pick a focus country and/or province (Natural Earth admin-0/admin-1 are bundled), choose an optional open-licensed XYZ basemap (OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, CARTO Positron/Dark Matter), run the built-in geoprocessing and symbol-insertion tools, then export to PNG, JPG or PDF at print resolution. The plugin works on its own private project and never modifies the project you have open in QGIS. No external Python dependencies: it uses only libraries shipped with QGIS. Requires an internet connection only if you enable a tile basemap.
plugins.author: Beaver Developer 0

plugins.name: FraXtex
plugins.description: Automatic geological fracture mapping from RGB orthophoto and DEM
plugins.about: FraXtex is a QGIS 3/4 plugin for automatic fracture mapping in two stages: (1) generate a fracture probability map from RGB orthophoto and DEM using ONNX deep learning models, and (2) vectorize the probability map into LineString geometry. Dependencies (numpy, rasterio, scikit-image, onnxruntime, geopandas, shapely, pygeoops) are auto-installed on first run via pip. If auto-install fails, a platform-specific manual command is shown in the Processing log. See the README for manual install instructions for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
plugins.author: Ayoub Fatihi

plugins.name: niva
plugins.description: QGIS from the command line: write concise text-pipeline geoprocessing flows (no PyQGIS coding) and run them in a dock.
plugins.about:
QGIS from the command line. A concise, readable text-pipeline grammar for QGIS
geoprocessing (load … | buffer 100m dissolve | save …) that stands on PyQGIS, but for
people who don't write PyQGIS. Reach ~878 QGIS Processing algorithms through ~45 friendly
verbs (or `run` any algorithm by id), across vector, raster, point clouds and databases.
This plugin adds a dock where you write or open a .niva flow file and run it in the current
QGIS session; results land on the map. The same grammar also runs as a standalone
command-line tool and REPL (pip install qgis-niva). niva is bundled with the plugin
(zero-dependency, pure Python), so there is no separate install step on Windows, macOS, or
Linux. It runs in-process on QGIS's own Python and Processing algorithms and can run without
QGIS itself even running (batch jobs).
plugins.author: John Zastrow

plugins.name: Réunion MF
plugins.description: AROME overseas forecasts and precipitation radar mosaic (Météo-France) for Réunion Island, with native regional view, reprojected Réunion view (EPSG:2975), animated time series and near real-time radar updates.
plugins.about:
This plugin brings together three modules in a single panel:
- AROME (forecasts): queries the AROME Overseas package API (Indian Ocean domain, 0.025° grid), with dynamic parameter discovery, regional or Réunion view, automatic styling, and animated time series via the Temporal Controller.
- Radar (near real-time): queries the Radar package API, extracts the Réunion precipitation mosaic (Piton Villers + Colorado radars, 500 m resolution, 5-minute steps), manual refresh building a local sliding history.
- Observations (weather stations): queries the Observations package API, displays hourly station measurements for Réunion Island, with native temporal animation (vector layer).
A Météo-France API key (portail-api.meteofrance.fr, "API Key" mode) is required, shared across all three modules.

Developed with the assistance of an AI tool (Claude, Anthropic), under human supervision and validation for each component.

---
Version française : ce plugin regroupe trois modules Météo-France pour La Réunion (AROME, Radar, Observations) dans un panneau QGIS unique. Voir le README du dépôt pour le détail complet en français.
plugins.author: Cyriel Adnes (DEAL Réunion - SCETE-USIG)

plugins.name: RoadDigitizz
plugins.description: Interactive road digitizing with automatic centerline and polygon creation using real-time buffer preview.
plugins.about:
RoadDigitizz: Smart Road Digitizing for QGIS

Draw a road centerline and let the plugin automatically create both the centerline and the corresponding road polygon with a real-time buffer preview.
Perfect for transportation mapping, urban planning, and GIS data creation.

Features:
• Real-time buffer preview
• Configurable road width
• Multiple cap & join styles
• Snap support & undo
• Optional road width attribute storage (RDZWidth)
• Automatic CRS-aware distance handling

Digitize once, get both layers instantly.
plugins.author: Dwi Wahyu Utomo

plugins.name: DigDok
plugins.description: Basemaps and data layers for the Norwegian cultural-heritage sector
plugins.about:
DigDok Maps adds one-click menu shortcuts for background maps and Norwegian open-data / cultural-heritage layers, aimed at archaeology and heritage documentation.

Norwegian sources: Riksantikvaren (kulturminner), Kartverket (topographic cache, Matrikkelen, historical maps, administrative units, elevation), NGU (geology), NIBIO (land resources), Geodata, UNIMUS (Gjenstandsbasen) and ADED (excavation data).

Global basemaps: Google, Bing, Esri, Carto, OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, F4map and Stadia Maps (incl. the Stamen styles, shaded relief, terrarium and vector tilesets). Stadia layers need a free API key, set from the DigDok menu and stored in the QGIS authentication database. All layers carry attribution.

Derived from the HCMGIS plugin by Thang Quach (opengeoshub/HCMGIS, GPL-3.0): https://github.com/opengeoshub/HCMGIS
plugins.author: Hallvard Indgjerd

plugins.name: Basdonax Keyline from DEM
plugins.description: Computational design of Keyline infiltration lines from DEM/DTM.
plugins.about: Basdonax Keyline from DEM is a QGIS Processing plugin for computational design of infiltration lines, Keyline-inspired layouts and regenerative hydrological landscape planning from digital terrain models. It includes DEM validation, hydrological analysis, D8 flow accumulation, potential drainage detection, design units, intelligent mother lines and multicriteria optimization using WDI and ICL indicators.
plugins.author: Basdonax

plugins.name: SkyStitch - Drone Orthomosaic
plugins.description: From drone photos to a finished map — a fast 2D orthomosaic, or full 3D photogrammetry (orthophoto, DSM, DTM, point cloud, 3D mesh) — all inside QGIS. Free, open-source, and your imagery stays on your machine.
plugins.about:
SkyStitch brings drone mapping right into QGIS — point it at a folder of GPS-tagged photos and get map-ready results without leaving QGIS or paying for the cloud.

Two engines, one plugin:
- Fast 2D — stitch a single georeferenced orthomosaic (GeoTIFF) in seconds. Great for quick previews and flat sites.
- Full 3D — real SfM/MVS photogrammetry on a local NodeODM node: a true orthophoto plus DSM, DTM/DEM, point cloud (LAZ) and a textured 3D mesh (OBJ), straight onto the canvas.

Why you'll like it:
- 100% free & open-source — and your imagery never leaves your machine.
- No cloud, no subscriptions, no Docker to wrestle — install one lightweight local engine (e.g. the free WebODM native installer) and run everything from QGIS.
- Survey-grade when you need it — drop in GCPs for centimetre-level accuracy.
- Background processing with a live log, progress bar and one-click Test Connection.

Requires QGIS 3.16 or newer.
plugins.author: Muhammad Kholifatkhur Rohman

plugins.name: Computo Metrico GIS
plugins.description: Computo metrico e contabilita lavori in QGIS con prezziari regionali o CSV/XLSX/DCF, SAL, report PDF/XLSX e progetto dimostrativo. / Bill of quantities and works accounting in QGIS with Italian regional price lists or CSV/XLSX/DCF files, progress payments (SAL), PDF/XLSX reports and a demo project.
plugins.about: IT: Plugin sperimentale per computo metrico estimativo e contabilita lavori con database SQLite locale, import validato dei prezziari, misurazioni automatiche da geometrie, SAL, giornale lavori e reportistica professionale. I risultati vanno sempre verificati da un tecnico abilitato prima dell'uso contrattuale. / EN: Experimental plugin for bill of quantities and works accounting with a local SQLite database, validated price list import, automatic measurements from geometries, progress payments (SAL), works journal and professional reporting. Results must always be verified by a qualified professional before contractual use.
plugins.author: Dott. Sarino Alfonso Grande

plugins.name: Fireline Planner
plugins.description: Prioritize forest blocks and plan fire line placement using multi-criteria vulnerability analysis
plugins.about: Scores forest blocks by fire vulnerability (fire history, slope, proximity to villages/roads/HQ), allocates a fire-line budget (km) across the highest priority blocks, and generates candidate fire-line alignments along the forest-village interface, set back inside the forest.
plugins.author: Karthick V

plugins.name: RivaPlan
plugins.description: RivaPlan automates river planform morphology analysis in QGIS.
plugins.about: RivaPlan is a QGIS Processing plugin for automated river planform morphology analysis. The current version includes tools for centreline generation, river width extraction, bankline shifting, centreline shifting, sinuosity analysis, and local curvature estimation.
plugins.author: Rohit Sharma

plugins.name: oceanum-datamesh
plugins.description: Search, query, load and display Oceanum Datamesh ocean & environmental data directly in QGIS.
plugins.about:
A QGIS plugin for the Oceanum Datamesh platform. Search the Datamesh catalog, inspect dataset
metadata, then query and load data into QGIS as native layers: gridded datasets become raster layers,
feature datasets become vector layers, and station/table data become point or attribute-table layers.
Requires a Datamesh access token (set the DATAMESH_TOKEN environment variable or enter it in the plugin).
Depends on the `oceanum` Python package, which the plugin can install for you on first run.
plugins.author: Oceanum Developers

plugins.name: GEAQUA Capture Zones
plugins.description: Analytical delineation of groundwater time-of-travel capture zones for a single pumping well.
plugins.about: GEAQUA Capture Zones is a Polish-English QGIS tool for analytical delineation of time-of-travel capture zones for one pumping well in a homogeneous aquifer with uniform regional groundwater flow. The current method follows Ceric and Haitjema (2005) and supports centric circular, eccentric circular and uniform-flow capture-zone approximations, including the zero ambient-flow limit. The plugin is intended for screening, documentation and hydrogeological analysis. Calculated zones require professional review and are not automatically legally designated protection areas. No external Python dependencies are required.
plugins.author: Maciej Nikiel & Grzegorz Nikiel

plugins.name: QuickMapCompare
plugins.description: Build a grid of side-by-side viewports in a dockable panel to compare QGIS layers, built-in tile basemaps, and web map providers at once, with per-viewport live sync to the main map canvas.
plugins.about: QuickMapCompare builds a grid of side-by-side "viewports" in a dockable panel, each showing a QGIS layer, a native WMS/XYZ tile basemap (OpenStreetMap, Esri, CartoDB, Google Maps, Bing Maps, and more), or an embedded Web Map Provider. Every viewport can live-sync to the main QGIS canvas as you pan and zoom, and layer/tile viewports support an on-canvas "Swipe Compare" gesture (hold S and drag) to compare directly against the live canvas with no separate window.
plugins.author: Pixeled Dimensions

plugins.name: Style Reloader for GeoServer
plugins.description: A QGIS plugin to sync layer styles from QGIS to GeoServer via REST API
plugins.about: Style Reloader allows you to export layer styles as SLD and push them directly to your GeoServer instance with one click.
plugins.author: Josep Quevedo i Pau Morell

plugins.name: PipaRouter
plugins.description: Programação de rotas de caminhão-pipa para abastecimento emergencial de água
plugins.author: Antonio A. Coelho Neto

plugins.name: Map to HTML
plugins.description: Publish any number of QGIS layers as a standalone Leaflet/HTML/JS web map, each keeping its own symbology and labels.
plugins.about: Pick any number of layers from the current QGIS project and export a self-contained web map (HTML + per-layer GeoJSON/style JSON) that runs in any browser without a server, qgis2web-style. Each layer's symbology (marker color/size/shape, line, fill and hatch patterns, transparency, labels) is extracted from QGIS and carried over as-is, with a toggle panel to show/hide layers, a cross-layer text search bar, a sortable per-layer attribute table, and feature selection with CSV/GeoJSON export.
plugins.author: rinyu

plugins.name: USGS 3DEP Downloader
plugins.description: Download USGS 3DEP DEM GeoTIFFs for the current QGIS map view
plugins.about: Downloads USGS 3DEP staged elevation GeoTIFF tiles for the current QGIS canvas extent and adds them to the project.
plugins.author: Spencer Thomas

plugins.name: Advanced Profile Tool
plugins.description: Alignment-based cross-section generation, multi-DEM profile extraction, interactive section viewer, terrain comparison, volumes, and CAD/report exports (CSV, Excel, PDF, PNG, SVG, DXF).
plugins.about: Alignment-based cross-section generation, multi-DEM profile extraction, interactive section viewer, terrain comparison, volumes, and CAD/report exports (CSV, Excel, PDF, PNG, SVG, DXF).
plugins.author: Nikhil Jacob

plugins.name: quickdraw tools
plugins.description: Draw simple shapes fast and add them straight to the Map Registry as memory& shape layers.
plugins.about: quickdraw Tools speeds up on-the-fly digitizing in QGIS: point, line, rectangle, circle, polygon and buffer tools that write straight into memory layers, with configurable fill/stroke colors, stroke width, remembered layers and attribute field name, all saved between sessions.
plugins.author: leonya ivanchikov

plugins.name: Kakao QGIS Bridge
plugins.description: Dock-based Kakao Map and Roadview viewer with bidirectional QGIS synchronization and Local search.
plugins.about: Shows Kakao Maps JavaScript API content inside a QGIS dock widget and synchronizes QGIS, Kakao Map, and Roadview in both directions. Includes Local place/address search, Roadview position/direction display, Kakao Mobility route search, route guidance, and route history import/export. Requires user-provided Kakao JavaScript and REST API keys. Kakao tile URLs are not extracted or used as XYZ/TMS layers.
plugins.author: yjkim

plugins.name: FIRE-SCENE — External Wildfire Risk
plugins.description: External wildfire risk analysis for urbanizations (FIRE-SCENE Pilot 1).
plugins.about:
QGIS Desktop plugin for the FIRE-SCENE external wildfire risk methodology
(buffers, orientation wedges, hazard medians, ZHR alignment, terrain and access).
Owned and maintained by CTFC.
plugins.author: CTFC — Centre de Ciència i Tecnologia Forestal de Catalunya

plugins.name: Shoreliser
plugins.description: Shoreline change analysis pipeline: clip, Hovmöller diagram, DSAS statistics, and an interactive space-time cube — driven from a 4-tab side panel.
plugins.about: Shoreline-change analysis in four guided steps: clip & split baseline, Hovmöller diagram (width & change rasters with a labelled axis grid), DSAS statistics, and an interactive 3D space-time cube. Provides both a dockable 4-tab panel and a Processing provider. Licensed under GPL-3.0. Archived on Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/21410974
plugins.author: Iuliia Horkovchuk

plugins.name: Gerador de RCO
plugins.description: Generates RCO documents from vector layer fields in QGIS.
plugins.about: Independent tool for analyzing vector layer fields, suggesting field types and descriptions from a bundled reference catalog, and generating RCO documents in DOCX format. It is not officially affiliated with SEMAD, Sisema, or IDE-Sisema. Results must be reviewed by the responsible professional. / Ferramenta independente para analisar campos de camadas vetoriais, sugerir tipologias e descrições a partir de um catálogo de referência e gerar documentos RCO em formato DOCX. Não possui vínculo oficial com a SEMAD, o Sisema ou a IDE-Sisema. Os resultados devem ser revisados pelo responsável técnico.
plugins.author: Arthur Coelho Felisberto

plugins.name: WAI QGIS MCP
plugins.description: Let trusted AI assistants inspect, map, and automate QGIS
plugins.about: WAI QGIS MCP lets trusted AI assistants inspect projects, manage layers, run Processing algorithms, render maps, and execute PyQGIS code. Setup: open Plugins > WAI QGIS MCP and click Start Server. For Codex or the ChatGPT desktop app, install Node.js 18 or later, run "codex mcp add qgis -- npx -y qgis-mcp" in a terminal, then restart the assistant. For Claude Desktop, download the MCPB asset from the latest GitHub release and install it from Settings > Extensions > Advanced settings > Install Extension. For Claude Code, install Node.js 18 or later, run "/plugin marketplace add wiseman/qgis_mcp" followed by "/plugin install qgis-mcp@qgis-mcp", then run "/reload-plugins". Keep QGIS running while using the assistant. Only connect assistants you trust. See the homepage for complete setup and troubleshooting.
plugins.author: John Wiseman

plugins.name: Parcel Watershed Delineation
plugins.description: Delineates a single watershed for one or more parcels using one or more DEMs.
plugins.about: Delineates watershed contributing area for parcels. Workflow: 1. Load DEM(s) and Parcel layer. 2. Set boundary points and options. 3. Run algorithm to merge DEMs, condition raster, calculate D8 flow accumulation, and output single watershed polygon with calculated attributes. DISCLAIMER & ACKNOWLEDGMENTS: Developed with the assistance of Claude Sonnet and Google Gemini AI models. This tool is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. Results (watershed boundaries, outlet elevations, and contributing areas) MUST be independently reviewed, double-checked, and verified by a qualified professional before engineering or planning use. Author assumes no liability for errors or misuse.
plugins.author: Dario Di Nunzio

plugins.name: Precisa GEO 2 Earth
plugins.description: Exports QGIS layers to a KMZ organized in folders (Features, Labels, Hatching, Orthomosaic), preserving the current symbology.
plugins.about: Renderiza a simbologia atual de cada camada como overlay PNG reprojetado para EPSG:4326, organiza em subpastas KML (Feições, Textos, Hachuras, Ortomosaico) e empacota em KMZ. O usuário nunca precisa configurar reprojeção — o plugin detecta o CRS de cada camada e reprojecta automaticamente.
plugins.author: Helton J. C. Lourenço

plugins.name: Flag Viewer
plugins.description: Shows the CF flag_meanings for the raster band or mesh dataset value under the cursor, like Value Tool but decoded.
plugins.about: Flag Viewer samples the raster band or mesh dataset group value under the mouse cursor and decodes it into its CF flag_meanings, using flag_values/flag_masks metadata auto-detected from the file, or a user-supplied JSON/YAML mapping. Supports both "categorized" flags (one value = one meaning) and "bitmask" flags (each bit = one meaning).
plugins.author: Colin Moldenhauer

plugins.name: HYDRA2DGPU
plugins.description: GPU-accelerated 2D shallow water equation solver for QGIS
plugins.about:
HYDRA2DGPU performs 2D hydrodynamic flood and surface-water modelling using a CUDA finite-volume solver. It couples unstructured meshes, 1D drainage networks, hydraulic structures, and rainfall / infiltration, all inside the QGIS map canvas.

This plugin requires an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA support (compute capability >= 7.5). On first launch the plugin installs the hydra-swe2d solver backend into an isolated per-user Python environment; Windows and Linux x86_64 are supported, macOS is not.

Manual / advanced install: see https://github.com/aspragueumkc/hydra2dgpu#readme.
plugins.author: Aaron Sprague

plugins.name: Polygon Split By Ratio
plugins.description: Split a polygon by given ratios or by an exact target area, using cut lines parallel to a chosen reference line
plugins.about: Two tools: (1) Splits a selected polygon into any number of parts according to given area ratios (e.g. 3,2,1), with cut lines parallel to a chosen reference line. (2) Cuts an exact target area (e.g. 3.12 ha) starting from a real cut line (e.g. a stream, with its breakpoints preserved), parallel to a separate direction line, measured on the right-hand side of that line's direction. Useful for forestry stand/compartment subdivision and similar cadastral or planning tasks. / Ket eszkoz: (1) A kivalasztott poligont tetszoleges szamu reszre osztja a megadott teruletaranyok szerint (pl. 3,2,1), egy kivalasztott iranyvonallal parhuzamos vagovonalakkal. (2) Pontos celteruletet (pl. 3,12 ha) vag le egy valodi vago vonaltol (pl. patak, a toresponjaival egyutt) kezdve, egy kulon megadott iranyvonallal parhuzamosan, annak iranya szerint jobb kez felol merve. Hasznos erdeszeti reszlet-felosztashoz es hasonlo kataszteri/tervezesi feladatokhoz.
plugins.author: szs

plugins.name: Deforestation Risk Analyzer
plugins.description: Per-polygon deforestation risk analysis for EUDR / MyRA parcels — raster (GFC, Hansen, WorldCover, custom TIF) and vector (Shapefile) reference layers, with Excel reporting.
plugins.about: Plugin for EUDR deforestation risk verification on agricultural / forestry parcels (cacao, MyRA). Load any number of reference layers — raster (GeoTIFF: GFC2020, Hansen/GLAD/RADD, WorldCover 10m, custom classification) or vector (Shapefile) — assign risk levels per class, and compute a risk score per polygon (coverage percentage / historical forest loss). Outputs: per-parcel risk score, per-layer risk columns, cause comments, and a coloured Excel report (summary + at-risk parcels + full attribute table).
plugins.author: Arnaud Yao, Jean-David Konan

plugins.name: Granulometria por Fotointerpretacion
plugins.description: Measures rock grain sizes in a photo by photointerpretation and exports gradation reports.
plugins.about: Granulometria por Fotointerpretacion (Photointerpretation Grain Size Analysis) measures the size of rock grains in a georeferenced photo, typically captured by drone. The user draws the photo outline to obtain the total area, then draws or adjusts grain polygons (for example, produced by a segmentation tool such as GeoAI/Segment Anything). The plugin filters grains by a sieve-size threshold, computes coarse/fine material areas and percentages, and exports: (1) an Excel workbook with area/diameter data in a fixed template layout, (2) a second Excel workbook with image and material summary information, and (3) a GeoPackage bundling the polygon layer, the source photo raster, and an embedded QGIS project, exported as-is in the project's coordinate system (no reprojection). No external Python packages are required: the plugin only uses Qt (via qgis.PyQt) and qgis.core/qgis.gui, all of which ship with QGIS. The Excel files are written natively with the zipfile/XML standard library (no openpyxl dependency). The plugin's image analysis methodology follows the principles of ISO 13322-1:2014 (Particle size analysis — Image analysis methods — Part 1: Static image analysis methods), applying static image analysis with complete pixel-count evaluation to determine particle size distributions from georeferenced photographs.
plugins.author: Jean Pardo

plugins.name: ArcGIS-like Workspace
plugins.description: Applies an ArcGIS Pro-inspired workspace preset and behavior to QGIS using native QGIS actions, toolbars, dock widgets, settings, and Qt styling.
plugins.about: This plugin rearranges QGIS into an ArcGIS Pro-inspired workspace and layers on genuine behavioral parity (contextual ribbon, Labeling toggle, Notifications, unified search, opt-in shortcuts) while keeping QGIS behavior native and reversible. It does not include Esri assets, branding, or proprietary UI code.
plugins.author: Jan TvB

plugins.name: Thiessen Irrigation Weighting
plugins.description: Computes the area-weighted average of point station data (rainfall, irrigation water requirement, discharge, etc.) using the Thiessen (Voronoi) polygon method.
plugins.about: This plugin generates Thiessen polygons (a Voronoi diagram) from point data such as meteorological or irrigation stations, optionally clips them to an irrigation area boundary, and computes the area-weighted average value (e.g. area-weighted average rainfall or irrigation water requirement) based on each polygon's area. AREA_HA, AREA_PCT and WEIGHT_CONTRIB fields are added to the result layer.
plugins.author: Selcuk Albut

plugins.name: 建築規制ボリューム検討 (Building Volume Finder)
plugins.description: Searches practical building volumes (floor area) that satisfy road/neighboring slant limits, floor-area ratio, building coverage ratio, and daylight (shadow) regulations from site conditions, and links to the "日影図・高さ制限チェッカー" (Shadow Diagram / Height Limit Checker) HTML tool via JSON. / 敷地条件から建築規制を満たす延床面積の最大ボリュームを探索する。日影図・高さ制限チェッカー（HTMLツール）とJSONで連携する。
plugins.about: EN: An initial-stage volume-study tool for consolidating/combining public facilities in Osaka City. Workflow: select a site -> automatically fetch and area-prorate the use-zone designation from Japan's National Land Numerical Information (A29) -> automatically search realistic building placements that satisfy road slant limits, neighboring-lot slant limits, floor-area ratio, building coverage ratio, and daylight/shadow regulations (including regulations triggered when the shadow falls on a neighboring regulated zone) -> export the results as a QGIS layer, JSON, and HTML. Version 0.2.0 upgrades the search from "maximize floor area only" to a practical multi-objective placement search: rotation angles are discretized to the site's own boundary directions, buildings are anchored against the site boundary instead of floating in the middle, and candidates are ranked by a combined score (floor-area ratio, usable open space, south-facing daylight) with near-duplicate results pruned. The HTML output now also shows a breakdown across multiple use zones and which shadow-regulation zone applies. It connects to the existing browser tool "日影図・高さ制限チェッカー" (Shadow Diagram / Height Limit Checker) via JSON (hikage-checker format), so a search result can be opened directly in that tool to check shadow diagrams and sections. Published as an experimental release. / JA: 大阪市の公共施設における複合化・集約化の初期ボリュームスタディ用ツール。敷地選択→用途地域の自動取得・按分（国土数値情報A29）→道路斜線・隣地斜線・容積率・建蔽率・日影規制（影が落ちる先の区域を含む）を満たす実務的な配置の自動探索→結果をレイヤ／JSON／HTMLで出力、までを行う。ver0.2.0で探索を「容積最大化のみ」から「回転角の離散化・アンカー配置・有効空地や南面採光を含む多目的スコア・類似解の間引き」による実務的な配置探索に改良し、HTML出力側にも複数用途地域の内訳や影が落ちる先の区域の判定を表示するようにした。既存のブラウザツール「日影図・高さ制限チェッカー」とJSON（hikage-checker形式）で連携し、探索結果はそのままHTMLツールで日影図・断面図を確認できる。テスト版（experimental）として公開。
plugins.author: rinyu

plugins.name: QuickShapeStatistics
plugins.description: Draw quick shapes to be used for simple zonal statistics.
plugins.about: Click a button to draw a circle or a polygon shape, which will be used to calculate basic zonal statistics on the active layer. For polygons the area will be calculated, for lines the length will be used and for points the number of points will be summarized.
plugins.author: preinzi (LiberGIS)

plugins.name: Auto House Numbering
plugins.description: Automated road-relative house numbering for selected plots/building footprints.
plugins.about: Select a road and selected plots, choose the numbering start point, and generate odd/even house numbers with the road name.
plugins.author: Lawal Lawal Adeniran

plugins.name: Terrain Product Studio
plugins.description: Publication-grade terrain maps from one DEM: 20 color palettes, USGS-style cartography, hydrology, geomorphometry, multi-hazard analysis, GeoPackage bundles, QGIS project export, 3D web viewers, restyle-without-regeneration and STL/OBJ print models.
plugins.about:
Terrain Product Studio turns one elevation raster into a full set of publication-ready layers: elevation color relief, hillshades, slope, aspect, TRI/TPI, roughness, curvatures, spot elevations, smoothed contours and rivers, geomorphons, SPI/STI, landslide and multi-hazard indexes, hydrology, an all-in-one GeoPackage bundle, a ready-to-save .qgz project and an interactive 3D web viewer. 

The Assistant tab suggests smart defaults (contour interval, stream threshold, river width/depth, working CRS) from your DEM; cartography can be restyled onto existing canvas, QML and print layouts without re-running the pipeline. 20 color ramps in Light/Dark/Scientific, one-click industry presets, STL/OBJ 3D-print export and a run-history journal.
plugins.author: Nguyễn Văn Tín

plugins.name: GeoDeploy
plugins.description: Browse a GeoDeploy instance, add its layers, and publish layers back to it.
plugins.about:
GeoDeploy is a self-hosted spatial data platform and geoportal builder. This plugin connects
QGIS to an instance: browse what it publishes (no account needed for public data), add a layer
using the fastest source it offers, and upload a QGIS layer back — including multi-gigabyte
files, which go straight to object storage. Pure Python, no external dependencies.
plugins.author: Koffi Dodji Noumonvi

plugins.name: qPansopy
plugins.description: QPANSOPY Plugin for QGIS - Procedure Analysis and Obstacle Protection Surfaces (PANSOPS)
plugins.about: QPANSOPY Plugin for QGIS to create aviation surfaces including VSS, OCS, ILS, OAS, Wind Spiral and PBN-LNAV protection surfaces according to ICAO PANS-OPS Doc 8168 standards.
plugins.author: FLYGHT7

plugins.name: HydroROC
plugins.description: Hydrological tools for QGIS: automatic watershed delineation, drainage network analysis and hydrological analysis.
plugins.about: HydroROC provides tools for watershed analysis and hydrological processing in QGIS. This version includes Automatic Watershed Delineation, Parameters I (geometry, shape and relief), and Parameters II (drainage network and time of concentration).
plugins.author: Ing. Richard Oré Cayetano

plugins.name: qAeroChart
plugins.description: ICAO Aeronautical Chart Plugin - Create approach profiles and aeronautical charts
plugins.about: Plugin for creating aeronautical charts following ICAO Annex 4 and Doc 8697 standards and industry best practices
plugins.author: FLYGHT7

plugins.name: Bhoonidhi Downloader
plugins.description: Search, browse and download open-access satellite imagery from ISRO's Bhoonidhi portal directly inside QGIS.
plugins.about:
A QGIS front-end for the bhoonidhi-downloader library (https://github.com/geovicco-dev/bhoonidhi-downloader,
MIT license). Log in with your Bhoonidhi credentials (never stored to disk --
the session lives only in memory for the current QGIS session and is
discarded on close), pick a direct-download satellite/sensor, set a date
range and a spatial filter (manual bounding box or a drawn rectangle),
search the archive, preview georeferenced scene quicklooks on the map,
and download selected scenes. Each search is saved as a revisitable
"query" for the session and cleaned up automatically when QGIS closes.
External dependency: this plugin installs the bhoonidhi-downloader
PyPI package into QGIS's Python the first time it runs (with your
confirmation), since it is not bundled in the zip.
plugins.author: Saptadeep Deshmukh

plugins.name: Terrain Analysis Symbology
plugins.description: Symbolize slope/aspect rasters with the Van Zuidam (1983) classification and compass-direction classes, plus an Aspect-Slope Bivariate Overlay (combined hue/saturation raster, with optional hillshade-blended brightness).
plugins.about: Adds three Processing algorithms for terrain-derived raster visualization. "Van Zuidam (1983) Slope Classification Symbology" classifies a slope raster into the 7 standard Van Zuidam geomorphological classes (Flat through Extremely Steep, in Degree or Percent) and applies a Singleband Pseudocolor (Discrete) renderer with class-name legend labels. "Aspect Direction Symbology (Compass Classes)" classifies an aspect raster into 4 or 8 compass-direction classes (N/E/S/W or N/NE/E/SE/S/SW/W/NW), each centered on its true compass direction, using a cyclic HSV color wheel suited to circular data, with an optional compass-rose preview. "Aspect-Slope Bivariate Overlay" combines a Slope raster and an Aspect raster into one new RGB(A) raster (hue=aspect, saturation=slope steepness), following the classic aspect-slope mapping technique of Moellering & Kimerling (1990) and Brewer & Marlow (1993), with an optional Hillshade input (Kennelly & Kimerling, 2001) that blends real relief shading into the brightness channel instead of a flat constant -- see README for references. The first two algorithms only change the input layer's symbology; the third creates a new raster file, since QGIS has no live renderer that can combine two input rasters into one color. Co-developed by Muhammad Fatahillah Mubarak together with Claude (Anthropic) as a coding assistant.
plugins.author: Muhammad Fatahillah Mubarak, with Claude (Anthropic)

plugins.name: Natural Breaks Raster Symbology
plugins.description: Classify and symbolize raster layers with Natural Breaks (Jenks), Equal Interval, or Quantile, with an optional histogram preview.
plugins.about: Adds a Processing algorithm that computes class breaks for a raster band using exact Fisher-Jenks Natural Breaks (dynamic programming), Equal Interval, or weighted Quantile methods, then applies a Singleband Pseudocolor (Discrete) renderer using any QGIS color ramp. Large rasters are read at a decimated resolution and summarized into a weighted histogram so the computation stays fast without loading every pixel into memory. An optional histogram preview (requires matplotlib) lets you compare methods and class counts visually before committing to a symbology. Originally built while producing an AHP + GIS flood-hazard map for Samarinda, Indonesia, then generalized into a standalone tool. Co-developed by Muhammad Fatahillah Mubarak together with Claude (Anthropic) as a coding assistant.
plugins.author: Muhammad Fatahillah Mubarak, with Claude (Anthropic)

plugins.name: Logis
plugins.description: QGIS plugin for logistics in Brazil, supporting urban logistics, regional logistics, and waste collection routing.
plugins.about: logis is a QGIS plugin designed to support logistics projects in Brazil. It consists of three modules: Urban Logistics (OSM-based), Regional Logistics (DNIT/SNV-based), and Specialized Logistics (waste collection routing). The plugin provides tools for calculating logistics indicators, vehicle routing (VRP/TSP), and facility location (p-median, MCLP, LSCP) using PyQGIS and Python's standard library.
plugins.author: Diego Camargo

plugins.name: QGIS CAD Sync
plugins.description: Bidirectional DWG/DXF conversion and live AutoCAD sync for QGIS — reliable Processing algorithms plus a background watcher that keeps QGIS layers up to date as you save in AutoCAD.
plugins.about:
Two independent tools in one plugin.

CONVERSION (requires ODA File Converter, installed separately — free, opendesign.com): four Processing algorithms under Processing Toolbox > DWG / DXF Conversion — "Convert DWG file to DXF", "Bulk convert DWG folder to DXF", "Convert DXF file to DWG", and "Bulk convert DXF folder to DWG". Bulk conversions skip files already converted by default (safe to re-run), validate the input folder up front, enforce a timeout to avoid hanging on blocking dialogs, and report exactly which files failed. Successful DXF results can be added to the current project automatically. No dialog required — runs via qgis_process, Processing models, PyQGIS scripts, or QGIS's built-in batch runner.

LIVE SYNC (no ODA dependency — works standalone if you save directly to DXF from AutoCAD): a dockable panel that watches DXF files on disk and automatically reloads the matching QGIS layer whenever AutoCAD saves changes. Loads from a shadow copy rather than the original file so AutoCAD can always save without QGIS locking it, waits for the file to stop changing before reading it (not just a fixed delay), supports pause/resume and manual sync, keeps optional version history, logs all activity, shows per-file sync status, and persists the watch list into the QGIS project so it's restored automatically next session.

Works on QGIS 3.x and 4.x, Windows/macOS/Linux (headless Linux needs xvfb for the conversion algorithms only). Developed by Kelvin Moseti — linkedin.com/in/kelvin-moseti-welkinsgroup
plugins.author: Kelvin Moseti

plugins.name: GeoBridge
plugins.description: Discover, semantically search, and preview Copernicus climate data (ERA5, CAMS, CEMS) as WMTS layers directly in QGIS, powered by the geobridge Python library.
plugins.about: GeoBridge_Plugin wraps the geobridge library to bring Copernicus Data Store (C3S/CAMS/CEMS) dataset discovery, plain-language semantic search, and time-stepped WMTS raster preview layers (with a play/pause slider) into QGIS. Enter your CDS API key once, search for a use case ("urban heat island", "PM2.5 exposure"), and add the recommended layer straight to the map. A later phase adds GeoTIFF export via ARCO Zarr or the CDS API job queue.
plugins.author: GeoBridge contributors

plugins.name: Mangrove Extraction
plugins.description: Automatic mangrove extraction from Sentinel-2 remote sensing imagery
plugins.about: QGIS plugin for automatic mangrove extraction from Sentinel-2 imagery (R10 bands: B2, B3, B4, B8, with optional integration of resampled SWIR bands B11/B12). This plugin targets extent mapping and multi-temporal monitoring of mangroves for reproducible scientific research, relying on freely available data (Copernicus). Important: the model is retrained on every run (no preloaded model) -- the selected ground-truth layer must always correspond to the same geographic area as the Sentinel-2 bands in use, otherwise the plugin refuses the computation before it starts.
plugins.author: Dr EDEA O. Emile

plugins.name: Optical Downloader
plugins.description: Download cloud-masked Sentinel-2 and Landsat 8/9 imagery from Microsoft Planetary Computer, no account or API key required.
plugins.about: Searches Microsoft Planetary Computer for the least-cloudy Sentinel-2 L2A or Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 scene over an area and date you choose, and saves a georeferenced, cloud/shadow-masked GeoTIFF. Define the area by drawing on the map or by selecting an existing polygon layer (the output is clipped exactly to that polygon, not just its bounding box). No sign-in or API key is needed, since Sentinel-2 and Landsat are in Planetary Computer's open, public collection tier.
plugins.author: Ilias Machairas

plugins.name: WaterQual
plugins.description: Sentinel-2 water quality monitoring for lakes, reservoirs, and other inland/coastal waterbodies — chlorophyll-a and turbidity proxies (NDCI, NDTI) plus calibrated chlorophyll-a estimators (OC3, Gilerson), no account or API key required.
plugins.about: Searches Microsoft Planetary Computer for the least-cloudy Sentinel-2 L2A scene over a waterbody and date you choose, masks clouds/shadows and non-water pixels, and computes one of four water-quality algorithms: NDCI (unitless chlorophyll-a proxy), NDTI (unitless turbidity proxy), OC3 (calibrated chlorophyll-a for clear water), or Gilerson (calibrated chlorophyll-a for turbid water). Works on lakes, reservoirs, ponds, and other water surfaces large enough for a stable sample at Sentinel-2's 10m resolution. Saves a georeferenced index GeoTIFF plus a report with summary statistics, and can optionally also save the raw RGB+NIR+SWIR imagery alongside it for visual monitoring. No sign-in or API key needed — Sentinel-2 is in Planetary Computer's open, public collection tier.
plugins.author: Ilias Machairas, Ashish Kuruvila
